rows.title: Associate Analyst – Nectar360 Supplier Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
At Sainsbury’s, data sits at the heart of how we operate, innovate and serve our customers. Our Data & Analytics team is building a technically advanced, commercially focused and impactful capability, powering our Next Level Strategy and helping to create a Sainsbury’s powered by industry leading AI algorithms. We use data, technology and advanced analytics to drive better decisions across the business, from forecasting and optimisation to experimentation, personalisation and machine learning. With one of the richest retail datasets I n the UK and a portfolio spanning Sainsbury’s, Argos, Habitat and Nectar, the opportunity to innovate is huge. Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges at scale, create measurable impact and grow quickly alongside brilliant colleagues. People who thrive with us combine business understanding, technical expertise and curiosity, with a natural instinct for problem-solving. Join us and help shape the future of retail through data and AI.

Based in the Sainsbury’s Office in London, we’re recruiting an ambitious Associate Analyst to work alongside stakeholders in Nectar360 & Sainsbury’s to drive our media and consultancy proposition to FMCG and GM clients. Nectar360 is the company behind Nectar, the UK’s largest loyalty programme, with over 27m members across the country.

Do you take satisfaction in seeing your recommendations implemented in the ‘real world’? Are you analytically creative and motivated by new challenges? Do you have a passion for working with data to drive insight and improve customer understanding?

When you join us you will be providing world-class customer insights for our clients. Utilising the Nectar data to understand how we can personalise the customer experience and drive business impact, this role is a fantastic opportunity to apply and develop your analytical capabilities.

The role is based in our London office on average 1 day a week, with home working expected the remainder of the time. Occasional travel to our FMCG clients is required.

What will you be doing? 

You'll analyse Nectar, Sainsbury's and supplier data to maximise understanding of customer behaviour and provide impactful insights and recommendations. You'll take responsibility for delivering end-to-end analytical projects, using SQL to interrogate large datasets and combining multiple sources including Sainsbury's transactional data, ranging data and customer profiling information. You'll build your analytical and technical expertise as you deliver projects across a wide variety of topics, such as customer journeys, segmentation, ranging, promotions and campaign effectiveness. You'll be expected to work confidently with large datasets, developing efficient and accurate SQL solutions to answer complex business questions. You’ll take a proactive role in delivering increasing revenue for Nectar360, such as experimenting with new methods and data to enhance analytics, and improving our analytics efficiencies. You should be able to look beyond the data to find relevant and actionable insights that are useful and interesting to stakeholders. You’ll be responsible for making your insight actionable; explaining complex analytics to non-technical audiences and making clear recommendations on how stakeholders should be using the insight you’re providing. You’ll be expected to confidently & independently create well formatted PowerPoint documents and Tableau dashboards that explain the analysis that you have generated, presenting findings to internal & external stakeholders in an engaging and enthusiastic manner. 

Essential Criteria

An innovative mind and a passion for solving problems. Technical confidence and statistical understanding to manipulate and interpret datasets using Excel and SQL, R or Python. Experience of BI tools (e.g. Tableau or Business Objects) and AWS/Snowflake would be advantageous. Excellent communication skills and experience in collaborating with peers or colleagues. 

This role will suit you if:

You’re looking to grow your career in a fast paced, commercial environment. You’re looking to work autonomously in a client-facing environment. You’ll take accountability for your analytical projects and build strong collaborative partnerships with both Sainsbury’s suppliers and internal teams. You thrive on excellence all the way. You will need to deliver high-quality insight with attention to detail. You’re looking for variety and new challenges. We work with a wide range of contacts across Nectar360 and Sainsbury’s, providing analytical advice to multiple business units. No two questions are the same, so you’ll need to be analytically creative whilst thinking on your feet to understand the real question we need to answer and implementing the best analytical techniques to do so. 

What we offer 

Colleague discount across the multi-brands – Sainsbury’s, Argos and Habitat Holiday allowance Bonus scheme Pension plan Special offers on gym memberships, restaurants, holidays, retail vouchers and more 

You’ll also benefit from being part of the wider Data & Analytics community at Sainsbury’s. We have Big Data with a great culture and huge learning and development opportunities.

Flexible working and job share conversations are encouraged. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer that champions a diverse and inclusive culture. If you’re reading this, even if you’re not 100% sure you’re there with your experience, we’d still love to hear from you. 

#DataAndAnalytics

#Analytics

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so youll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, theres always the chance to try something new - whether thats as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, well also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them: Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. This increases to 15% off at Sainsburys every Friday and Saturday and 15% off at Argos every pay day. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related target bonus of up to 5% of salary (which may vary for Nectar360), depending on how we perform. Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance and you can buy additional holiday. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, pay advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance programme. Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks pay for paternity leave. Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply). Please note, due to the volume of applications we receive, our roles may close early.

rows.title: SEO Manager (Technical)
rows.descriptionText:
SEO Manager (Technical) - Ralph Lauren 
As our new SEO Manager, you'll come from an SEO background but have solid strategy and reporting skills. You’ll predominantly be working on the Ralph Lauren account. Working both with your Account Director and the wider SEO team, as well as collaborating with the wider business, you'll be responsible for delivering a best-in-class experience to our luxury ecommerce clients. 
Note: we have a hybrid work arrangement where everyone must be in the office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. 
Responsibilities  Strong data and analytics background, hands-on experience in Adobe Analytics, including segmentation, attribution and visitor-level analysis. Ability to identify opportunities, risks and the underlying drivers behind performance changes. Strong reporting and presentation skills, able to explain what is driving performance and translate complex data into clear actions and recommendations. You’ll be working directly in technical SEO experience with large international e-commerce environments, including headless architecture, React/Next.js, SSR, CSR, hydration, JavaScript rendering, indexation and technical QA. Experience working with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC), including category attributes, metadata management, refinements/faceted navigation, product tagging, and XML bulk uploads/imports. Deep understanding of international SEO e-commerce, including hreflang architecture, localisation and international site migrations. Strong knowledge of structured data (JSON-LD), with the ability to validate implementation against page state and rendered content. Ability to identify AI and search trends, changing search behaviour and consumer sentiment, combining public and first-party performance data to identify emerging trends, risks and growth opportunities. Highly autonomous and naturally curious, able to take an ambiguous problem, determine the right data and methodology, test hypotheses and develop a recommendation with minimal direction. Develop and implement content-led SEO strategies tailored to luxury fashion and beauty brands. Conduct in-depth keyword research and content gap analysis to inform strategy Collaborate closely with the PPC, Social, and affiliate teams to ensure unified campaign execution. Attend and contribute to client meetings, presentations, and performance reviews Identify outreach and backlink opportunities to support organic growth. Stay on top of industry trends and emerging content/SEO techniques relevant to luxury and ecommerce sectors. Continue to develop your knowledge within the digital industry, share and discuss with peers how organic search is changing and how Assembly can react to these changes. Ensure all your accounts are driving hard to continually add value to the client's business, this will be through continued optimisation and innovation. Looking for areas where this can be driven from. Participating in new business work when required, taking ownership and ensuring delivery of the areas you have been assigned. 
Required Skills  3+ years' experience in SEO, with minimum 2 years within an agency environment. Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics or equivalent platforms to investigate performance, identify trends and uncover the drivers behind changes in organic and ecommerce performance. Strong experience in forecasting, using statistical/time-series approaches such as Prophet, ensemble models and other forecasting models, with an understanding of model accuracy and evaluation metrics such as WAPE, MAPE and forecast bias. Comfortable using Python, SQL, and APIs to analyse large datasets at scale. Experience working with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) or similar ecommerce platforms/CMSs such as Shopify, Adobe Commerce or equivalent enterprise solutions. Strong understanding of technical SEO fundamentals, including crawlability, indexation, canonicalisation, redirects, HTTP status codes, robots directives, XML sitemaps and internal linking. Solid understanding of SEO tools (e.g. Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog) and experience with uncovering insights. Strong reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines across different clients. Unafraid to voice strong out-of-the-box creative ideas. Excellent communication and presenting skills, including written & spoken English. 
Nice to have  Multiple languages as well as English would be a nice bonus, as we handle a lot of international clients and clients in various markets globally. This isn’t a requirement though as we also work closely with our translation team! Strong interest in AI, generative search and emerging technologies, with curiosity around how they may change search behaviour, ecommerce and digital discovery. Experience within luxury, fashion, beauty or large-scale retail ecommerce. 

At Stagwell Media, our mission is to find the change that fuels growth. We apply this principle to the work we do with our clients and to how we engage with our people. We’re a modern global agency bringing together media, data, technology and talent to make brands perform.
Our business is purpose driven. In March 2022, we were named Ad Age’s first ever Purpose-Led Agency of the Year, recognised for our mission to leave the world better than we found it. This year we became B Corp certified, the result of a two-year journey. We’re proud to have created a culture where diversity of thought, experience, and background are valued, within an environment that fosters continuous learning, adaptability, and a shared passion for meaningful impact.When you join Stagwell Media, you become part of an award-winning global community of digitally led experts, home to 1,500 talented people across 25 offices globally. Together we create unique data, technology and media solutions that enable faster and smarter problem solving within an inspired, collaborative workplace.
Stagwell Media is poised for its next chapter of growth. We’re a meritocratic, high-performance business with a progressive outlook and a growth mindset in all that we do. To realise our potential we need some new skills and thinking.
The core DNA of Assembly lies in digital performance marketing. New and existing clients are asking us to extend this expertise across all media, connecting traditional channels with digital methods of execution, measurement and automation. We were born the right way to do this – we’re building out from a leading digital and technology capability and adding the rest, rather than trying to reverse engineer a legacy business into a more modern version of itself. At Assembly we ask our people to embody three core values:
Show Up: actively contribute to a space of personal and collective growthMake Change: embrace obstacles as opportunities, taking intentional steps to drive positive changeWin Well: approach success with integrity, responsibility, and a commitment to collaboration, understanding that the journey is as important as the destination.
We look forward to meeting you and to discussing how we can grow together.

rows.title: Environmental Health, Safety and Sustainability (Multiple Roles and Locations) Industrial Placement, 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Choose Wisely, Apply Confidently

To maximise your opportunities at securing an Industrial Placement with us this year, we strongly advise that you apply to no more than 3 adverts. (For clarity, multiple roles within a single advert are considered one application.)

We encourage you to concentrate your efforts on the roles that best align with your skills, interests and university experience, as this will strengthen your application and give you the best chance of success.

Roles Available in Location: Worthing, Montrose, Ware

Education required: See individual roles for degree requirements

Pre-application activity: Before applying, you'll need to obtain an application code by completing a short activity in Connectr, our candidate engagement platform.

This activity is designed to encourage considered applications. Once completed, you'll receive your unique application code required to proceed with your application.

Other requirements: You will have completed a minimum of 2 years of your undergraduate degree but will not have graduated at the start of your placement. You must be enrolled at a UK (United Kingdom) or ROI (Republic of Ireland) University for the duration of your placement.

If you have already graduated with a bachelor’s degree and are currently studying a postgraduate Masters, you are not eligible for this programme.

Language requirement: Written and spoken fluency in English

Expected Start date: July 2027

Duration: 1 year (approximately)

Salary: A salary of £26,400 plus a bonus.

Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required

Application Closing: Roles are expected to close on 13/10/2026, however, candidates will be reviewed regularly, and the advert may close at any point. Please ensure you review and complete the application stages below.

Are you looking to gain valuable real world work experience and help positively impact the lives of others? 

A GSK internship offers you the opportunity to kickstart your career – to take on a real role with genuine impact. You’ll take on challenging tasks within live projects or assignments. You’ll also get to learn from others in your team and other parts of GSK whilst developing your skills and gaining valuable experience for wherever the future takes you.

What do we offer you? 

A competitive salary, with an annual bonus based on company performance. Employee recognition programs, which reward exceptional achievements. Access to our cutting-edge wellbeing platform: personalize your experience, help reduce stress, increase focus, build connections and resilience. You will also have access to a confidential helpline 24/7, mindfulness, health screenings and financial wellbeing support. Access to Private Healthcare Insurance, including 24-hour access to an online GP. Optional Support: Includes identity protection, long-term care insurance, home, auto, and pet insurance Opportunities to work with Employee Resource Groups, providing opportunities to network, gain mentorship, and develop personally and professionally. Access to IPUnite which is a community of Early Careers programme participants offering development, networking and social connections to help you make the best of your programme. You will also be invited to join LinkedIn groups and pre-joining webinars, to enable you to connect and network with new students. 2 volunteering days per year 

Typical skills you can expect to learn on this placement will include:

Teamworking through working with multidisciplinary teams Communication (written & verbal) Time management Problem-solving Networking Data analysis and management Technical skills (detailed within each role description) 

The Roles (3 available)

Role 1 – Environment, Health & Safety Associate - Worthing

Degree requirements: Engineering related disciplines: Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Engineering or other relevant degree subject.

Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required

Overview of the Department

The Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Placement offers experience within a cross-functional team supporting the safety, health, and environmental performance of a manufacturing site. The role provides exposure to a wide range of site operations, enabling students to develop practical experience in risk management, safety improvement, sustainability initiatives, data analytics, and project delivery. Working with stakeholders across the business, students contribute to creating a safe and sustainable workplace while developing valuable technical, analytical, and project management skills.

Key Placement Activities

Conducted risk assessments and supported risk management activities to identify hazards and implement effective control measures. Supported the development and implementation of safety programme, promoting a strong culture of health, safety, and compliance across the site. Analyzed EHS performance data and utilized digital analytics tools to identify trends, create reports, and support data-driven decision-making. Assisted with EHS audits, compliance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to maintain high safety and environmental standards. Developed and supported engineering and sustainability solutions to address safety, environmental, and operational challenges. Managed and contributed to EHS projects and wellbeing initiatives, promoting environmental sustainability alongside physical and mental health awareness. 

Role 2 – Environmental Health, Safety Montrose

Degree requirements: Health & Safety, Environmental Science or related life sciences/engineering degree.

Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required

Overview of the Department

This Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Placement provides practical experience supporting safety, health, and environmental compliance within manufacturing and laboratory operations. The role involves working closely with operational teams to promote a strong safety culture, support regulatory compliance, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Students gain exposure to risk management, incident investigation, auditing, training, environmental activities, and project delivery while developing a broad understanding of EHS practices in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.

Key Placement Activities

Supported day-to-day EHS compliance activities, including risk assessments (COSHH), safety inspections, audits, and maintenance of EHS records. Assisted with incident and near-miss investigations, analyzing findings and contributing to actions that improve workplace safety. Supported the implementation and continuous improvement of EHS programme, including waste management, chemical handling, permit-to-work systems, and environmental monitoring. Analyzed EHS performance data and trends to support reporting, compliance monitoring, and data-driven decision-making. Prepared safety documentation and delivered EHS training, inductions, and toolbox talks to promote awareness and a positive safety culture. Contributed to EHS projects and environmental compliance initiatives, engaging with stakeholders across manufacturing and laboratory operations to drive continuous improvement. 

Role 3 – Environmental Health and Safety Support – Ware

Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required

Overview of the Department

The site EHS team at Ware are responsible for the safety of staff, contractors and visitors on site. The team specialize in different fields including engineering activities, ergonomics, manual handling, noise, COSHH and high-risk activities.

Organizing and running site meetings, understanding of site safety requirements and implementing standards, point of contract for contractors and staff on safety concerns. rows.title: Network Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About VIRTUS

VIRTUS Data Centres is the UK’s fastest-growing data centre provider. We own, design, build, and operate some of the most energy-efficient, flexible, and secure data centres in Europe.

In 2023, we announced our expansion into continental Europe, starting with Berlin and Milan, with plans to grow further across the region.

At VIRTUS, we aim to be a positive force in the fourth industrial revolution—delivering innovative solutions while staying firmly rooted in our core values: Clarity & Quality, Accountability, Customer Commitment, Purposeful Innovation, and Capability & Growth.

Job Summary

VIRTUS is seeking an experienced Network Engineer with strong Cisco, switching, routing, firewall, segmentation, and data centre networking experience to support the design, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of secure enterprise and production network infrastructure across multiple sites.

The engineer will operate in a fast paced, critical infrastructure environment and must be capable of working independently, on site, and across multiple technology domains, collaborating with internal teams and third party vendors to deliver reliable and secure network services.

Duties And Responsibilities

The role includes but is not limited to the following:

Network Infrastructure Management

 Build, configure, and maintain enterprise and data centre network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and firewalls. Support lifecycle management activities including upgrades, patching, and hardware replacement, ensuring alignment with supported standards and vendor best practices. Strong troubleshooting capability across switching, routing and connectivity issues in complex, multi-site environments.

Network Security & Segmentation

 Implement and maintain secure network configurations, including VLANs, segmentation between corporate and production environments, and access control policies. Support the application of cyber security controls across the network estate, including firewall rules, secure remote access, and monitoring integration.

Network Operations

 Perform day‑to‑day network activities including switch configuration, routing updates, VLAN provisioning, and network integrity checks. Troubleshoot complex network issues across multiple sites, coordinating with internal teams and third‑party providers where required.

Physical & Virtual Server Management

 Support the maintenance of physical and virtual server infrastructure, including routine health checks, capacity monitoring, firmware updates, operating system patching, and lifecycle management activities. Undertake planned maintenance activities in line with change control processes, ensuring appropriate testing, backup validation, rollback planning, and post-maintenance verification are completed.

Backup & Restore

 Configure, monitor, and maintain backup schedules for relevant physical and virtual server infrastructure, ensuring backup policies are aligned to agreed recovery point objectives (RPOs), recovery time objectives (RTOs), retention requirements, and operational risk priorities. Perform and evidence regular backup and restore testing, including validation of backup integrity, restoration procedures, recovery sequencing, and post-restore checks to confirm services can be recovered within agreed RPO and RTO targets.

Monitoring & Performance Management

 Support network & server monitoring platforms to ensure visibility of performance, availability, and capacity across the estate. Analyse network & server performance trends and implement improvements to optimise reliability and resilience.

Change & Project Delivery

 Work with internal stakeholders to deliver network changes required for infrastructure upgrades, new site deployments, and system integrations. Participate in change management processes, ensuring all changes are planned, tested, and documented appropriately.

Collaboration with Vendors & Service Providers

 Engage with network vendors and service providers to support delivery, troubleshooting, and escalation of issues. Validate external works and ensure alignment with VIRTUS standards and operational requirements.

Documentation & Compliance

 Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures. Ensure all activities align with VIRTUS policies, security standards, and regulatory compliance requirements for critical infrastructure

Person Specification

Essential

 A self‑motivated and resourceful individual, with the ability to build effective working relationships quickly across internal and third‑party teams. Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively across technical and non‑technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex network and infrastructure issues in a clear, structured, and methodical way. Pro‑active and responsive, able to prioritise workloads and operate effectively during periods of high activity, using strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Comfortable working through ambiguity, bringing structure, clarity, and control within a growing and evolving IT Operations environment. Experience operating within critical infrastructure or multi‑site environments, with an understanding of availability, resilience, and security requirements. Strong understanding of networking principles, including switching, routing, segmentation, and secure connectivity across enterprise environments.

Desirable

 Educated to degree level or equivalent, with membership of a recognised professional body and relevant industry certifications. Experience working within a data centre or other critical infrastructure environment, with an understanding of high availability and resilience requirements. Professional certifications such as CCNP or CCIE, with additional certifications in cloud or virtualisation technologies (specifically Azure, VMware) considered advantageous. Exposure to enterprise architecture concepts or frameworks (e.g. TOGAF), with an understanding of how network design supports wider IT strategy. Experience supporting hybrid environments, including integration with cloud platforms (e.g. Microsoft Azure) and enterprise services such as Microsoft 365, VMware, ServiceNow, and network monitoring tools.

Additional Information

 This is a hybrid role, with regular travel to data centres based around London, and occasional travel into central London required. This role comes with an on-call element, which will require the post holder to participate in an out-of-hours on-call escalation rota.

In line with VIRTUS’ Vetting Policy, the successful applicant must be willing to undergo a BS7858 screening process.

VIRTUS is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

We reserve the right to close this post for applications should sufficient applications be received.

Search Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully

VIRTUS Data Centres does not accept unsolicited support from search firms for employment openings. CVs/resumes submitted by search firms to any VIRTUS employee without an active, written search agreement for a specified role will become the property of VIRTUS. No fees will be paid for candidates hired from agency submissions made without such an agreement. Existing agency partnerships must adhere to position-specific terms outlined in their agreements. Please refrain from calling or emailing regarding this matter.

rows.title: Manager, Customer Engagement (EMEA)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

We're looking for a Manager, Customer Engagement (EMEA) to join our Loyalty EMEA team at Hilton.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a friendly, ambitious, and fast-paced environment where creativity, customer focus, and commercial impact go hand in hand.

The role would suit a CRM & Loyalty Marketing Manager or a Client Account Manager with agency background who thrives on delivering impactful marketing campaigns and building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business and agency partners.

If you're passionate about creating engaging and relevant customer communications, using storytelling to inspire action, leveraging customer insights to drive relevance and engagement, and applying commercial thinking to support business priorities, we'd love to hear from you.

Core initiatives in scope

 You'll be responsible for developing and delivering member engagement strategies that strengthen relationships with Hilton Honors members across the EMEA region. You'll act as a key connector between our agency partners and multiple teams across the Marketing & Loyalty organisation, including Brand & Enterprise, Destination Marketing, Co-brand, New Hotel Openings, CRM, MarTech, Analytics, and Customer Marketing Operations. Working closely with these teams and our agency partners, you'll design and execute CRM journeys, regional offers, and marketing activations across email and mobile channels that drive member activation, repeat stays, retention, engagement, and overall satisfaction. The role also plays an important part in launching new partnerships from a member experience perspective, including designing onboarding journeys for partner members and ensuring a seamless, engaging, and rewarding end-to-end Hilton Honors experience.

What areas will you be supporting?

 Lead flagship member engagement programmes across EMEA, including Monthly Unlocked and StayInspired, ensuring strong regional execution, creative excellence, stakeholder alignment, and clear performance reporting. Support the activation of new partnerships from a member engagement perspective, coordinating onboarding journeys for partner members, including welcome communications, programme education, and first-stay activation, while ensuring a clear and compelling value proposition across all channels. Partner closely with teams across the Marketing & Loyalty organisation, including Brand & Enterprise, Destination Marketing, Co-brand, New Hotel Openings, and Partnerships, to align CRM activity with broader campaigns, product and proposition launches, partnership commitments, and regional commercial priorities.

Responsibilities

What will your day to day look like?

 Own the CRM campaign calendar and delivery plan, ensuring activity is aligned to Hilton’s commercial priorities, tentpole moments, customer needs and partner commitments. Lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM journeys and regional offers across email, mobile app, and other relevant channels, from planning and briefing through to launch and optimisation. While Customer Marketing Operations and agency partners support the technical build and deployment, you will oversee the process, coordinating stakeholders and managing timelines to ensure campaigns are delivered successfully and on schedule. Develop clear audience and campaign briefs that leverage customer insights and segmentation to deliver highly targeted and personalised communications that increase relevance, deepen engagement, and drive repeat stays. Champion a test-and-learn culture, using A/B testing, pilots, and other experimentation methods to continuously improve performance and scale successful approaches across markets and audience segments. Act as the guardian of CRM quality, ensuring copy, creative, design, targeting, and proposition work together to deliver an elevated customer experience while supporting commercial objectives. Establish clear success metrics, monitor campaign performance, capture learnings, and translate insights into actionable recommendations, providing regular updates and performance reporting to senior stakeholders. Translate insights and member feedback into action: identify friction points across the member journey (understanding benefits, enrollment quality, recognition), recommend fixes, and drive stakeholder follow-through. Stay ahead of emerging trends, identifying new channels, technologies, and AI-enabled ways of working that can enhance CRM effectiveness, unlock creativity, and improve team productivity.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills

 Experience in customer engagement, CRM / lifecycle / loyalty marketing within a multi-market or international environment. A strong understanding of customer segmentation, audience targeting, and personalisation, with the ability to translate insights into relevant and engaging customer experiences and content. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Excellent stakeholder and agency management skills, with a collaborative approach and a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships. Strong team player. Self-starter, able to work independently. Ability to deliver through influence in a matrixed organization and manage multiple workstreams end-to-end. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence presenting recommendations to senior audiences. Exceptional planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills, combined with a keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work at pace. Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and insights to identify opportunities, diagnose challenges, develop hypotheses, and measure success.

Preferred Qualifications, Experience & Skills

 Loyalty program or hospitality experience. Experience working with destination marketing or travel demand-generation initiatives. Familiarity with CRM platforms and experimentation approaches (working knowledge). Experience supporting partnership launches / activations from a customer journey perspective.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

rows.descriptionText:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

This role is the primary point of accountability within Europe for the governance, tracking and reporting of the project portfolio. As a Programme Analyst you will support the planning and monitoring of programs or projects, ensuring they align with organisational objectives and deliver expected outcomes.

 Ensures that project artefacts (e.g. risks, issues, dependencies, status reports, financials, milestones) are kept up to date, and to consult with Business Partners and other key stake holders to ensure the maintenance and integrity of the project workstack. Drives consistency of approach and standards of delivery and execution across the Project Management resource pool working in collaboration with the Programme Director. Coordinates and/ or completes the preparation of the key PMO deliverables (e.g. status reports, publications, dashboards, time/resource allocation), including the monthly Senior Leadership Team Governance decks (i.e. ELT, Deep Dive and Delivery Reviews), International and Enterprise reports. Leads multiyear planning and annual financial planning on behalf of Tech and Execution. Manages the document library (and associated repositories) from initiation of a new project through to closure. Coordinates and administers key PMO meetings. Set up new projects on ‘in house’ systems and provide frontline support to all SPandE team for general enquiries whether it be calendars, artefacts, governance, SharePoint or JIRA. Analyse program data, metrics, and performance indicators advising on potential issues related to costs, benefit realisation, schedules, and performance. Consolidates time sheets in readiness for invoice approval for non-permanent employees. Assist in developing program plans, timelines, and resource allocation. Communicate with internal teams and external partners. Facilitate meetings and document action items with appropriate follow up where required. Identify inefficiencies and recommend solutions. Support implementation of best practices – drafting new or revised policies and standardised procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

 Ability to collect and analyse complex sets of data. Good critical thinking and critical thinking skills. Strong project management skills. Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or a related field.

Minimum Qualifications

 Demonstrated experience as a Programme Analyst, Management Analyst, or suitable experience in a similar role. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and report writing skills. Strong organisational and time management skills. Advanced computer skills and knowledge of multiple databases and software systems.

What Is in It for You?

Private Medical Insurance: On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.Holiday Entitlement: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs.Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

We are looking for a Digital Reporting Analyst to join our London office.

This is a great opportunity for an inquisitive and innovative individual to work in a hands-on capacity within our data & analytics team. You’ll have the opportunity to work across a number of clients & projects, with a natural home on our largest eCommerce client; identifying opportunities to improve their website & operational functions, supporting the launch of new products, and delivering growth across Europe.

Key Client Programmes

eCommerce analysis for our cornerstone client, responsible for analysis & delivery of insights leading to website and platform innovations, alongside real-time campaign performance reporting: Develop & deliver insight reports, leveraging automation process & structures to visualise performance trends. Leverage a range of tools (Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, NPS Analysis) to deep dive into, and contextualise, broader platform performance & customer experience improvements. Undertake website tagging & debugging audits, ensuring & improving accuracy of performance reporting & insights delivered. Provide ongoing insight reporting throughout the year, identifying eCommerce optimisations & efficiencies. Assorted additional client projects Own performance reporting of an owned retail platform, providing monthly & quarterly insights packages & uncovering engagement trends across platform functionality & audience groups. Character

A strong collaborator with an inquisitive mind & a pragmatic problem solver. rows.descriptionText:
Associate, Product Data & Analytics

A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (PFI), we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

rows.title: Intern, Application Support
rows.descriptionText:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!

Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.

What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in education, using modern technology.

Today, we’ve digitized payments for more than 3,300+ global clients across education, healthcare, travel & B2B, covering more than 240 countries and territories and supporting over 140 currencies. And, we’re just getting started!

With over 1000+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 14 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.



Job Description

Are you ready to keep the world's money moving?

At Flywire, our Payments Platform processes billions of dollars across 240+ countries — and when something goes wrong, payers can't pay, clients can't get paid, and the business stops. That's where Application Support comes in. We are the team that keeps the platform running: investigating production issues, partnering with Engineering to fix root causes, and turning recurring pain into permanent improvements.

We are looking for Fly-terns (Final year students) in London to join the Application Support team this summer. You won't just be "shadowing" — you'll be working on real production issues and building tooling that makes our team faster, smarter, and more proactive.

The Role: Project-Driven & Supported

As a Fly-tern in Application Support, you will be embedded within our team and participate in our day-to-day rituals — triage, ticket reviews, incident handling — while focusing on a specific, high-impact project designed for your 6-week journey.

To ensure you grow and succeed, you will have a dedicated support system:

A Mentor: A senior Application Support engineer for day-to-day guidance, pair-debugging sessions, and code reviews.

A Manager: To support your professional growth, provide feedback, and help you navigate the Flywire culture.

What You'll Work On

Application Support sits at the intersection of engineering, product and operations, so your project can dive deep into very different technical areas. Possible domains include:

Support Tooling & Automation: Building internal tools (Ruby/Python) and integrations that reduce manual work — auto-triage scripts, ticket enrichers, self-service runbooks, or operational dashboards used by the team every day.

Observability & Insights: Designing dashboards and alerts on top of our payments data (Sumo Logic, Jira, MySQL, MongoDB) to surface recurring issues, escalation patterns, or SLA risks before they become incidents.

AI-Augmented Support: Helping us push the boundaries of how Application Support uses AI — from automated investigation agents to AI-assisted ticket categorization and knowledge base generation from past resolutions.

Root-Cause Engineering: Pairing with the team on a recurring class of production issues — from data inconsistencies in the global ledger to integration failures with banking partners — and shipping the fix end-to-end with our Engineering squads.

AI-Augmented Engineering

Application Support is one of the most AI-forward teams at Flywire. As an intern, you will learn to leverage cutting-edge AI tools like Cursor, Claude Code and Gemini to investigate issues faster, draft runbooks, query logs, and build internal automations. We treat AI as a teammate, and we'll teach you how to get the most out of it.



Qualifications

Here's What We're Looking For

Current student in the 4th year of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or Data Science. We highly value candidates from Double Degrees in Mathematics and Informatics Engineering, as well as specialized degrees in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Informatics Engineering.

Tech Foundations: Comfortable with SQL and at least one scripting language (Python, Ruby, JavaScript). Curiosity about how distributed systems, APIs, and databases behave in production is more important than years of experience.

The Support Mindset: You enjoy debugging more than greenfield coding. You like asking "why is this happening?" until you reach the real answer, and you care about both the technical fix and the user on the other side of the ticket.

Communication: Fluency in Spanish and a strong working command of English to collaborate with our global teams, partner with Engineering, and write clear, empathetic responses to internal stakeholders.

Bonus: any exposure to FinTech, payments, observability tools (Sumo Logic, Datadog, Grafana), or ticketing systems (Jira) will be appreciated.

Our Tech Stack

Platforms we support: Ruby on Rails, Java (Spring Boot), React

Data/Messaging: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ

Observability & Tooling: Sumo Logic, Jira, GitLab CI, AWS

AI & Tools: Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini

What We Offer

Flexible June Start: We prioritize your exams; your start date is adaptable.

London Hub Culture: Work from our founding office with a vibrant community of FlyMates.

Global Showcase: Present your project results to engineering and operations leaders across the globe.

Career Growth: Successful Fly-terns are our first priority for full-time Associate roles after graduation.



Additional Information

 

Submit today and get started!

We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

Flywire is an equal opportunity employer. With over 30 nationalities across 12 different offices, and diversity and inclusion at the core of our people agenda, we believe our FlyMates are our greatest asset, and we’re excited to watch our unique culture evolve with each new hire.

Flywire is an equal opportunity employer.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are seeking a curious and commercially minded Data Analyst to join our growing team at CompassRock. While this role is based in the residential rental sector, we actively welcome applications from professionals with experience in hospitality, airlines, or broader real estate industries—particularly those who bring a passion for elevating customer experience through data-driven decisions.

Our mission is to redefine urban renting—delivering a seamless, service-led living experience. Your analysis will directly inform pricing strategies, marketing performance, resident satisfaction, leasing effectiveness, and broader commercial planning across our portfolio.

Company Overview

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sector. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across England and Europe. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, the company values the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs. As CompassRock continues to expand, there will be abundant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

What You'll Do

Leverage large datasets to generate actionable insights around resident behaviour, leasing trends, retention, and demand drivers.Support the leasing and revenue teams by identifying opportunities for rent optimization, concession planning, and lead conversion improvement.Monitor and analyse digital marketing channel performance (e.g. PPC, aggregators, OTAs), particularly for lease-ups and new openings.Benchmark operational and service KPIs—occupancy, turnaround times, customer service touchpoints—across sites or regions.Translate data into clear visual dashboards and compelling presentations for senior stakeholders.Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, leasing, revenue management and operations to improve the end-to-end resident experience.

Who We're Looking For

Proven analytical experience in BTR, hospitality, airlines, hotels, or real estate.Experience in building and structuring datasets or data cubes to support scalable reporting and analytics—ideally with a view to implementing BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Proficient in working with large datasets using tools like SQL and Excel.A commercial mindset with the ability to link data insights to real business outcomes.Strong communication skills—you know how to turn complex numbers into actionable recommendations.Curious, collaborative, and highly adaptable.

Bonus If You Have

Experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, or marketing attribution.Exposure to customer or guest satisfaction data (e.g. NPS, reviews, feedback tools).Previous work with leasing systems or property management software.

Renumeration / Bonuses / Benefits

Salary: CompetitiveBonuses: Discretionary Bonus SchemeBenefits: a) Company Pension Scheme; b) Vitality Private Healthcare Insurance; c) Company Sick Pay; d) Bike to Work SchemeWorking Hours: 40 hour working weekJob Type: Full-time, Permanent, 4x work from the office, 1x WFHLocation: Oxford Street, London (Corporate Head Office)

We are an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We provide equal opportunities for everyone and offer reasonable adjustments to ensure all candidates have a fair chance during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.

The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.title: Marcus by Goldman Sachs, Research Manager, Associate - London
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

OUR IMPACT

Across Asset Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking, and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our direct-to-consumer business provides digital solutions that help customers save and invest. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data, and design.

Marcus by Goldman Sachs 

As the online consumer banking business of Goldman Sachs, Marcus operates as a digital bank, providing online savings products directly to individual consumers. Marcus combines Goldman Sachs' over 150 years of expertise with intuitive digital experiences, focusing on value, transparency, and simplicity for its millions of customers.

The Role

We’re seeking an enthusiastic, proactive and highly motivated Research Manager to join the research team in our London office. Reporting to the Research and Insights Lead, this role will manage a broad programme of market and consumer research across multiple markets, delivering high-quality insight that informs customer, product, brand and communications decisions. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesDesign and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Forrester’s Research Associate for the European research team supports a team of analysts whose research and advisory guide today’s business and technology leaders on established and emerging best practice processes and technologies to ignite customer-obsessed growth.

Job Description:

Job Requirements:

A BA or BS degree with a strong academic record; interest in statistics or quantitative data is a major plus. B2-level English proficiency or above. Varied undergraduate or postgraduate work experience, ideally in market research or with technology.  The willingness to actively and intellectually engage with colleagues, including more senior colleagues such as analysts.  Enthusiasm to learn about business processes and their impact on business results; passion for learning about technology and its impact on business and society.  Effective time and project management skills.  A working knowledge of word processing, presentation, and spreadsheet software.  Sharp attention to detail and resourcefulness.

Let’s be bold, together.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Job Description

The Data Scientist Graduate is a key member of the client-facing Data Science Lab team in the European region. As a Data Scientist, you will be accountable for the development and delivery of analytics-driven strategies and solutions for Visa’s external clients in Europe. In this role, you will work collaboratively with VCA and a multitude of internal functions, their senior leaders, and our clients in promoting an insight-driven culture, creative analytic solutions, and best practices to drive business performance with a clear commercial ‘value’ and measurable ‘return’. Half of your day will involve delivering projects (coding/working with data), and the other half will be dedicated to discussing data requirements and managing internal and external meetings. Sometimes we might be delivering a CSV file; another time, a predictive machine learning model or segmentation. Whatever the solution is, you will be involved in the end-to-end process, starting from gathering clients’ requirements all the way to delivering actionable insights that enable our clients to make data-driven business decisions.

Principal Responsibilities
