rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Part of the broader Addepar Data Management organisation, the Portfolio Data Operations team is responsible for ensuring Addepar's clients have timely and high quality data. This will include overseeing the processing of transactions and positions so that it meets client timelines, ensuring data quality through verification checks, and helping clients with their data support questions. The Portfolio Data Operations team sits at the nexus of Addepar's activity and requires daily communications with data providers, clients, and other personnel within Data Operations and across the firm.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

Perform daily internal verification checks to ensure portfolio account data is accurate and available within SLAs.Investigate and troubleshoot data pipeline issues and data feed processing exceptions, and triage with Engineering Support when needed.Complete and maintain operational workflows, and identify and implement opportunities for optimisation.Collaborate with Client Support, Solution Architects, and other members of Sales and Services to address client data inquiries and requests.Partner with Product and Engineering to design, test, and implement new processes and tooling features that improve data quality as well as increase operational efficiency.Participate in broad company initiatives to stand up new product offerings and services.

Who You Are

Prior work experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with deep knowledge of capital markets, trade processing and lifecycle, and middle/back-office operations systems.Demonstrates excellent attention to details and a passion for problem solving!Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with internal and external stakeholders.Proven track record of multitasking and prioritising effectively in a fast paced environment.Very team-oriented, balanced, and forward thinking.Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, SQL, Salesforce, Jira, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, or other common financial services systems and applications.

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. The Opportunity

With roles from hospitality to research, there’s a career for everyone at the University of Edinburgh. We can offer opportunities for you to develop in your career and make a real difference in the communities around us while contributing to the world at large. 

We offer careers and roles in just about every area you can think of. Whether you are looking for entry-level, mid-career or roles at the top of your chosen specialism, we can offer you a career where you can flourish and make a real difference in the communities around us while contributing to the world at large. The University isn’t just any employer. We are part of a local community and a contributor to global thinking, progress and research. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices.

Join the University of Edinburgh and you’ll be making a difference to everything around you. Be part of something bigger — where you’ll do meaningful work, grow and progress, be rewarded and recognised, and benefit from our strong commitment to your wellbeing. There are so many reasons to join us. 

Applications are invited for an Epidemiologist/ Health Data Scientist, to work with Dr Peter Gallacher and Prof. Neeraj Dhaun (Bean) (Cardiovascular and Renal Healthcare Data Research Group) on an ambitious research programme utilising high-fidelity, routinely-collected NHS data to improve cardiovascular risk prediction and management in patients with kidney disease.

The postholder will work at the interface between cardio-renal epidemiology, data science, medical statistics, and clinical medicine. They will contribute to original, high-impact quantitative research by accessing, curating and interrogating large-scale and complex regional and national datasets, comprising linked administrative, biochemistry, diabetes, hospitalisation, mortality, prescribing, renal and transplantation data.

The postholder will work with clinical researchers to transform and curate linked datasets, design novel and exciting data-linkage studies, and perform advanced data analytics and statistical modelling. They will be embedded within our growing research team, comprising clinical research nurses and clinician researchers from a variety of public health, primary and secondary care backgrounds. The postholder will also provide guidance to other members of the research group, including undergraduate or postgraduate students. As our research team grows, they will help to recruit and lead a team of epidemiologists and data scientists.

Our research team is based within the Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research – a BHF-funded Centre of Research Excellence in Edinburgh – and works closely and collaboratively with a variety of research teams under the auspices of the Centre’s ‘Heart Diseases’ and ‘Data-Driven Innovation’ Research Themes ( https://cardiovascular-science.ed.ac.uk/research/cvs-bhf-centres/bhf-centre-of-research-excellence ).

This role would suit an ambitious individual who is either looking to develop their skills and career in high-impact health data research, or a more experienced epidemiologist/data scientist looking to expand their role within a dynamic and specialist team.

You Will Have

 An undergraduate qualification or equivalent in a mathematics, statistics, computing science, scientific or health-related field;  Experience of clinical epidemiology or health data science;  Experience of data management (e.g. data cleaning and manipulation);  Experience of statistical modelling;  Proficiency in programming (e.g. statistical programming in R);  A strong level of attention-to-detail that is well-suited to handling and analysing large-scale, complex linked datasets. 

You will be based in the Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research, Queen’s Medical Research Institute, University of Edinburgh, 47 Little France Crescent, Edinburgh EH16 4TJ.

The position is funded through an award from the British Heart Foundation and is available immediately for 2 years in the first instance.

About The Team

School of Neurological and Cardiovascular Sciences

We host research and postgraduate training in neuroscience, cardiovascular, metabolic and psychiatric research. We are one of six schools in the College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine at the University of Edinburgh and are home to the Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research.

Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research

Our institute fosters collaborative neuroscience, cardiovascular, metabolic and psychiatric research to tackle some of the world's most significant health challenges.

Our research explores health and disease across the body and life course – from tiny changes in cells to the lived experience of patients. Together, we work to advance the understanding, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of major health conditions including heart disease, stroke, metabolic dysfunction, mental illness, dementia and neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders. Empowered by genetics, advanced imaging, artificial intelligence and clinical trials, our research seamlessly connects discovery science with clinical care.

Our institute community

Our researchers drive cutting-edge science, enabling our students and working hand in hand with our expert technical and professional services colleagues. College of Science and Engineering/ School of Physics and Astronomy

The Opportunity

Together we can do great things. Be part of something bigger.

We offer careers and roles in just about every area you can think of. Applications are invited for two Postdoctoral Research Associate at the Higgs Centre for Theoretical Physics, to work on applications of scattering amplitudes and the double copy to gauge theory and gravity.

The Research Associate will contribute to the European Research Council Advanced Grant project “Classical and Semiclassical Aspects of Amplitudes”. Research activities include studying the interplay of large gauge transformations, amplitudes and observables; computing (semi)classical observables both in scattering and bound domains, and investigating amplitudes in time-dependent spacetimes. The ERC grant is held by Donal O’Connell but there will be ample opportunity to work with others including Tim Adamo, Anton Ilderton, Mao Zeng and the wider group. This post is full-time (35 hours per week).

About Us

As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally.

About The Team

The Institute for Particle and Nuclear Physics is composed of three research groups.

The Particle Physics Experiments group seeks understanding of the fundamental particles of nature and the interactions governing their behaviour. In particular, we aim to explain the dominance of matter over anti-matter through the study of CP violation with the LHCb experiment: to understand the mechanisms of electroweak symmetry breaking that lead to the creation of mass, and to search for new particles at ATLAS and future colliders; to discover and characterise particle dark matter with the LUX-ZEPLIN and DarkSide-20k experiments; and to explore neutrino oscillations, and neutrinos of astrophysical origin with experiments distributed grid computing (GridPP), to store and analyse the vast quantities of data that are produced in these endeavours.

The Particle Physics Theory Group is interested in fundamental physics at all energy scales, from the hadronic binding energy scale, to the scale of present and future particle colliders, up to the energy scales of the very early universe at its first fractional second of existence. We have interest and theoretical involvement in most current and upcoming particle physics experiments, high energy colliders, and in observations made by the WMAP and Planck satellites. We pursue the very latest developments in both perturbative and nonperturbative field theory, renormalization theory, and the application of quantum field theory to other branches of physics such as turbulence theory and condensed matter systems.

The Nuclear Physics Group has a broad and diverse range of research interests aimed at understanding the properties and structure of nuclei, the origin of the chemical elements in the universe, and the way in which nuclear reactions power some of the most spectacular stellar explosions, such as novae, supernovaea and X-ray bursts. Our research is performed at world-leading oversea laboratories (TRIUMF, RIKEN, GSI, LNGS, CERN and others), using a variety of experimental techniques and state-of-the-art instrumentation developed by the group.

About Us

As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally.

About The Team

The Institute for Particle and Nuclear Physics is composed of three research groups.

The Particle Physics Experiments group seeks understanding of the fundamental particles of nature and the interactions governing their behaviour. In particular, we aim to explain the dominance of matter over anti-matter through the study of CP violation with the LHCb experiment: to understand the mechanisms of electroweak symmetry breaking that lead to the creation of mass, and to search for new particles at ATLAS and future colliders; to discover and characterise particle dark matter with the LUX-ZEPLIN and DarkSide-20k experiments; and to explore neutrino oscillations, and neutrinos of astrophysical origin with experiments distributed grid computing (GridPP), to store and analyse the vast quantities of data that are produced in these endeavours.

The Particle Physics Theory Group is interested in fundamental physics at all energy scales, from the hadronic binding energy scale, to the scale of present and future particle colliders, up to the energy scales of the very early universe at its first fractional second of existence. We have interest and theoretical involvement in most current and upcoming particle physics experiments, high energy colliders, and in observations made by the WMAP and Planck satellites. We pursue the very latest developments in both perturbative and nonperturbative field theory, renormalization theory, and the application of quantum field theory to other branches of physics such as turbulence theory and condensed matter systems.

The Nuclear Physics Group has a broad and diverse range of research interests aimed at understanding the properties and structure of nuclei, the origin of the chemical elements in the universe, and the way in which nuclear reactions power some of the most spectacular stellar explosions, such as novae, supernovaea and X-ray bursts. Our research is performed at world-leading oversea laboratories (TRIUMF, RIKEN, GSI, LNGS, CERN and others), using a variety of experimental techniques and state-of-the-art instrumentation developed by the group.

The Opportunity

As part of a strategic investment supporting the UK’s National Quantum Strategy, the University of Edinburgh is recruiting up to three Innovation Fellows to develop high-impact applications of quantum computing across a range of scientific domains. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a new field: to work at the frontier of quantum computing while delivering results that matter to science, industry, and society.

The Innovation Fellows Will Be Recruited As a Cohort And Pursue Collaborative Research Within The Quantum Advantage Turbo Charger (QATCH) Programme. Over The Course Of Their Fellowships They Will Work Alongside Research Teams At The Quantum Software Lab, Domain Experts From Across The College Of Science And Engineering, The National Quantum Computing Centre, And QATCH’s Industry Partners To Deliver Applications Of Quantum Computing In One Or More Of The Following Target Sectors

S1) Healthcare and Life Sciences.

S2) Materials and Manufacturing.

S3) Finance.

S4) Energy.

S5) AI and Data Science.

S6) Cybersecurity.

These fellowships are designed for ambitious early-career researchers who want to turn frontier quantum research into real-world impact. We welcome applicants approaching quantum computing from either direction. If your background is in quantum algorithms, information science, or hardware, this is your opportunity to apply that expertise to concrete, high-value scientific problems and to build end-to-end software pipelines that run on cutting-edge hardware. If you are an expert in one of our application domains (life sciences, materials, energy, finance, AI, or cybersecurity) this is your opportunity to unlock long-standing problems in your field with quantum computing, working side by side with leading algorithm and hardware specialists to translate your challenges into quantum solutions.

Applicants should have a demonstrable research track record in quantum computing and/or a relevant application domain and will ideally have at least two years of postdoctoral (or equivalent industry) experience. Above all, we are looking for researchers who combine scientific rigour with pragmatic execution, and who are energised by turning ideas into working solutions.

We're building a research environment that combines the intellectual freedom of Bell Labs with the urgency and impact of a focused start-up. We offer the opportunity to work on hard, long-term problems that matter—with the autonomy to follow promising directions. We value researchers who can balance scientific rigour with pragmatic execution: people who want to ship real solutions to real problems, energised by turning research into impact. rows.title: Research Data Analyst I
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Job Function Summary

Involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting a wide variety of research data. Designs and conducts research including selecting data samples, developing research instruments, analyzing collected information according to established statistical methods, and developing recommendations based on research findings. Prepares reports, charts, tables, and other visual aids to interpret and communicate data and results.

Generic Scope

Entry-level professional with limited prior experience; learns to use professional concepts to resolve problems of limited scope and complexity; works on assignments that are initially routine in nature, requiring limited judgment and decision making. Employees at this level are expected to acquire the skills and knowledge to perform more advanced work following an agreed upon time in position, through defined training and development planning.

Custom Scope

Under direct supervision, acquires skills and knowledge of professional concepts in research data analysis. Works on small projects or segments of projects with limited scope and complexity.

Department Overview

The Department of Radiology & Biomedical Imaging is one of the largest departments within the School of Medicine, generating more than $40 million in professional fee revenues each year, and submitting grant proposals resulting in $30-40 million of awards each year. More than 90% of the MD faculty in Radiology is based at the Parnassus Campus, including nine of the ten clinical sections and their chiefs, and five of the seven vice chairs. The department has significant clinical and research operations at China Basin, Mission Bay, the VAMC, ZSFG, and Mount Zion. It includes more than 150 academic personnel and approximately 225 staff FTE. In addition, there are more than 90 resident, fellow, and graduate student trainees.

The Research Data Anl 1 position is focused on the collection of clinical data focused on patients treated with PSMA radioligand therapy and peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. A multicenter database is being created to collect data on these patients to understand toxicity, efficacy and see how these drugs are used clinically. The candidate will work under the general supervision and guidance from the supervisor Dr. Thomas Hope. They will also work with Dr. Abuzar Tuchayi Moradi.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilitiesPartner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis

We're Excited About You Because…

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.

rows.title: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics

Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.

Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.

Role Summary

We are looking for a technically curious and highly motivated Blockchain Technology & Analytics Analyst to support the evaluation, monitoring, and implementation of blockchain and digital asset technologies.

This role combines blockchain data analytics, AI-assisted development and research, technical due diligence, and project execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable working hands-on with blockchain data and infrastructure while also being able to translate technical concepts into clear insights and presentations for business, product, technology, and client stakeholders.

The candidate does not need to be a blockchain expert on day one, but should have a strong technical foundation, curiosity about emerging technologies, and the ability to rapidly learn new platforms and tools using AI-assisted development and research.

A successful candidate will be someone who can take a relatively open-ended question such as "How is this validator performing?", "How does this blockchain network work?", or "Should we evaluate this technology provider?" and independently turn it into a structured technical investigation.

They will be comfortable using AI tools, data, APIs, documentation, and hands-on experimentation to quickly develop an informed point of view, and then communicate the findings clearly to stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Blockchain Technology Research

Develop a working understanding of Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains, including transactions, smart contracts, validators, nodes, RPC interfaces, and common infrastructure components.Develop familiarity with blockchain ecosystems outside EVM, particularly Solana and Canton.Use AI-driven research and analysis to evaluate the technical architecture, APIs, integration models, security considerations, and capabilities of blockchain and digital asset technology providers.Conduct technical evaluations of platforms and providers such as Fireblocks, Turnkey, Zerohash, Chainalysis, Notabene, and other emerging blockchain infrastructure and compliance solutions.Compare technology providers and clearly document capabilities, architectural tradeoffs, integration considerations, and potential use cases.

Prototyping & Technical Experimentation

Assist with the development and deployment of proofs of concept (POCs) for blockchain and digital asset use cases.Deploy and test applications, blockchain infrastructure, APIs, and supporting components on AWS and virtual machines.Work with engineering and product teams to evaluate new blockchain technologies through hands-on experimentation.Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, troubleshooting, documentation, and technology evaluation.

Blockchain Analytics & Validator Monitoring

Use Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools to rapidly build dashboards, scripts, and analytical tools for monitoring blockchain infrastructure and validator performance.Develop dashboards and analytics covering metrics such as validator fees and rewards, transaction volumes, transaction counts, aggregate transaction value, and other network performance indicators.Use Allium, SQL, and blockchain datasets to conduct on-chain data analysis and answer product, technical, and business questions.Write and troubleshoot JSON-RPC queries against blockchain nodes and RPC endpoints to retrieve blockchain, transaction, validator, and network information.Analyze blockchain data to identify trends, anomalies, and insights relevant to product development and infrastructure operations.

Technical Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

Translate complex blockchain concepts into clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.Create executive-ready presentations, architecture diagrams, technical assessments, and recommendations for stakeholders across Visa.Present findings from technology evaluations, blockchain analytics, and POCs to product, engineering, security, and business teams.Support client engagements by contributing to technical discovery and due diligence, researching client technology requirements, and evaluating potential integration approaches.

Project & Process Management

Coordinate cross-functional activities required to advance blockchain technology initiatives from evaluation through POC.Project manage internal Visa processes associated with new technologies, including Security Assessments and other technology review processes.Track dependencies, risks, decisions, action items, and approvals across technical and business stakeholders.Work with internal teams, external technology providers, and clients to move technical evaluations and POCs forward.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor’s degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.Basic understanding of Ethereum, EVM-compatible blockchains, smart contracts, transactions, wallets, nodes, and blockchain validators.Familiarity with blockchain ecosystems such as Solana and/or Canton.Experience writing SQL queries and analyzing structured datasets.Ability to work with REST APIs and JSON-RPC interfaces.Familiarity with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another scripting/programming language.Experience or strong interest in using AI coding and research tools to accelerate technical work.Basic familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, Linux, and virtual machines.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies.Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.Hands-on experience querying blockchain data using Allium or similar blockchain analytics platforms.Experience interacting directly with Ethereum or other blockchain nodes through JSON-RPC.Exposure to blockchain infrastructure, custody, wallet, compliance, or analytics platforms.Experience building dashboards or data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Grafana, Tableau, or similar platforms.Familiarity with AWS services, Docker, Git, and other development tools.Experience conducting technical vendor evaluations or technology due diligence.Experience developing prototypes or POCs involving APIs, cloud infrastructure, or emerging technologies.Interest in digital assets, stablecoins, tokenization, blockchain infrastructure, payments, or distributed ledger technologies.

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $131,900.00 to $ 204,000.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

rows.descriptionText:
Building a career at Granite may be the most valuable thing you could do...

Find your dream job today, and be part of something great. Our most powerful partnership is the one we have with our employees. Our people are our most valued asset and the foundation of Granite’s century-old success. We’re building more than infrastructure; we are building your future.

General Summary

This position is responsible for providing intermediate level expertise and analysis for system selection, implementation, integration and support of business systems to ensure alignment with Information Technology (IT) initiatives and business strategy and needs as they relate to service management.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Provide IT support for internal customers and IT staff to ensure critical business needs are met in relation to IT services and solutions. Analyze business functional requirements into technical specifications to ensure appropriate deployment of changes that impact the end user.Apply technical knowledge, skills and expertise in development and implementation methodologies to the system development lifecycle including unit testing and code review to ensure industry-established best practices are followed.Collaborate with business analysts to evaluate the impact of system changes introduced by customizations, interfaces, bug fixes, updates and upgrades to ensure timely, effective and efficient delivery of corporate systems.Ensure adequate communication is maintained regarding projects, changes, major incidents and other Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Processes and priorities so all invested parties are kept informed of progress.Resolve escalated issues and work with other team members to ensure timely resolution of production issues.Provide analysis around new changes, requirements or improvements to current systems to ensure efficient process handling.Assist in the preparation and maintenance of technical documentation to ensure IT operations processes are efficient and effective.Participate in general housekeeping activities (i.e. service desk) to comply with IT operations ticket handling procedures.Review system and application design and change documents to ensure efficient and effective handling.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Sciences, Information Systems or related field desired

Work Experience

2+ years’ experience with relevant software and development toolsetExperience with Microsoft products, Oracle, SQL and relational databasesExperience with Change and Release ManagementExperience with multiple programming languages

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Experience with or knowledge of ETL (data extraction, transformation, and load) methods and technologiesExperience designing and implementing data solutions on Databricks using the Medallion ArchitectureWorking knowledge of Azure cloud technologies and services.Familiarity with AI-powered tools and a willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies.Knowledge of ServiceNow basic operationsGood written and oral communication skillsExcellent support and problem diagnosis skillsStrong desire to jump in and investigate issues, resolve problems, and communicate statusStrong interpersonal, organizational and customer service skillsAbility to complete projects in a team-oriented environmentDemonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignmentsSQL debugging skills requiredWorking knowledge of BI tools and data warehouse concepts desiredAbility to work under high pressure

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to operate a computer keyboard. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Additional Desired Skills

Comply, understand, and support corporate safety initiatives to ensure a safe work environmentAbility and willingness to abide by Company’s Code of Conduct 

Our Benefits At a Glance

Building tomorrow starts with you, and Granite knows that you can excel only if we support you in and out of the workplace. That is why we offer a broad benefits package that includes paid holidays, sick leave, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, flexible spending plans, as well as special programs for musculoskeletal health, mental wellness, and more.

Salaried employees may choose from two PPO medical plans through Anthem BlueCross, including our most popular plan, for which 100% of the premium is paid by Granite for eligible employees and dependents. Employees can also opt into a Health Savings Account (HSA) or a Flexible Spending Account (FSA).

As part of our investment in your future outside of the workplace, Granite provides a 100% match on the first 6% of eligible compensation that salaried employees defer into their 401(k) plans, which vests immediately.

Benefits may vary for positions located outside of the continental United States.

Base Salary Range

$83,971.00 - $125,957.00

Pay may vary based upon relevant experience, skills, location, and education among other factors. 

About Granite Construction Incorporated

Granite Construction Incorporated is a member of the S&P 400 Index and is the parent company of Granite Construction Company, one of the nation's largest heavy civil contractors and construction materials producers. Granite is a Drug-Free Workplace and Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws.

For additional information on applicant/employee rights please click here.

Notice to Staffing Agencies

Granite Construction, Inc. and its subsidiaries ("Granite") will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Granite, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Granite mailing address, fax machine or email address, directly to Granite employees, or to Granite's resume database will be considered Granite property. Granite will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. Granite will consider any candidate for whom an Agency has submitted an unsolicited resume to have been referred by the Agency free of any charges or fees. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Granite's recruiting function to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully-executed contract for service and in response to a specific job opening. Granite will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have such agreement in place. Agency agreements will only be valid if in writing and signed by Granite's Human Resources Representative or his/ her designee. No other Granite employee is authorized to bind Granite to any agreement regarding the placement of candidates by Agencies.

rows.title: Landing Page SEO & AEO Strategist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Landing Page SEO & AEO Strategist

Our client is an AI technology company.

5x in office - San Francisco

The Role

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the intersection of Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, SEO, PPC, content, and growth.

You will help build our Agent Engine Optimization practice, enabling customers to increase their visibility across AI agents and emerging search experiences, with SEO serving as the technical and strategic foundation.

You will work directly with customers to understand their search strategy ( Paid & Organic ), use our platform to generate and launch landing pages at massive scale, and refine the output when the technology does not fully address a specific use case. You will optimize these pages for paid search as well as organic search rankings.

You should be strategic enough to advise customers, technical enough to learn and operate new tooling ( bonus points for adding features ), and practical enough to fill gaps manually when needed. This is not a software engineering role, but it is well suited to someone who is highly technical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with emerging AI products.

You will also help shape a new product and service offering, turning early customer needs into repeatable strategies, workflows, and product insights.

What You’ll Do

Develop strategies that improve how customers are discovered, understood, and surfaced by AI agents and emerging search platforms. Partner with customers to understand their SEO goals, target audiences, search intent, and landing page strategy. Advise customers on Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, technical SEO, and scalable landing page programs. Drive Landing Page strategy for PPC campaigns Use our platform to generate, refine, and launch high volumes of landing pages. Adapt AI-generated content for specific keywords, audiences, products, locations, and customer use cases. Build repeatable workflows that support the delivery of 30 or more landing pages per week. Apply strong editorial and SEO judgment to improve quality where automated output falls short. Identify emerging patterns in AI discovery and translate them into customer recommendations, delivery practices, and product insights. Identify recurring product gaps and translate customer feedback into actionable insights for the broader team. Help define the standards and best practices for a new category of AI-powered growth. 

What We’re Looking For

Strong experience in SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or a related field, including technical and programmatic SEO. A strong point of view on how AI agents are changing search, discovery, and customer acquisition. Experience creating or optimizing landing pages at scale. A clear understanding of search intent, keyword strategy, content quality, and conversion. Familiarity with Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, and emerging discovery behavior. Experience working directly with customers, clients, and external stakeholders. Comfort using AI tools, prompt-based workflows, and new software products. Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail. The ability to balance strategic thinking with fast, high-volume execution. The ability to bring structure to an emerging product area where the playbook is still being written. Comfort operating in an early-stage environment where products and processes are still evolving. Use Claude Code ( or similar ) 

Nice to Have

Experience in agency, consulting, professional services, or customer success. Familiarity with CRO, A/B testing, personalization, or paid search. Experience with ecommerce, SaaS, or digitally native businesses. Working knowledge of CMS platforms, analytics tools, HTML, or CSS. 

Why This Role

You will help define how we deliver a new AI-powered growth product, work directly with customers on high-impact problems, and influence how the platform evolves.

This is an opportunity to move beyond optimizing for traditional search engines and help define how companies compete for visibility in an AI-agent-driven world.

You will work directly with customers, influence how our platform evolves, and help establish the strategies and operating model for an emerging category.

rows.descriptionText:
The Company

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, and deployment hubs in Europe and the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

Saildrone is applying modern machine learning and computer vision to autonomous vehicles operating in challenging, poorly observed environments. As a Perception Machine Learning Engineer, you will develop and deploy ML-based perception capabilities using real-world vehicle data.

You will work across model development, data, evaluation, and production deployment.

The Responsibilities

Develop machine-learning-based perception systems for autonomous vehicles.Train, evaluate, and improve computer vision models using real-world sensor data.Develop data and experimentation workflows to identify failure modes and improve model performance.Build perception capabilities for detection, classification, segmentation, depth estimation, or scene understanding.Analyze vehicle data and model failures to identify weaknesses and drive improvements.Integrate models into production perception systems.Bring new machine learning techniques from experimentation into deployed systems.

The Qualifications

Strong Python programming skills.Hands-on experience developing computer vision or machine learning systems.Strong experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework.Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals and real-world visual data.Experience evaluating models using quantitative metrics and experimental analysis.Experience taking ML or computer vision systems into production.

NICE TO HAVE

C++ experience for production perception systems.Robotics, autonomous vehicle, aerospace, or defense experience.Edge or embedded ML deployment.Sensor fusion, 3D perception, or multimodal perception.ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA, or other inference optimization experience.

The base salary range for this position is shown below. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This range reflects the base salary for candidates in states requiring pay transparency disclosure.

Salary Range

$144,500—$300,000 USD

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

Benefits

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

Generous Time Off: Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual plus a robust annual holiday schedule and paid sick leave ensure you can rest, reset, and sustain performance over time.Comprehensive Health Coverage: Premium, multi-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with significant company contributions for employees and dependents—providing security and peace of mind.Shared Ownership in the Mission: Equity grants are a core part of our compensation, allowing you to participate in the long-term value you help create through meaningful, operational work.Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) retirement plan with flexible pre-tax and Roth payroll contribution options supports long-term financial planning.Investment in Your Growth: We support your continuous learning through an annual professional development reimbursement program, empowering you to sharpen your skills and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving field.Relocation Support: For eligible roles, we offer relocation assistance to help bring the world’s best talent to our mission-critical locations.

rows.title: Algorithm Engineering Intern (AI, Computer Vision & Software Engineering)
rows.descriptionText:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Responsibilities

Apply Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques to image transformation and defect detection.Analyze large-scale image datasets and evaluate algorithm performance.Prototype algorithms using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.Develop production-quality software using Modern C++ and Python.Apply best practices in software design, testing, debugging, code reviews, and version control.Collaborate with algorithm, software, systems, and application engineers to deploy solutions into production.


Required Qualifications

Strong background in Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Pattern Recognition.Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python.Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent ML frameworks.


Preferred Qualifications

HireArt is helping our client find a Robotics Data Annotator to join its team during an exciting stage of growth.

In this role, you’ll work closely with engineering, product, and research teams to produce high-quality annotations that directly improve robotic system performance. Your work will help train models, refine data quality standards, and shape annotation guidelines and workflows.

We welcome candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including robotics, computer vision, video annotation, linguistics, STEM fields, quality assurance, research, and military experience. Prior robotics experience is not required for consideration; however, candidates with 2–3 years of relevant robotics experience who also meet the preferred qualifications may be considered for the higher end of the compensation range.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, reliable, and motivated to contribute to real-world robotics systems. You have strong spatial reasoning, communicate observations clearly, and thrive in deadline-driven environments.

As a Robotics Data Annotator, You Will

Review robot demonstration and teleoperation videos to segment tasks, subtasks, and manipulation events. Write clear, precise descriptions of robot actions and behaviors within each segment. Annotate perceptual data, including drawing bounding boxes, labeling object classes, and tracking objects across frames. Follow detailed annotation guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality outputs. Identify edge cases, ambiguities, and failure modes, and escalate findings with actionable feedback. Perform quality assurance checks on your own and peers’ work to maintain data integrity. Execute annotation tasks across multiple robot platforms, environments, and use cases. Contribute to improving annotation tools, guidelines, and workflows.

Ability to perform focused, repetitive tasks with strong attention to detailStrong spatial reasoning and ability to interpret motion, object interactions, and manipulation sequencesExcellent written communication skills, with the ability to clearly describe physical actions and spatial relationshipsProficiency with Windows, macOS, or Linux, and standard productivity toolsAuthorization to work in the United States (U.S. citizenship required due to business or legal requirements)Typing speed of at least 40 words per minuteFlexibility to work varying schedules, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as needed

Preferred Qualifications

rows.title: Site Operations Capacity Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Supply Chain Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

Supply compute at a scale of 10s to 100s of GWs, the largest build out of compute in history. Qualify and dual-source across every critical equipment category, with lead-time and capacity thresholds tied directly to the forward build pipeline.Make supply chain the reason we build faster than anyone. Our modular build redefines speed in this industry, and it lives or dies on supply chain. Keep procurement permanently off the critical path so schedule compression stays our advantage, not our constraint.Build the most accurate supply chain prediction modelling that exists. Use the frontier of AI to forecast lead times, demand, and disruption with a precision the industry has never had, and turn that foresight into a structural edge.

Role Scope

Model capacity across the fleet: power, space, cooling, and compute, so allocation decisions run on numbers, not recollection.Track capacity consumption against plan and flag constraints quarters before they bind.Build the reporting that connects deployment schedules to sellable capacity for commercial and leadership.Run scenario analysis for deal and allocation decisions: what fits where, by when, at what displacement.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.You've done capacity, utilization, or demand analysis for infrastructure, data centers, cloud, or heavy industry.You build models in SQL or Python that others rely on, and you version them like it matters.You translate analysis into a one-page answer an executive can act on.You chase down data quality problems to the source instead of footnoting them.Bonus: Data center capacity planning. Power systems knowledge. BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Hex). Cloud capacity or fleet economics.

rows.title: Analyst - Pricing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Gap

Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.One of the most competitive Paid Time Off plans in the industry.*Employees can take up to five “on the clock” hours each month to volunteer at a charity of their choice.*Extensive 401(k) plan with company matching for contributions up to four percent of an employee’s base pay.*Employee stock purchase plan.*Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.*See more of the benefits we offer.For eligible employees

rows.title: Research Data Analyst I
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Job Function Summary

Involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting a wide variety of research data. Designs and conducts research including selecting data samples, developing research instruments, analyzing collected information according to established statistical methods, and developing recommendations based on research findings. Prepares reports, charts, tables, and other visual aids to interpret and communicate data and results.

Generic Scope

Entry-level professional with limited prior experience; learns to use professional concepts to resolve problems of limited scope and complexity; works on assignments that are initially routine in nature, requiring limited judgment and decision making. Employees at this level are expected to acquire the skills and knowledge to perform more advanced work following an agreed upon time in position, through defined training and development planning.

Custom Scope

Under direct supervision, acquires skills and knowledge of professional concepts in research data analysis. Works on small projects or segments of projects with limited scope and complexity.

Department Overview

The Department of Radiology & Biomedical Imaging is one of the largest departments within the School of Medicine, generating more than $40 million in professional fee revenues each year, and submitting grant proposals resulting in $30-40 million of awards each year. More than 90% of the MD faculty in Radiology is based at the Parnassus Campus, including nine of the ten clinical sections and their chiefs, and five of the seven vice chairs. The department has significant clinical and research operations at China Basin, Mission Bay, the VAMC, ZSFG, and Mount Zion. It includes more than 150 academic personnel and approximately 225 staff FTE. In addition, there are more than 90 resident, fellow, and graduate student trainees.

The Research Data Anl 1 position is focused on the collection of clinical data focused on patients treated with PSMA radioligand therapy and peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. A multicenter database is being created to collect data on these patients to understand toxicity, efficacy and see how these drugs are used clinically. The candidate will work under the general supervision and guidance from the supervisor Dr. Thomas Hope. They will also work with Dr. Abuzar Tuchayi Moradi.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.  Acquiring knowledge of research function. Acquiring ability to perform research analysis duties.  Acquiring statistical analysis, systems programming, and database design skills to perform research analysis duties.  Ability to effectively manage time and see assigned parts of projects through to completion on deadline.  Basic consultation and communication skills.  Attention to Details.

 Previous exposure to Medical Care.

rows.title: Landing Page SEO & AEO Strategist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Landing Page SEO & AEO Strategist

Our client is an AI technology company.

5x in office - San Francisco

The Role

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the intersection of Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, SEO, PPC, content, and growth.

You will help build our Agent Engine Optimization practice, enabling customers to increase their visibility across AI agents and emerging search experiences, with SEO serving as the technical and strategic foundation.

You will work directly with customers to understand their search strategy ( Paid & Organic ), use our platform to generate and launch landing pages at massive scale, and refine the output when the technology does not fully address a specific use case. You will optimize these pages for paid search as well as organic search rankings.

You should be strategic enough to advise customers, technical enough to learn and operate new tooling ( bonus points for adding features ), and practical enough to fill gaps manually when needed. This is not a software engineering role, but it is well suited to someone who is highly technical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with emerging AI products.

You will also help shape a new product and service offering, turning early customer needs into repeatable strategies, workflows, and product insights.

What You’ll Do

Develop strategies that improve how customers are discovered, understood, and surfaced by AI agents and emerging search platforms. Partner with customers to understand their SEO goals, target audiences, search intent, and landing page strategy. Advise customers on Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, technical SEO, and scalable landing page programs. Drive Landing Page strategy for PPC campaigns Use our platform to generate, refine, and launch high volumes of landing pages. Adapt AI-generated content for specific keywords, audiences, products, locations, and customer use cases. Build repeatable workflows that support the delivery of 30 or more landing pages per week. Apply strong editorial and SEO judgment to improve quality where automated output falls short. Identify emerging patterns in AI discovery and translate them into customer recommendations, delivery practices, and product insights. Identify recurring product gaps and translate customer feedback into actionable insights for the broader team. Help define the standards and best practices for a new category of AI-powered growth. 

What We’re Looking For

Strong experience in SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or a related field, including technical and programmatic SEO. A strong point of view on how AI agents are changing search, discovery, and customer acquisition. Experience creating or optimizing landing pages at scale. A clear understanding of search intent, keyword strategy, content quality, and conversion. Familiarity with Agent Engine Optimization, AI search, and emerging discovery behavior. Experience working directly with customers, clients, and external stakeholders. Comfort using AI tools, prompt-based workflows, and new software products. Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail. The ability to balance strategic thinking with fast, high-volume execution. The ability to bring structure to an emerging product area where the playbook is still being written. Comfort operating in an early-stage environment where products and processes are still evolving. Use Claude Code ( or similar ) 

Nice to Have

Experience in agency, consulting, professional services, or customer success. Familiarity with CRO, A/B testing, personalization, or paid search. Experience with ecommerce, SaaS, or digitally native businesses. Working knowledge of CMS platforms, analytics tools, HTML, or CSS. 

Why This Role

You will help define how we deliver a new AI-powered growth product, work directly with customers on high-impact problems, and influence how the platform evolves.

This is an opportunity to move beyond optimizing for traditional search engines and help define how companies compete for visibility in an AI-agent-driven world.

You will work directly with customers, influence how our platform evolves, and help establish the strategies and operating model for an emerging category.

These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world. Team Description:The Finance Team at Neuralink plays a pivotal role in fueling our mission to develop groundbreaking brain-machine interfaces that restore autonomy to individuals with unmet medical needs. We provide the financial insights and strategies that enable rapid innovation, efficient scaling, and sustainable growth in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment. If you are a dynamic finance leader passionate about blending strategic acumen with hands-on execution to drive technological breakthroughs, this team is for you.Job Description and Responsibilities:As the first Financial Analyst focused on Engineering in Neuralink's broader Finance organization, you will report directly to the Strategic Finance Lead and serve as a foundational team member in supporting and shaping Neuralink’s Strategic Finance function. Candidates for this role should be excited to partner closely with and support key stakeholders across Neuralink’s engineering teams, namely manufacturing and hardware development teams. Once on board, you will help manage and be responsible for owning the unit economics of the N1 implantable device, adjacent durable and surgical accessories as well as the R1 surgical robot. Strong candidates will demonstrate an aptitude for translating complex technical specs into rigorous costing models that give cross-functional visibility to Strategic Finance leadership and engineering stakeholders. Your work will directly drive commercialization of Neuralink’s product line and help arm the company to make ambitious capital investments and product roadmap decisions.The ideal candidate is dynamic, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity, with a proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that accelerate innovation.Key responsibilities include:Hardware Costing & Unit EconomicsBOM Management: Translate engineering changes and tolerances into real-time financial impacts on COGS and gross margins.
