Immediately vested.Flexible Paid Time-Off, Sick leave and Company HolidaysCompany Paid Two-weeks Winter BreakFlexible Hybrid Work ModelChef prepared Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner at Palo Alto officeMonthly breakfast, complimentary snacks and beverages at Newport News office

rows.title: Postdoctoral Experimental Physicists
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have openings for Postdoctoral Experimental Physicists to independently execute experiments and/or to develop instrumentation in support of the Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion (LMF) and OMEGA laser-matter research. You will plan, design, execute and oversee experiments in the fields of laser-plasma interactions, hydrodynamics, radiation transport, implosion physics, material strength and nuclear physics. These positions are in the High Energy Density (HED) Scientific & Technology (S&T) Program within the Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion (LMF) Principal Associate Directorate (PAD).

In this role, you will

Research, design and execute x-ray and laser driven experiments at LMF, at the OMEGA Laser Facility, and at the on-site Jupiter Laser Facility.Design, field, and coordinate optical, x-ray and nuclear diagnostics.Prepare and present technical and scientific reports, presentations, and publications for both internal and external audiences, including the DOE community and at conferences.Collaborate with scientists and researchers to achieve research objectives.Coordinate team resources and plan experimental campaigns.Pursue independent, complementary research interests and engage with a wide range of scientists both within and outside the laboratory.Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

PhD in plasma physics, hydrodynamics, shock physics, spectroscopy, condensed matter, nuclear physics, dynamic material science, or a related discipline.Experience in experimental physics in one or more of the following areas: laser-plasma interactions, hydrodynamics, radiation-driven hydrodynamics, radiation transport, condensed matter, nuclear physics, or high energy density experiments.Comprehensive analytical, experimental, and problem-solving skills.Experience with x-ray, optical, charged particle, or nuclear diagnostics, including their development, calibration, or fielding, and associated analysis techniques.Proficient written and verbal communication skills to author technical and scientific reports, publications, and invited papers, and deliver scientific presentations.Effective interpersonal skills necessary to collaborate and work in a team environment.Ability to perform independent research.

Qualifications We Desire

Experience with lasers, pulsed-power sources, high-density plasma interactions, and/or conducting high energy density experiments.

Pay Range

$118,594 - $131,174 Annually

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information

Position Information

This is a Postdoctoral appointment with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years. The postdoctoral appointment is a temporary, mentored training position intended for individuals in the early stages of their postdoctoral research careers. Consistent with the structure of the program, applicants must have received their Ph.D. (or equivalent doctorate) within five years of the anticipated start date.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!Flexible Benefits Package401(k)Relocation AssistanceEducation Reimbursement ProgramFlexible schedules (*depending on project needs)Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How To Identify Fake Job Advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

Universal Representation Modeling: Build high-precision, risk representation models leveraging massive heterogeneous data (video, live streams, audio, behavior sequences, and social graphs) to enable cross-scenario risk perception. The opportunity

Unity Vector builds an offline ML platform that powers insight, experimentation, attribution, and AI-driven decision-making across the company.

Our systems operate at scale across batch and streaming data, supporting analytics, product intelligence, machine learning pipelines, and business operations. As data volume and complexity grow, our platform enables large-scale model training, feature generation, and experimentation workflows that power production ML systems.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer,Intern to join our Offline Infrastructure team. This is an ideal role for people who is excited to work on large-scale systems and apply research-driven thinking to real-world machine learning problems.

About Turn/River

Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that applies a proprietary growth engineering strategy to investing, partnering with software businesses to accelerate growth and build enduring value. The firm’s team of equal parts investors and operators provides hands-on operational support and the flexible capital to systematically scale marketing, sales and customer success at its portfolio companies. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe.

About The Role

We are seeking an AI Engineer to build the AI and automation layer of our revenue operations—designing, building, and shipping intelligent workflows that make our sales, renewal, and retention motions faster, more predictable, and scalable. Ultimately, this role is helping the Customer and Sales organizations deliver more revenue sustainably.

This is a building role where you will embed with portfolio company revenue teams and bring a point of view on where AI can create the most leverage—spanning pipeline creation + advancement, forecasting, renewal automation, churn prediction, and more—then re-engineer those workflows using AI agents, LLM-powered tools, and automation frameworks. You will build working systems, put them into production, and iterate based on real performance data.

The ideal candidate is a structured thinker, a relentless builder, and a lifelong learner who thrives on bringing order to complexity. You should be equally comfortable writing a prompt chain as you are configuring a workflow inside of a CRM or revenue intelligence platform, and you should be energized by the challenge of turning a manual, repetitive process into something an AI agent handles autonomously.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent Design & Development: Design, build, and ship autonomous AI agents that execute revenue workflows end to end—including lead qualification, opportunity scoring, account health monitoring, renewal triggers, and win/loss analysis—with minimal human intervention. You will be the one writing the code.Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Turn/River’s sales, customer success, and finance leads, as well as the data team and portfolio companies, as a thought partner on how AI can accelerate revenue growth, retention, and renewal performance.Workflow Identification & Re-Engineering: Bring a systematic lens to revenue operations, identifying high-value automation opportunities across the full customer lifecycle. Decompose manual workflows—from pipeline creation to renewal processing—into agent-ready components: skills, tools, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.Portfolio Company Collaboration: On a project basis, partner directly with portfolio company revenue teams on specific initiatives—for example, building and testing AI-powered workflows that support a portfolio company’s sales productivity, renewal automation, or churn reduction programs.Pipeline & Forecast Analytics: Build AI-assisted reporting and forecasting frameworks that provide real-time visibility into pipeline health, deal velocity, and revenue risk. Surface insights that help sales and CS leadership identify gaps, prioritize accounts, and improve forecast accuracy.Renewal & Retention Automation: Design and deploy intelligent workflows that automate the renewal cycle—including proactive risk identification, renewal outreach sequencing, expansion opportunity detection, and churn propensity modeling—to protect and grow net revenue retention.Frontier AI Adoption: Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape—new models, agent frameworks, and revenue intelligence tooling—and rapidly prototype and deploy new capabilities to keep Turn/River’s revenue function at the cutting edge.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience building AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems in a production environment.Individual contributor by preference. You are accountable for building and shipping the work yourself rather than directing others who do — this role is measured in systems running in production, not specifications handed off.Real-world application of AI to improve revenue in a commercial business & extensive knowledge of primary AI platformsDeep familiarity with the B2B SaaS revenue tech stack: CRM platforms (Salesforce or equivalent), revenue intelligence tools, CPQ, and customer success platforms.Data-driven mindset with experience building pipeline dashboards, renewal forecasts, and retention analytics.Structured thinker who can break complex revenue processes into systems of components, root causes, and dependencies.Strong communicator who can distill technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively with sales and CS leaders.Hands-on, execution-oriented, and accountable for results—this is a building role, not an advisory one.Curious, experimental operator who continuously tests new approaches and technologies.

Location

San Francisco, hybrid work model

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $180,000 taking into account numerous variable factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience, training, licensure, certifications, and organizational requirements.

Benefits and Perks

An opportunity to make an impact across multiple high-growth tech firmsCompetitive salary and discretionary bonusMedical, dental, and vision insurance covered 100% for employee & dependentsFlexible vacation policy401K matchingPaid parental leaveCommuter benefitsHealth and Wellness benefitsHousehold Services benefitsHome Office benefitsAnnual Home Office Equipment ReimbursementDonation matchingWork from home Monday & FridayEnergetic work environment with snacks and weekly team lunches 3x per week, centrally located near multiple public transit linesA company that enjoys having fun: holiday parties, annual company offsite and retreat, annual summer "work from anywhere" month

rows.title: Robotics Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Aurelius Systems is a VC backed defense tech startup building autonomous, edge deployed directed energy systems for counter-UAS. We build laser weapons to shoot down drones.

We're a small team of engineers, former US military operators, and subject matter experts scaling America's directed energy dominance. The first cost effective, reliable and robust laser weapon system.

Our namesake isn't an accident. Marcus Aurelius wrote about doing the work in front of you, every day, without excuses. Henry Ford didn't wait for permission to reinvent manufacturing. That's how we operate, small team, unreasonable output, no hiding behind the unachievable.

In addition to our San Francisco lab, we opened our Detroit manufacturing hub and field test weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

The Role And Your Impact

We need a Robotics Software Engineer who writes fast, correct C++ that runs on real hardware. You’ll work on the Archimedes stack alongside our Lead Software Engineer, taking raw sensor data and turning it into tracking, control and autonomy that has to work in real time. Performance and accuracy matter more than anything. Your scope grows as fast as you do; our Lead went from Founding Robotics Engineer to Lead in 12 months.

What You’ll Own

 Production C++ across the stack: sensor ingestion, tracking, control and autonomy  Working directly with drivers and raw sensor data, not pre-packaged inputs  Threading, process architecture and performance on the paths you own  Timing and latency analysis, and making the fixes it points to  Python tooling for testing, analysis and the range  Debugging on hardware at weekly field tests 

What We’re Looking For

2+ years writing production C++ that runs on real hardware or real-time systems  Comfort below the abstraction layer: threading, concurrency, memory, performance profiling  You implement, not just design. You’ve shipped code you wrote  Evidence you learn fast: you got effective in a new domain in months, not years 

 Where you probably come from:  We’re domain agnostic. Robotics, AV, drones, aerospace, F1 or automotive, maritime, embedded systems, compilers, or low-level C++ game engine and 3D simulation work all fit. A robotics degree isn’t required; the robotics is learnable on the job.

 We want to talk if:  You’ve written C++ where latency or timing actually mattered and you measured it. Bonus if your projects touch motion planning, dynamics, trajectory optimization, or state estimation.

 Not a fit if:  You’re web, backend or full stack; your C++ is light and your real work is in Python; you’ve never had a full-time role; or you design systems but don’t implement them.

Nice To Haves

 ROS2 (a good signal, though we've moved past it) Rust or other systems languages  Sensor integration and calibration  Real-time Linux 

 Education:  BS, MS or PhD in CS, EE, Robotics or equivalent. Track record matters more than degree.

How You Operate

 Extreme bias for action. You'd rather build a prototype tomorrow than model it for a month  You characterize your own systems before the field does  Comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a startup environment  You debug from first principles, not intuition alone  Clear communicator across mechanical, electrical, optical, and software teams  Self directed. You identify what needs to happen next and do it without being told 

Why Join Aurelius Systems

 Build more in 1 month than most engineers build in 1 year. We field test weekly. Your work goes downrange, not into a filing cabinet.  Career velocity is real. With no middle management, there are no layers between you and impact.  Work on a problem that actually matters. Small cheap drones are changing warfare. Our laser systems are the asymmetric answer — infinite magazine, near zero cost per shot, scalable to every base, border, facility, and truck.  Join the densest defense startup ecosystem in the country. California is where the next generation of defense companies are being built. 

How We Work

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 6. When we're sprinting toward a demo or field test, the team ramps up — nights, weekends, whatever it takes to ship. When the sprint lands, we ramp down. We don't manufacture intensity for show. If you've worked at SpaceX, against a mission-critical timeline, or on a racing team, you already know the rhythm.

Benefits

 Competitive salary and equity  United Health Care medical, dental, and vision coverage  Flexible 18 days PTO plus 5 sick days  Travel to field test events and range days  Covered daily lunches and office snacks and drinks  E-bike and scooter stipend up to $500 Direct access to leadership and real ownership over your work 

Export Control Notice

As defined by U.S. law, individuals who are any one of the following are considered to be a U.S. Person: (1) U.S. citizens, (2) legal permanent residents (a.k.a. green card holders), and (3) certain protected classes of asylees and refugees, as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Model Integrations
rows.descriptionText:
About Nunchux AI

Nunchux AI builds infrastructure that makes multimodal generative AI faster and cheaper to serve, and easier to build on. Founded by MIT PhDs Muyang Li, Yujun Lin, and Zhekai Zhang with CMU Professor Jun-Yan Zhu, Nunchux brings together deep research expertise and production systems experience. Our work is built on nearly a decade of research from MIT and CMU, including nunchaku project, whose models have surpassed 4 million downloads. We have top VC backing, and we build for enterprises and for millions of developers.

The Role

Help Nunchux bring new image and video models to Modelverse as soon as they become available. Your focus is speed to launch: get the model running, connect it to the platform, and ship a working first version.

You will own the initial integration and the Day 1 release, working with the cloud team on deployment and with the product engineers on the API and Modelverse integration. After launch, you will hand off the further work on performance, cost, and model quality to the relevant teams. Between launches, you will maintain and extend our shared code for model integration and serving.

What You’ll Do

Prototype new models: Get new image and video models running quickly with the available code and weights. Run test examples and identify what each model needs for launch. Ship the first version: Coordinate the deployment with the cloud team, and the API and Modelverse integration with the product engineers. Get the basic parameters, examples, and developer instructions ready for Day 1. rows.title: AI Trainer - Coding
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Our client is looking for experienced software engineers to evaluate how AI coding agents handle real engineering work inside realistic codebases: implementing a change to spec, fixing a bug with a regression test, refactoring without breaking behavior, reviewing a pull request, debugging from a trace. Coding agents are strong in many ways and frustratingly bad in others: they miss edge cases, make brittle changes, and need close supervision from an experienced engineer. You bring the judgment you have built over a career shipping production systems. We bring the agent output that judgment is needed to grade.

In this role, you will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own practice, such as a bug fix with a regression test, a feature implemented to spec with tests, a refactor with behavior preserved, a pull request review, a debugging write-up from logs and traces, or an API contract with examples, run them through frontier AI agents, and evaluate what comes back against a professional standard.

You will work with realistic professional files, the kind a practitioner in your field actually handles, which you assemble yourself. Some tasks are compact, built around a handful of files; others are larger scenarios that take several days to build. In every case the goal is the same: a task a competent professional in your field would complete correctly and a frontier model currently gets wrong.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will be helping build better AI by putting your knowledge to work in a structured, flexible, fully remote environment. The work is long-form and self-directed, and clear written reasoning matters as much as technical depth.

Responsibilities

Design challenging, realistic software engineering tasks drawn from your own day-to-day work: the scenario, a spec phrased the way you would brief a trusted teammate, and the codebase or supporting files an engineer would need (repositories you construct or adapt, tests, logs, API contracts, design notes), which you author yourself.

Run those tasks through AI coding agents and evaluate the deliverable they produce (the diff, the tests, the design, the review) against the standard you would hold a teammate to.

Compare two agent outputs on identical specs and codebases, decide which performed better, and document where each fell short.

Write tests, rubrics, and success criteria that specify what a correct deliverable must contain (the right behavior preserved, the right edge cases handled, the right tests added, the right conventions followed), and explain in writing why a submission passes or fails each one.

Flag concrete failures with evidence: brittle changes, missed edge cases, tests that pass for the wrong reason, thrashing in the trace, fabricated or ignored files, and off-spec interpretation of the ask.

Contribute across your stack and adjacent ones, and review and refine tasks built by other engineers.

Qualifications

2+ years of professional software engineering experience preferred, shipping and maintaining production code as part of a team.

In progress Bachelor’s degree or higher.

Expertise in at least one common stack: TypeScript or JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, or Kotlin. Specialists are welcome: a strong frontend-only, backend-only, or mobile engineer is a good referral.

Comfortable in a terminal with git, tests, and a debugger; able to read an unfamiliar codebase and orient quickly. Docker and CI experience is a plus.

Strong judgment about what good code and a real model failure look like, and the ability to explain both in writing.

No prior AI or machine learning experience is required. Engineering judgment and attention to detail matter most.

Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities

 Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support  Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures  Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained  Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation  Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization  Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate  Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic  Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles  Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage  Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant  Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams  Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary  Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets  Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone  Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components  Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data 

Job Qualifications & Experience

 Minimum Qualifications 

 2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role  Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience  Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis  Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued  Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources  Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping  Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work  Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls  Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence  Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance 

Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As

 Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)  Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)  Tableau Certified Data Analyst  Tableau Desktop Specialist certification  Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools  Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data  Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation  Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases  Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts  Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift  Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices  Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview  Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods 

The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

rows.descriptionText:
Bayside Health

Bayside Health is a public health service delivering high-quality care across every stage of life for close to 1.2 million people living in metropolitan Melbourne, the Mornington Peninsula, Koo Wee Rup, Bass Coast and Southern Gippsland. We have more than 15 main sites, including hospitals, centres and clinics that provide comprehensive care from welcoming newborns to supporting older people and a full range of services in between. More than 22,000 dedicated staff are focused on providing exceptional, equitable, and locally connected care through shared expertise, compassion, and a commitment to continuous growth. Education and training are central to staff development as we encourage all employees to strive and thrive. Bayside Health was formed following the merger of Alfred Health, Bass Coast Health, Gippsland Southern Health Service, Kooweerup Regional Health Service and Peninsula Health on 1 January 2026.

Fixed-Term, Full-Time (Ending Sept 2027)Managers and Administrative Workers Grade 3Great Staff Benefits

About Us

The Alfred Hospital’s Department of Infectious Diseases is one of Australia’s largest and most advanced centres for infectious disease care, research and education. It provides specialist expertise across general infections, HIV, hospital‑acquired infections, antimicrobial resistance, travel medicine, viral hepatitis, STIs and infections in immunocompromised patients. Clinical services include dedicated units for general infectious diseases, HIV care, consultative support and immunocompromised hosts, alongside a leading training program.

A flagship component is the Victorian State‑wide HIV Service, offering comprehensive multidisciplinary care for people living with HIV, including management of complications and co‑morbidities. The Department sits within the Alfred Medical Research Precinct and, through Monash Partners, is recognised as an NHMRC Academic Health Science Centre.

About The Role

This is an entry-level position and an opportunity to build epidemiology and applied statistics skills while taking responsibility for the routine, recurring data work that underpins the Department’s research and clinical activity. Working within the EDMS team and alongside the research stream, the Research Data and Analytics Officer will help maintain clinical research databases, deliver regular data submissions, extracts and reports reliably and on time, and carry out applied statistical analysis on clinical and epidemiological datasets under the supervision of the team’s analysts. With support from the Data Analysts and the Manager EDMS, you will develop your analytical capability in R, contribute to research outputs and publications, and grow towards more advanced methods and independent analytical work over time. You will also support the Victorian HIV Service and other Departmental programs on quality projects that integrate data with clinical care.

About You

Bachelor’s degree (or working towards one) in Statistics, Data Science, Biomedical Science, Public Health, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experienceWorking ability in a statistical language (preferably R) and sound general data literacy, with confidence handling data carefully and accuratelyA grounding in statistical methods and a genuine interest in applying them to epidemiological and clinical data, with willingness to learn new tools and techniques on the jobDemonstrated reliability in delivering routine, recurring tasks accurately and to deadline Experience with REDCap, and/or exposure to regression, survival analysis or other applied statistical methodsExperience contributing to a publication or manuscript submissionExposure to scripting or data workflow tools, for example SQL, Power Automate or Power BIPostgraduate coursework or a Diploma in Biostatistics, Data Science or Public Health

If applicable, specify specific requirements that you require in the cover letter or CV.

Any queries please contact Brian Price, Clinical Service Director Alfred Infectious Diseases on B.Price@alfred.org.au

Applications close at 11:00pm AEDT Tuesday, 27 October 2026. 

We embrace diversity and strive to have a workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, and people of all genders, sexualities, and cultural backgrounds.

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application materials, please don’t hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

New York State Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is the State’s affordable housing agency, with a mission to build, preserve, and protect affordable housing and increase homeownership throughout New York State.
This position is with HCR's Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC). This is not a civil service position and does not require a civil service exam. Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications outlined below to be considered. 
NYS Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility. Our work would not be possible without the diverse backgrounds, experiences, ideas, and abilities of our employees. HCR is committed to developing a workforce that represents the diverse population of New York State. HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.
Resilient Homes and Communities (RHC) now serves as the lead principal office responsible for the administration of New York State’s multiple CDBG-DR awards. RHC operates within the New York State Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC) and the Homeownership and Community Development (HOCD) unit, which consists of the State of New York Mortgage Agency, the Affordable Housing Corporation, the Office of Community Renewal, the Office of Special Initiatives and RHC.
Position Summary
The Data Analyst will play a key supporting role analyzing, visualizing and reporting data for the Office of Resilient Homes and Communities. This position combines data science, spatial data analysis (GIS) with business and policy research to support reporting, decision-making, and program quality across the agency. Reporting to the Director of Research and Data, the Data Analyst will assist in maintaining spatial and quantitative databases, updating the federal Disaster Recovery Grants Reporting (DRGR) system, and producing maps, dashboards, and reports. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain hands-on experience in disaster recovery policy, data integrity, and public sector data analysis.
Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 Data & Reporting Support: Assist in the development, update, and maintenance of performance management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc data analyses to support program operations.
 GIS & Spatial Analysis: Support program teams by maintaining Esri ArcGIS software/ArcGIS Online platforms, performing basic spatial analyses, and creating maps and graphs for internal and external stakeholders.
 System Maintenance: Help input, track, and verify service areas and program data within New York State’s internal systems and the federal Disaster Recovery Grant Reporting (DRGR) system to ensure accuracy across program records.
 Data Quality & Documentation: Assist in documenting data methodologies, maintaining Standards of Procedure (SOPs) for federal reporting, and performing routine data cleaning and quality control.
 Research Assistance: Provide analytical and research support for ongoing projects evaluating the impact of RHC programs on New York State residents.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal program teams and external partners to share, transfer, and package data for reporting and research needs.

Qualifications:

 Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field*
 Knowledge of public policy in areas such as disaster recovery, infrastructure, housing, economic development, and/or resiliency is preferred.
 Experience distilling quantitative and qualitative policy analysis into written descriptions such as briefs, memos, etc.
 2 years professional experience in an analytic role*
 Demonstrated experience using Esri ArcGIS 10.x, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, Model Builder, R and basic python programming. 
 Excellent oral, written, and quantitative skills.
 Exceptional problem-solving abilities. 
 Exceptional ability to use data to make decisions. 
 Expertise in the use of Microsoft Office products, specifically Excel and Access.
 Ability to work in a flexible, fast paced, mission driven environment.

*Substitutions: four years of specialized experience or associate’s degree and two years of specialized experience may substitute for bachelor’s degree; J.D. or master’s degree may substitute for one year of specialized experience; Ph.D. may substitute for two years of specialized experience.
This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.
APPLICANTS MUST INCLUDE A RESUME
WHAT WE OFFER AT NYS HCR: 

 Extensive benefits package including participation in New York State’s Health Insurance Program and New York State & Local Employees’ Retirement System.
 Promotional opportunities for dedicated professionals.
 Work-life balance benefits including a 37.5-hour work week, opportunity for compressed scheduling, and paid time off benefits (vacation, sick, personal days, and federal holidays).
 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave.
 Paid Family Leave.
 As a New York State employee, you may qualify to participate in the Federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF). The PSLF Program forgives the remaining balance on your Direct Loans after you have made 120 qualifying monthly payments under an accepted repayment plan and while working full-time for an eligible employer. 

ABOUT NEW YORK STATE HOMES AND COMMUNITY RENEWAL:
Under the leadership of Governor Kathy Hochul and Commissioner RuthAnne Visnauskas, HCR is a vibrant, innovative agency that integrates and leverages New York State’s housing resources. We have offices in New York City, Albany, Buffalo, and Syracuse, and employ a diverse workforce of professionals who are hard-working and committed to serving low- and moderate-income families. Our mission is far-reaching, encompassing single and multifamily housing finance, home improvement, rent regulation, housing subsidies, and community development. We partner regularly with a variety of public and private stakeholders.
Achieving this mission requires a wide range of skills and backgrounds in public policy, administration, real estate, construction, finance, law, and many other areas of expertise. We seek to provide a workplace environment that is productive, flexible, accountable, ethical, and caring. Our employees are empowered to make a difference where they live and work. We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including paid leave, health, dental, vision, retirement, and family-friendly policies. 
New York State is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE)

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities

 Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support  Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures  Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained  Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation  Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization  Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate  Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic  Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles  Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage  Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant  Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams  Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary  Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets  Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone  Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components  Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data 

Job Qualifications & Experience

 Minimum Qualifications 

 2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role  Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience  Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis  Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued  Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources  Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping  Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work  Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls  Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence  Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance 

Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As

 Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)  Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)  Tableau Certified Data Analyst  Tableau Desktop Specialist certification  Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools  Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data  Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation  Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases  Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts  Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift  Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices  Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview  Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods 

The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY
 Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. 

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This is a hands-on analytics role. You will work across the full subscription lifecycle — how subscribers are acquired and retained, and what they actually do once they subscribe. Engagement and content consumption, marketing and activation, user journeys, churn and cohort behavior all sit within your scope. The common thread is SQL: we are looking for someone who can get to any subscription dataset, understand what it does and does not say, and turn it into an answer a business partner can use.

Because the role is scoped broadly rather than by function, it can flex as the portfolio grows. You may work across products alongside a marketing-focused counterpart, or take end-to-end analytics ownership of a single business unit depending on where the business needs depth. You will work closely with key operational stakeholders to understand how to best interpret data shifts day to day and identify trends to inform the business.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

Subscriber & Engagement Reporting

Build and own engagement reporting for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, title and category performance, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, and third-party platformsAnalyze subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), cancellations, and plan mix and their impact on engagementConnect engagement to retention, identifying the early-tenure behaviors that separate subscribers who stay from those who churn, and translating that into onboarding, content, and lifecycle recommendationsBuild and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription and engagement metrics, in partnership with Data EngineeringMaintain and evolve recurring performance comparisons (month-over-month, cohort-over-cohort, pre- and post-launch), proactively flagging anomalies such as app issues, tracking gaps, and data quality problems before they distort reportingProvide guidance to finance on cost as it relates to engagement of programming and inform future content strategies and acquisitions

Hands-On Data & Query Work

Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, engagement, campaign, and behavioral data — joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large and imperfect sourcesConduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, tenure, platform, and content affinityTroubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms and internal tracking (naming mismatches, missing records, deduplication logic) and resolve them at the query levelSupport the transition from manual, on-demand reporting to self-service dashboards in partnership with Data Engineering

Marketing, Lifecycle & Campaign Measurement

Analyze campaign performance across marketing and CRM channels — email, push, in-app, SMS, and paid media — and connect activity to downstream subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retentionSupport attribution analysis (e.g., first-touch) to measure the impact of campaigns on subscription conversion and migration effortsConduct segmentation analysis to surface engagement trends, at-risk segments, and personalization opportunitiesSupport experimentation and test design, helping isolate confounding variables (for example content quality versus message format, or seasonality versus offer effect) so results are interpretable

Cross-Functional Partnership

Translate analysis into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for Programming, Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, and Finance stakeholders, tailoring the narrative to each audienceRespond to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders with quick turnaround, clear caveats, and accurate dataFlag data quality issues and tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners, and follow through to resolution

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write and troubleshoot queries involving joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large datasets. This is a must-have and the core of the roleExperience in subscription, growth, product, marketing, or media analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting roleGenuine curiosity about the whole subscriber picture — comfort moving between a churn cohort, a content engagement question, and a campaign performance read in the same weekExperience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention, LTV)Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or similar)Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tablesGood communication skills — able to explain data findings, and their limitations, clearly to non-technical stakeholdersDetail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadershipComfortable working in a fast-paced environment with recurring deadlines and frequent ad hoc requestsExperience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or CursorFamiliarity with product analytics or engagement measurement tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude) a plusFamiliarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plusExposure to a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze a plusPrior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plusBachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience

The Experience You’ll Bring

rows.title: Marketing Analyst, Paid Social
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst to join Etsy’s Demand Generation team! In this entry-level role, you'll support the execution and optimization of mid and upper-funnel paid social campaigns, ensuring we show the right inventory to the right shoppers at the right time. You’ll learn how to navigate different types of creative, paid media platforms, and performance data to support campaign builds, QA, reporting, and ongoing optimization.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position reporting to the Performance Media Manager, Paid Social & Display on the Performance Social & Display Marketing team. I

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Within Brand Marketing, the Performance Social & Display team focuses on measurable, full-funnel growth through channels like Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, and more. We fuel Etsy's growth via audience-centric storytelling and media placements. We collaborate closely with partner teams such as Analytics, Product, and Engineering in order to automate and optimize global offsite experiences and programs at scale. As a team, we value data-driven decision making, experimentation, operational excellence, and cross-functional partnership.

What does the day-to-day look like?

In this role, you'll support the day-to-day management of the mid and upper funnel portion of the paid social platforms that power Etsy's advertising. You will partner with senior channel owners to learn the ropes of large-scale campaign management, marketing technology, and attribution frameworks while ensuring our daily operations run at peak efficiency.

In This Role You Will

Support campaign builds and QAAssist with building, launching, and QA-ing campaigns across paid social platforms (for example: creative trafficking, catalog updates, audience implementation, and pixel/tag checks).Help ensure ads follow Etsy’s naming conventions, UTM standards, and creative/spec guidelines before launch.Help maintain and optimize product feedsSupport day-to-day management of large-scale campaignsFlag creative or catalog issues (missing images, disapprovals, mismatched categories) and partner with more senior teammates and XFN partners on fixes.Monitor pacing and performanceCheck platform dashboards and internal trackers to monitor budget pacing, delivery, and key performance metrics.Surface anomalies (performance spikes/drops, delivery issues, broken links, tracking problems) quickly and assist in root-causing and correcting them.Contribute to optimizationsResearch and propose bid and budget adjustments to help ensure campaigns hit efficiency and volume targets.Assist in creating and updating audience structures, exclusions, and blocklists.Support testing and experimentationHelp set up and track creative and audience tests.Maintain test logs and help compile simple summaries of results for the broader team.Assist with reporting and communicationPull recurring performance exports from platforms and support creation of simple views or dashboards for weekly readouts.Help compile slides or notes for internal updates, post-mortems, and leadership-facing report-outs.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you succeed in this role are:

Experience & skills0–2 years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, analytics, or a related field; internships, co-ops, or project experience are welcome.Basic familiarity with paid social and/or display platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, or similar), whether from coursework, certifications, or hands-on experience.Comfort working with data in tools like Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or a BI tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau) is a plus, but not required.Strong quantitative skills and excitement about learning how to interpret performance data (e.g., ROAS, CPA/CAC, CTR, CVR, LTV).A curious, problem-solving attitude!
Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

 Geo-1: 80,000.00 - 108,000.00 USD Annual Geo-2: 72,000.00 - 98,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

The Role

As a Junior SEO Audience Growth Associate, you will support the Search Audience Senior Manager in driving search traffic growth for Sotheby’s Luxury Division. You’ll assist in optimizing SEO strategies, creating and refining SEO-focused content, and analyzing performance data to help attract and engage qualified buyers and sellers across key luxury categories. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a renowned brand while further developing your skills in SEO, copywriting, and data-driven marketing.

Responsibilities

Assist in keyword position tracking and analysis for luxury categories such as jewelry, watches, fashion, wine & spirits, sports, books, and science & pop culture using tools like SEMrush.Support the development and maintenance of SEO performance dashboards in Adobe Analytics to provide insights into content performance.Help implement SEO strategies to improve search rankings and organic traffic for luxury division landing pages.Collaborate with the content marketing team to create, update, and optimize SEO-driven content aligned with category goals and target keywords.Write and refine engaging, keyword-optimized copy for evergreen content, leveraging AI tools and existing resources.Conduct competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities within the luxury market.Support in preparing monthly performance updates and strategic priorities for internal stakeholders.Stay informed about SEO best practices and trends, particularly in the luxury goods and e-commerce space.

You’ll Be Successful If

You have 1-2 years of experience in copywriting, SEO copywriting, or a related role.You have a passion for the luxury industry and an understanding of its dynamics and trends.You are data-driven, detail-oriented, and skilled at translating analytics into actionable insights.You are an effective communicator with strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are proactive, adaptable, and collaborative.

Ideal Experience & Competencies

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Google Analytics, or Adobe Analytics.Proven ability to write compelling, optimized content for digital platforms.Basic knowledge of content management systems (CMS) and a willingness to deepen your expertise.Familiarity with AI-driven content tools and their applications in SEO.A proactive approach to problem-solving and an eagerness to learn and grow in the SEO space.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $60,000—$67,000. rows.title: Intern, Marketplace Insights & Consumer Foresight
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The Marketplace Insights Intern will assist in researching market, consumer, and macroeconomic data to create insights for Constellation Brands. This internship provides exposure to both Marketplace Insights (what’s happening now) and Consumer Foresight (what’s likely to happen in the future). The ideal candidate is curious about sales performance and consumer behavior, enjoys solving business problems with data, and is excited to learn how insights can drive business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Market & Industry Analysis: Analyze sales performance data of the category and our brands to identify key trends and explain business results for Constellation Brands.Consumer Behavior Research: Explore emerging consumer behaviors, attitudes, and shopping trends across demographic groups to develop insights that uncover future growth opportunities. Strategic Insights Project: Lead a project that turns data into insights and drives strategic, actionable recommendations. Investigate a business question, conduct data-driven macroeconomic, market, and consumer research, and deliver an engaging presentation to leadership. 

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field. Strong interest in market research, economics, analytics, strategy, or business development. Curious and growth-mindset; self-starter with a desire to learn about the industry, ask questions, and contribute your perspective. Excellent analytical and quantitative skills; ability to interpret data from multiple sources and develop holistic business insights. Exceptional team collaboration and communication skills; comfortable presenting findings. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. High level of integrity and commitment to maintaining confidentiality.

rows.title: Marketing Analyst, Paid Social
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the role?

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst to join Etsy’s Demand Generation team! In this entry-level role, you'll support the execution and optimization of mid and upper-funnel paid social campaigns, ensuring we show the right inventory to the right shoppers at the right time. You’ll learn how to navigate different types of creative, paid media platforms, and performance data to support campaign builds, QA, reporting, and ongoing optimization.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position reporting to the Performance Media Manager, Paid Social & Display on the Performance Social & Display Marketing team. I

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Within Brand Marketing, the Performance Social & Display team focuses on measurable, full-funnel growth through channels like Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, and more. We fuel Etsy's growth via audience-centric storytelling and media placements. We collaborate closely with partner teams such as Analytics, Product, and Engineering in order to automate and optimize global offsite experiences and programs at scale. As a team, we value data-driven decision making, experimentation, operational excellence, and cross-functional partnership.

What does the day-to-day look like?

In this role, you'll support the day-to-day management of the mid and upper funnel portion of the paid social platforms that power Etsy's advertising. You will partner with senior channel owners to learn the ropes of large-scale campaign management, marketing technology, and attribution frameworks while ensuring our daily operations run at peak efficiency.

In This Role You Will

Support campaign builds and QAAssist with building, launching, and QA-ing campaigns across paid social platforms (for example: creative trafficking, catalog updates, audience implementation, and pixel/tag checks).Help ensure ads follow Etsy’s naming conventions, UTM standards, and creative/spec guidelines before launch.Help maintain and optimize product feedsSupport day-to-day management of large-scale campaignsFlag creative or catalog issues (missing images, disapprovals, mismatched categories) and partner with more senior teammates and XFN partners on fixes.Monitor pacing and performanceCheck platform dashboards and internal trackers to monitor budget pacing, delivery, and key performance metrics.Surface anomalies (performance spikes/drops, delivery issues, broken links, tracking problems) quickly and assist in root-causing and correcting them.Contribute to optimizationsResearch and propose bid and budget adjustments to help ensure campaigns hit efficiency and volume targets.Assist in creating and updating audience structures, exclusions, and blocklists.Support testing and experimentationHelp set up and track creative and audience tests.Maintain test logs and help compile simple summaries of results for the broader team.Assist with reporting and communicationPull recurring performance exports from platforms and support creation of simple views or dashboards for weekly readouts.Help compile slides or notes for internal updates, post-mortems, and leadership-facing report-outs.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you succeed in this role are:

Experience & skills0–2 years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, analytics, or a related field; internships, co-ops, or project experience are welcome.Basic familiarity with paid social and/or display platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, or similar), whether from coursework, certifications, or hands-on experience.Comfort working with data in tools like Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or a BI tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau) is a plus, but not required.Strong quantitative skills and excitement about learning how to interpret performance data (e.g., ROAS, CPA/CAC, CTR, CVR, LTV).A curious, problem-solving attitude!
Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

 Geo-1: 80,000.00 - 108,000.00 USD Annual Geo-2: 72,000.00 - 98,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**.
