parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Business Overview:
Neuberger is an employee-owned global investment management firm with $613 billion in assets under management. The private equity group of the firm, Neuberger Private Markets, is a leading and growing investor in private markets, managing over $170 billion of client commitments since inception. The Private Investment Portfolios and Co-Investment (“PIPCO”) platform within Neuberger Private Markets oversees all commingled funds and custom portfolios consisting of a combination of primaries, co-investments, and/or secondaries, as well as primary-only and co-investment-only programs. The diverse suite of products includes a variety of strategies, ranging from highly diversified portfolios to those focused on a particular asset class (i.e., buyout, venture, and/or infrastructure), certain geographies, emerging managers, impact investments, or other customizations as requested by clients.
The PIPCO Marketing/Fundraising Group within Neuberger Private Markets is focused on developing and implementing the fundraising strategy for the overall PIPCO platform and individual fund offerings. The group plays a key role across the full lifecycle of the PIPCO funds—including commingled vehicles and custom mandates—from formation to fundraising to managing communications with existing investors.
Position Overview: 
The team is seeking a junior team member (Analyst level) dedicated to the PIPCO team to help manage non-investment activities for the platform. The individual will work closely with the investment, marketing, sales, legal, finance and operations teams to meet the needs of existing and prospective investors.
The individual will have a wide scope of responsibilities as outlined below and will begin as a generalist, working across the entire suite of PIPCO products, with the opportunity to specialize as their career progresses.
Primary Responsibilities:
Assist in managing fundraising processes:Work as a generalist, supporting product specialists within the PIPCO Marketing/ Fundraising GroupManage capital formation activities, such as drafting legal documents, launching datarooms and creating marketing materialsLiaise with portfolio managers and sales force, legal, finance, and operations teams to deliver materials and respond to requests for proposals (“RfPs”), manage prospect follow-ups, as well as answer ad-hoc client/prospect inquiriesTrack fundraising pipeline and activity across distribution channelsUpdate fund marketing materials and other ongoing prospect communicationsProvide sales with tools that they need, such as content, customized materials and product educationWork closely with investment teams to provide communication and updates internally and externally during fundraising processesPerform quantitative analyses and research, including management of various data files used by the broader private markets marketing teamsServe as a resource for the broader Neuberger sales teams for PIPCO-related mattersHandle logistics related to fund closes including coordination with sales, legal, subscription and clientsOrganize and coordinate onsite meetings for clientsMaintain up-to-date product information across various third-party databases used by the team
Manage internal PIPCO platform data:Track and maintain underlying LP information, such as commitment amounts and program statusTrack investment activity, deal flow and performance across individual strategies and aggregate platform
Help manage public exposure for platform through our annual meeting, industry conferences, databases and seminars
Experience & Skills Qualifications:
Undergraduate degree from top tier institution, with excellent academic credentials1-2 years of relevant professional experience (ideally Private Markets or Investment Banking focused)Must exhibit a “team-player” attitude and a desire to work on a wide range of projects and manage them effectivelyStrong organizational skills and ability to multi-taskRemarkable attention to detailStrong judgment, maturity and critical thinking skillsExcellent communication, ability to articulate and present ideas effectively both orally and in written formInitiative and creativity in approach to problem solving and to be resourcefulExhibits strong dedication to the job and takes ownership of deliverablesAbility to move quickly up the learning curveSignificant experience in Excel and PowerPoint preferred
Applicants must be authorized and have the right to work in the country where the role is located without the need for current or future sponsorship.
Compensation Details
The salary range for this role is $100,000-$120,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in the job posting location. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, business sector, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, market benchmarking data, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. This job is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, which, along with base salary and retirement contributions, is part of our total comprehensive package. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, retirement, life insurance and other benefits to eligible employees.
Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, production, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
Neuberger is an equal opportunity employer. The Firm and its affiliates do not discriminate in employment because of race, creed, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship status or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. rows.title: Representative, Marketing & Communications
rows.descriptionText:
The Impact You'll Make

Now is a great time to join our dynamic Marketing and Communications team at Danfoss, a global leader in engineering solutions that help the world use resources in smarter ways. We believe innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, perspectives, and experiences.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Analyst, Product Marketing profile to support marketing and communications initiatives for the Data Center business unit. In this role, you will help drive both proactive and reactive communications, ensuring that technical information is translated into clear, accurate, and compelling content for internal and external audiences.

You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and Customer Service to support product launches, customer communications, technical content creation, trade show preparation, and other strategic marketing activities. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with technical subject matter experts, creating high-quality content, and managing multiple projects with exceptional attention to detail. This position focuses on developing a strong understanding of assigned brands, communicating product information accurately, and helping prospective customers evaluate available offerings. 
The Brand Specialist will participate in scheduled promotional programs, provide product education, and support sales by assisting customers with purchasing decisions. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to brand presentation, and the ability to deliver consistent product information across different customer-facing settings. 

Key Responsibilities 


• Develop detailed knowledge of assigned brands, product categories, and service offerings.
• Represent featured brands during scheduled in-person promotional activities.
• Communicate product specifications, features, and practical benefits to prospective customers.
• Explain differences between available product models, service options, and packages.
• Deliver accurate product presentations tailored to customer interests and needs.
• Conduct product demonstrations and provide usage guidance when applicable.
• Educate customers about new product introductions and updated offerings.
• Explain current promotions, pricing information, and applicable purchasing terms.

• Gather general customer feedback regarding product features, preferences, and purchasing considerations.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or 1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, brand representation, customer engagement, or a related field.
• Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to learn detailed product information and explain it accurately.
• Comfortable conducting product presentations and demonstrations.
• Strong listening skills and ability to understand customer preferences.
• Professional and confident approach to customer interactions.
• Ability to communicate product benefits without making unsupported claims.
• Comfortable discussing pricing, promotions, and purchasing options.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate information.
• Ability to adapt communication to different customers and product categories.
• Organized and dependable when completing assigned responsibilities.
• Comfortable working in active, customer-facing promotional environments.

Benefits

• Supportive and collaborative team environment.

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst to join Etsy’s Demand Generation team! In this entry-level role, you'll support the execution and optimization of mid and upper-funnel paid social campaigns, ensuring we show the right inventory to the right shoppers at the right time. You’ll learn how to navigate different types of creative, paid media platforms, and performance data to support campaign builds, QA, reporting, and ongoing optimization.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position reporting to the Performance Media Manager, Paid Social & Display on the Performance Social & Display Marketing team. I

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Within Brand Marketing, the Performance Social & Display team focuses on measurable, full-funnel growth through channels like Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, and more. We fuel Etsy's growth via audience-centric storytelling and media placements. We collaborate closely with partner teams such as Analytics, Product, and Engineering in order to automate and optimize global offsite experiences and programs at scale. As a team, we value data-driven decision making, experimentation, operational excellence, and cross-functional partnership.

What does the day-to-day look like?

In this role, you'll support the day-to-day management of the mid and upper funnel portion of the paid social platforms that power Etsy's advertising. You will partner with senior channel owners to learn the ropes of large-scale campaign management, marketing technology, and attribution frameworks while ensuring our daily operations run at peak efficiency.

Support campaign builds and QAAssist with building, launching, and QA-ing campaigns across paid social platforms (for example: creative trafficking, catalog updates, audience implementation, and pixel/tag checks).Help ensure ads follow Etsy’s naming conventions, UTM standards, and creative/spec guidelines before launch.Help maintain and optimize product feedsSupport day-to-day management of large-scale campaignsFlag creative or catalog issues (missing images, disapprovals, mismatched categories) and partner with more senior teammates and XFN partners on fixes.Monitor pacing and performanceCheck platform dashboards and internal trackers to monitor budget pacing, delivery, and key performance metrics.Surface anomalies (performance spikes/drops, delivery issues, broken links, tracking problems) quickly and assist in root-causing and correcting them.Contribute to optimizationsResearch and propose bid and budget adjustments to help ensure campaigns hit efficiency and volume targets.Assist in creating and updating audience structures, exclusions, and blocklists.Support testing and experimentationHelp set up and track creative and audience tests.Maintain test logs and help compile simple summaries of results for the broader team.Assist with reporting and communicationPull recurring performance exports from platforms and support creation of simple views or dashboards for weekly readouts.Help compile slides or notes for internal updates, post-mortems, and leadership-facing report-outs.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you succeed in this role are:

Experience & skills0–2 years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, analytics, or a related field; internships, co-ops, or project experience are welcome.Basic familiarity with paid social and/or display platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, or similar), whether from coursework, certifications, or hands-on experience.Comfort working with data in tools like Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or a BI tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau) is a plus, but not required.Strong quantitative skills and excitement about learning how to interpret performance data (e.g., ROAS, CPA/CAC, CTR, CVR, LTV).A curious, problem-solving attitude!

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Working knowledge and experience of sales cycle management, account management, or market research is a must.Ability to build and maintain positive relationship with partners that enable the Forum to drive new business opportunitiesExcellent organizational, project and time management skills, a strong work ethic, and high attention to detail.Excellent verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and manage expectations of senior stakeholdersAgile team player who enjoys working in a highly collaborative, culturally diverse, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.Responsible, independent, and self-driven with a learning mindset and a positive attitudeProficient in working with MS Office and Salesforce preferred, experience with other CRM tools a plus.Proficiency in working with AI solutions preferred – knowledge of Chat GPT and Slack a plus.

alignment of interests with shareholders. • Analyze financial statements, earnings drivers, industry positioning, and competitive dynamics. • Develop and maintain detailed financial models to assess company valuations, cash flow projections, and scenario/sensitivity analyses. • Coordinate with external research providers, sell-side analysts, and consultants to validate assumptions and enhance AIG is reimagining the way we help customers manage risk. Join us as an Analyst in the Commercial Underwriting Office (CUO) to play your part in that transformation with opportunities to learn and grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

About Us

At AIG, helping organizations and people discover new potential is our purpose. As a global risk leader, we do this for our clients every day. Through our deep expertise in their industries and our innovative solutions that help them smartly manage risk, we enable their growth in ways they never thought possible.

But we also do the same thing for our colleagues, because we know our people are our greatest strength – the source of every insight, every idea and every innovation. When we're working as one team to do what's right for our colleagues and our communities, we can achieve excellence together. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Make your mark in CUO

AIG’s Commercial Underwriting Office (CUO) plays a critical role in strengthening underwriting excellence across the organization. Working across AIG’s underwriting businesses, CUO provides technical expertise, strategic direction, risk insights, and capability development that support disciplined underwriting, informed decision-making, and profitable growth.

As a CUO Analyst, you will work alongside underwriting and business professionals and gain hands-on experience supporting initiatives that strengthen AIG’s underwriting organization. Opportunities are available across Risk Engineering, CUO Casualty, and Training & Development, each providing a unique perspective on how AIG evaluates risk, advances underwriting strategy, and develops the capabilities needed to serve our clients and businesses.

How You Will Make An Impact

When you join AIG, you will be part of a connected cohort community of early career talent participating in a program that equips you with learning experiences and skills needed to launch your career. From day one, you will develop your knowledge and understanding of AIG and the insurance industry and learn new skills through meaningful on-the-job experiences and instructor-led masterclasses. Through exposure to senior leaders, mentoring circles, networking and volunteering, you will build connections with colleagues across the organization. Collectively, these different experiences are designed to enable you to make an impact and build a rewarding and successful career.  

Responsibilities

Depending on your placement, you will gain experience in one of the following areas within the Commercial Underwriting Office:

Risk Engineering


Support risk assessments to identify and evaluate operational, safety, property, and liability exposures. Analyze data, industry trends, and potential loss drivers to support risk evaluation and mitigation strategies. Partner with underwriters and clients to provide technical insights that inform risk selection and improve risk quality. Support initiatives focused on loss prevention, resilience, and business continuity. 

CUO Casualty


Support underwriting analysis, risk assessments, and portfolio reviews across Casualty businesses. Analyze portfolio performance, loss trends, market developments, and emerging risks to inform underwriting decisions. Partner with underwriting teams and business stakeholders on growth, profitability, and portfolio strategies. Support underwriting guidelines, governance, and best practices that promote underwriting excellence. 

Training & Development


Support the design and delivery of learning programs that build technical underwriting, business, and leadership capabilities. Assist with onboarding and development initiatives for underwriting professionals, including Early Career talent. Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and develop relevant training solutions. Support learning effectiveness, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Minimum Qualifications

Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree.

Education Requirements


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree to be received no later than June 2027 (unofficial transcript required upon application). 

Program Requirements


Available to start the Program on July 26, 2027. Analyst positions are in-person opportunities, requiring employees to work in the office at least four days per week. 

Core Qualifications


Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 

Preferred Qualifications


Preferred majors include Risk Management & Insurance, Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, or a related field. Interest in commercial insurance, underwriting, risk management, or underwriting talent and capability development. Ability to interpret data, trends, and business information and translate findings into meaningful insights or recommendations. Demonstrated curiosity and interest in learning about complex risks, business operations, and the commercial insurance industry. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in using data and technology to support business decisions. Previous internship, academic project, leadership, or relevant work experience in insurance, risk management, engineering, analytics, business, or learning and development is a plus. 

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume.

For applicants in Colorado, Jersey City, and New York City the base salary pay range for this position is $62,550 - $83,400.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

2027 ARM Summer Analyst Program Overview: (6/7/2027 ~ 8/13/2027)

The Risk Management Summer Analyst Program at MUFG is designed to help you learn how the Bank maintains a disciplined approach to identifying, assessing, managing, reporting, and mitigating risks.

Our 10-week Summer Analyst Program begins in early June and is structured to provide rising seniors with hands-on experience and business exposure in the world of Risk Management. You will be placed in a specific group that allows you to concentrate and quickly develop the skills and knowledge required to become an integral part of the team. You will work alongside MUFG professionals at all levels who will serve as your instructors and mentors. Interns also have the opportunity to attend learning sessions led by Americas Risk Management professionals in all of the Risk Disciplines at the bank. The Risk Program is designed to help you experience just what it’s like to manage risk within a Global Investment Bank.

In this role, the Analyst will have opportunities to interact with colleagues within Americas Risk Management and the Lines of Business and Products Owners while rotating through activities in their assigned area of a given risk discipline. With the goal of learning the components of the MUFG Risk Framework and how it is implemented within the Bank to effectively assess, monitor, and control risk. Additionally, the Analyst will have the opportunity to work on cross functional projects to gain insights into how the various risk frameworks intersect and support the overall management of risk at the Bank and support the strategic goals of MUFG.

Based on background, interest, and firm need – interns will be selected to work in one of the following areas:

Credit Risk Reporting: The reporting around risk of loss and reduction in capital, and weakened financial resiliency, arising from borrowers or counterparties not paying as agreed on loans or other contractual agreements.Liquidity Risk: The risk that the enterprise will not have, or may simply be perceived as not having, enough cash, liquid assets, or fulfill liabilities to fund loans, pay operating expenses, or other contractual obligations as they come due.Interest Rate Risk: The risk that focuses on assessing how changes in market interest rates may affect the bank’s earnings and financial position.Operational Risk: The risk from events which may have an adverse effect on current projected financial condition and resilience arising from inadequate or failed internal processes or systems, human error or misconduct, or adverse external events.Enterprise Risk Management: Risks resulting from Strategic events. Additionally, encompassing Risk Governance functions such as risk appetite and risk reporting, etc.Quantitative Risk Control: The use of any Models invariably presents Model Risk, which is the potential for adverse consequences (e.g., financial loss, poor business and strategic decision-making, or damage to an organization’s brand) from decisions based on incorrect or misused Model outputs and reports.

Support & Guidance

Your assigned mentor/manager will provide goals and professional development guidance and conduct performance reviews as a commitment to our summer Analysts. You will also have the opportunity to network with employees across different business groups and at all levels of the organization. In our open and inclusive environment, senior colleagues will know who you are and will see the work you do. You will leave with a better understanding of the world of risk management.

Career Progression

At the end of the program, the opportunity exists to receive an offer for full time employment upon graduation. Based on performance during the assignment, a percentage of the intern cohort will be placed in a three-year rotation program, while other offers may be considered for a role in the area where they completed their internship.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Modeller to join our data team and play a key role in designing and implementing structured data models across our medallion architecture — with a primary focus on the Silver (cleansed/conformed) and Gold (business-ready/aggregated) layers. You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data is modelled accurately, consistently, and in a way that drives value across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

 Design, develop, and maintain data models for the Silver layer (cleansed, deduplicated, and conformed data) and Gold layer (aggregated, business-logic-applied, reporting-ready data) Create and manage source-to-target mapping documents to clearly define data lineage from raw ingestion through to consumption layers Collaborate with data engineers to translate business requirements into logical and physical data models Define and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and modelling best practices across the data platform Work with business and analytics teams to understand reporting and analytical requirements and reflect them in Gold-layer structures Identify and resolve data quality, consistency, and integrity issues during modelling and mapping exercises Document data models, transformation rules, and mapping specifications to ensure traceability and auditability Participate in data governance initiatives, supporting metadata management and data cataloguing efforts Review and validate transformation logic applied between Bronze → Silver and Silver → Gold layers Contribute to the evolution of the overall data architecture and medallion framework

Required Skills & Experience

 Proven experience as a Data Modeller, Data Architect, or similar role within a modern data platform environment Strong understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layering) and the purpose of each layer Hands-on experience with source-to-target mapping and data lineage documentation Proficiency in dimensional modelling (star schema, snowflake schema) and normalised/denormalised design approaches Experience with data modelling tools such as erwin, dbt, Dataedo, or similar Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery) Strong SQL skills for validating and prototyping data structures and transformations Ability to engage with both technical teams and business stakeholders to gather and translate requirements Good documentation skills — comfortable producing mapping specs, data dictionaries, and model diagrams

Nice to Have

 Experience with dbt for managing Silver/Gold transformations and model documentation Exposure to data governance frameworks or tools (e.g. Collibra, Alation, Purview) Familiarity with Delta Lake or similar open table formats Understanding of data mesh or domain-oriented data modelling principles

The Crown Is Yours

As an Analyst I on the Customer Economics team, you’ll help shape the future of customer insights and marketing optimization by building models that forecast behavior and drive smarter decision-making. The Customer Economics team sits within the Marketing Analytics organization, powering acquisition-cost models and valuation frameworks that underpin how DraftKings invests in growth. You’ll dive into data to uncover patterns, steer revenue-driving strategies, and help cross-functional teams bring our models to life. From optimizing promotional impact to guiding retention strategies, you’ll play a pivotal role in making our customer experience more intelligent, predictive, and durable.

What you'll do as an Analyst I, Customer Economics

Build and deploy predictive models that forecast customer behavior and drive revenue outcomes.Translate complex model outputs into scalable solutions that teams across DraftKings can activate.Lead deep-dive analyses and cross-functional partnerships with Marketing, Finance, etc. to turn insights into action across the business.Use data and industry insights to uncover growth opportunities and elevate our modeling strategy.Create automated tools, analyses, and dashboards that measure and communicate customer performance.Analyze customer retention and gameplay trends to inform marketing investments and vertical strategies.Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to apply best-in-class practices using tools like Databricks, Airflow, and Bitbucket.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant discipline.At least 1 year of experience in business analytics or data science.Exposure to data science principles, including machine learning, regression techniques, and model evaluation. Join Our Team

At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. Overall Purpose

This position serves as a data science team member in the company delivering leading edge machine learning and artificial intelligence concepts from start to finish in collaboration with senior technical and business leaders. This includes understanding the business problem, aggregating, and exploring data, building, and validating algorithms, quantifying the value of the model to Early Warning Customers by performing simulations utilizing real world inputs, understanding, and articulating the model risks, deploying completed models to deliver business results and regularly measuring model accuracy, drift and performance.

Contribute to the development and parameterization of new pricing models within MS Reinsurance’s technical pricing framework.Assist in the production and validation of portfolio pricing statistics.Collaborate and share knowledge with the wider pricing and actuarial team on pricing approaches and analyses.Assistance with other pricing team activities as appropriate.

In case of questions, please contact us via email: careers@msreinsurance.com

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities

 Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support  Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures  Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained  Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation  Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization  Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate  Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic  Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles  Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage  Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant  Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams  Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary  Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets  Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone  Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components  Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data 

Job Qualifications & Experience

 Minimum Qualifications 

 2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role  Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience  Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis  Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued  Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources  Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping  Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work  Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls  Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence  Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance 

Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As

 Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)  Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)  Tableau Certified Data Analyst  Tableau Desktop Specialist certification  Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools  Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data  Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation  Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases  Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts  Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift  Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices  Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview  Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods 

The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

POSSIBLE HYBRID WORKPLACE OPPORTUNITY
Instructions for Applicants
Applicants must include a cover letter and resume for review. Resumes not accompanied by a cover letter will be deemed incomplete and will not be considered.
Applicant must describe in a cover letter how the applicant meets the minimum qualifications, and how the work or education experience outlined in the accompanying resume relates to the available position. Applicants are also encouraged to use the cover letter as an opportunity to identify specific skills, including knowledge of disaster recovery and how you use data analysis to implement into programs

 


New York State Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is the State’s affordable housing agency, with a mission to build, preserve, and protect affordable housing and increase homeownership throughout New York State.
This position is with HCR's Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC). This is not a civil service position and does not require a civil service exam. Candidates must meet the minimum qualifications outlined below to be considered. 
NYS Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility. Our work would not be possible without the diverse backgrounds, experiences, ideas, and abilities of our employees. HCR is committed to developing a workforce that represents the diverse population of New York State. HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.
Resilient Homes and Communities (RHC) now serves as the lead principal office responsible for the administration of New York State’s multiple CDBG-DR awards. RHC operates within the New York State Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC) and the Homeownership and Community Development (HOCD) unit, which consists of the State of New York Mortgage Agency, the Affordable Housing Corporation, the Office of Community Renewal, the Office of Special Initiatives and RHC.
Position Summary
The Data Analyst will play a key supporting role analyzing, visualizing and reporting data for the Office of Resilient Homes and Communities. This position combines data science, spatial data analysis (GIS) with business and policy research to support reporting, decision-making, and program quality across the agency. Reporting to the Director of Research and Data, the Data Analyst will assist in maintaining spatial and quantitative databases, updating the federal Disaster Recovery Grants Reporting (DRGR) system, and producing maps, dashboards, and reports. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain hands-on experience in disaster recovery policy, data integrity, and public sector data analysis.
Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 Data & Reporting Support: Assist in the development, update, and maintenance of performance management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc data analyses to support program operations.
 GIS & Spatial Analysis: Support program teams by maintaining Esri ArcGIS software/ArcGIS Online platforms, performing basic spatial analyses, and creating maps and graphs for internal and external stakeholders.
 System Maintenance: Help input, track, and verify service areas and program data within New York State’s internal systems and the federal Disaster Recovery Grant Reporting (DRGR) system to ensure accuracy across program records.
 Data Quality & Documentation: Assist in documenting data methodologies, maintaining Standards of Procedure (SOPs) for federal reporting, and performing routine data cleaning and quality control.
 Research Assistance: Provide analytical and research support for ongoing projects evaluating the impact of RHC programs on New York State residents.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal program teams and external partners to share, transfer, and package data for reporting and research needs.

Qualifications:

 Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field*
 Knowledge of public policy in areas such as disaster recovery, infrastructure, housing, economic development, and/or resiliency is preferred.
 Experience distilling quantitative and qualitative policy analysis into written descriptions such as briefs, memos, etc.
 2 years professional experience in an analytic role*
 Demonstrated experience using Esri ArcGIS 10.x, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, Model Builder, R and basic python programming. 
 Excellent oral, written, and quantitative skills.
 Exceptional problem-solving abilities. 
 Exceptional ability to use data to make decisions. 
 Expertise in the use of Microsoft Office products, specifically Excel and Access.
 Ability to work in a flexible, fast paced, mission driven environment.

*Substitutions: four years of specialized experience or associate’s degree and two years of specialized experience may substitute for bachelor’s degree; J.D. or master’s degree may substitute for one year of specialized experience; Ph.D. may substitute for two years of specialized experience.
This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.
APPLICANTS MUST INCLUDE A RESUME
WHAT WE OFFER AT NYS HCR: 

 Extensive benefits package including participation in New York State’s Health Insurance Program and New York State & Local Employees’ Retirement System.
 Promotional opportunities for dedicated professionals.
 Work-life balance benefits including a 37.5-hour work week, opportunity for compressed scheduling, and paid time off benefits (vacation, sick, personal days, and federal holidays).
 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave.
 Paid Family Leave.
 As a New York State employee, you may qualify to participate in the Federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF). The PSLF Program forgives the remaining balance on your Direct Loans after you have made 120 qualifying monthly payments under an accepted repayment plan and while working full-time for an eligible employer. 

ABOUT NEW YORK STATE HOMES AND COMMUNITY RENEWAL:
Under the leadership of Governor Kathy Hochul and Commissioner RuthAnne Visnauskas, HCR is a vibrant, innovative agency that integrates and leverages New York State’s housing resources. We have offices in New York City, Albany, Buffalo, and Syracuse, and employ a diverse workforce of professionals who are hard-working and committed to serving low- and moderate-income families. Our mission is far-reaching, encompassing single and multifamily housing finance, home improvement, rent regulation, housing subsidies, and community development. We partner regularly with a variety of public and private stakeholders.
Achieving this mission requires a wide range of skills and backgrounds in public policy, administration, real estate, construction, finance, law, and many other areas of expertise. We seek to provide a workplace environment that is productive, flexible, accountable, ethical, and caring. Our employees are empowered to make a difference where they live and work. We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including paid leave, health, dental, vision, retirement, and family-friendly policies. 
New York State is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE)

Bayside Health is a public health service delivering high-quality care across every stage of life for close to 1.2 million people living in metropolitan Melbourne, the Mornington Peninsula, Koo Wee Rup, Bass Coast and Southern Gippsland. We have more than 15 main sites, including hospitals, centres and clinics that provide comprehensive care from welcoming newborns to supporting older people and a full range of services in between. About Us

The Alfred Hospital’s Department of Infectious Diseases is one of Australia’s largest and most advanced centres for infectious disease care, research and education. It provides specialist expertise across general infections, HIV, hospital‑acquired infections, antimicrobial resistance, travel medicine, viral hepatitis, STIs and infections in immunocompromised patients. Clinical services include dedicated units for general infectious diseases, HIV care, consultative support and immunocompromised hosts, alongside a leading training program.

A flagship component is the Victorian State‑wide HIV Service, offering comprehensive multidisciplinary care for people living with HIV, including management of complications and co‑morbidities. Product Management 

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the Team: 

The Encore Processing Product Management organization drives the strategy and execution of Capital One’s Card Processing ecosystem. Our team is at the epicenter of Card Growth—delivering critical capabilities for major card network integrations (e.g., Discover), driving legacy system updates (e.g., Bridges), and building an ultra-resilient, highly available processing engine.

As the Senior Associate PM you are the engine behind our primary product delivery. You are a flexible, highly detail-oriented product manager who spans horizontal work across backend architecture and business operations. Whether you are validating payment logic for major portfolio conversions, analyzing edge cases for disaster recovery resiliency, or untangling complex cardholder data, your work directly protects customer experiences and directly enables business value for Card.

Key Responsibilities & Focus Areas

 High-Stakes Program & Conversion ExecutionClearing Evolution: Lead product discovery, requirements gathering, and data validation to support strategic growth initiatives (including Discover integration). Legacy Evolution: Partner with engineering to map legacy processes to target-state architectures, supporting the rollout of prioritized bridge solutions. Review update requirements for efficacy. Transaction Management: Build strategy, roadmaps, grounded in a deep understanding of business and customer needs.  Platform Resiliency & Operational ExcellenceWell-Managed Analysis: Perform root-cause analyses on recurring production errors. Identify systemic fixes to measurably eliminate reliance on manual Catch & Fix interventions. Disaster Recovery (DR) Readiness: Help define, test, and validate "Definition of Ready" criteria for critical features—ensuring seamless failover to the DR site for high-risk events and midnight payment processing. Intake & Feature Triaging: Manage incoming feature requests and operational enhancements, turning customer/business friction points into crisp, prioritized user stories.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & DeliveryFull-Stack/Horizontal Flexibility: Operate comfortably across both backend logic (money movement, posting rules, fee engine logic) and downstream customer touchpoints (mobile app and web display logic). Strategic Alignment: Support leadership with data-driven insights and progress metrics that feed quarterly VP+ strategy and roadmap updates. 

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert
In this role, you will:

Customer Resiliency: Ensure zero disruption to customer payment behavior during major conversions and system updates. Update Systems: Help untangle dependencies by identifying opportunities for advanced "bridge and peel away" solutions. Elevate Platform Quality: Deeply investigate process breakdowns to drive down reliance on manual "Catch & Fix" remedies. 

We want you if you are: 

Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challengesCommunicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with youDo-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your workPassionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needsLearner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for helpTeam Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or military experienceAt least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

AIG is reimagining the way we help customers manage risk. Join us as an Analyst in the Commercial Underwriting Office (CUO) to play your part in that transformation with opportunities to learn and grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

About Us

At AIG, helping organizations and people discover new potential is our purpose. As a global risk leader, we do this for our clients every day. Through our deep expertise in their industries and our innovative solutions that help them smartly manage risk, we enable their growth in ways they never thought possible.

But we also do the same thing for our colleagues, because we know our people are our greatest strength – the source of every insight, every idea and every innovation. When we're working as one team to do what's right for our colleagues and our communities, we can achieve excellence together. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Make your mark in CUO

AIG’s Commercial Underwriting Office (CUO) plays a critical role in strengthening underwriting excellence across the organization. Working across AIG’s underwriting businesses, CUO provides technical expertise, strategic direction, risk insights, and capability development that support disciplined underwriting, informed decision-making, and profitable growth.

As a CUO Analyst, you will work alongside underwriting and business professionals and gain hands-on experience supporting initiatives that strengthen AIG’s underwriting organization. Opportunities are available across Risk Engineering, CUO Casualty, and Training & Development, each providing a unique perspective on how AIG evaluates risk, advances underwriting strategy, and develops the capabilities needed to serve our clients and businesses.

How You Will Make An Impact

When you join AIG, you will be part of a connected cohort community of early career talent participating in a program that equips you with learning experiences and skills needed to launch your career. From day one, you will develop your knowledge and understanding of AIG and the insurance industry and learn new skills through meaningful on-the-job experiences and instructor-led masterclasses. Through exposure to senior leaders, mentoring circles, networking and volunteering, you will build connections with colleagues across the organization. Collectively, these different experiences are designed to enable you to make an impact and build a rewarding and successful career.  

Responsibilities

Depending on your placement, you will gain experience in one of the following areas within the Commercial Underwriting Office:

Risk Engineering


Support risk assessments to identify and evaluate operational, safety, property, and liability exposures. Analyze data, industry trends, and potential loss drivers to support risk evaluation and mitigation strategies. Partner with underwriters and clients to provide technical insights that inform risk selection and improve risk quality. Support initiatives focused on loss prevention, resilience, and business continuity. 

CUO Casualty


Support underwriting analysis, risk assessments, and portfolio reviews across Casualty businesses. Analyze portfolio performance, loss trends, market developments, and emerging risks to inform underwriting decisions. Partner with underwriting teams and business stakeholders on growth, profitability, and portfolio strategies. Support underwriting guidelines, governance, and best practices that promote underwriting excellence. 

Training & Development


Support the design and delivery of learning programs that build technical underwriting, business, and leadership capabilities. Assist with onboarding and development initiatives for underwriting professionals, including Early Career talent. Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and develop relevant training solutions. Support learning effectiveness, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Minimum Qualifications

Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree.

Education Requirements


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree to be received no later than June 2027 (unofficial transcript required upon application). 

Program Requirements


Available to start the Program on July 26, 2027. Analyst positions are in-person opportunities, requiring employees to work in the office at least four days per week. 

Core Qualifications


Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 

Preferred Qualifications


Preferred majors include Risk Management & Insurance, Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, or a related field. Interest in commercial insurance, underwriting, risk management, or underwriting talent and capability development. Ability to interpret data, trends, and business information and translate findings into meaningful insights or recommendations. Demonstrated curiosity and interest in learning about complex risks, business operations, and the commercial insurance industry. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in using data and technology to support business decisions. Previous internship, academic project, leadership, or relevant work experience in insurance, risk management, engineering, analytics, business, or learning and development is a plus. 

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume.

For applicants in Colorado, Jersey City, and New York City the base salary pay range for this position is $62,550 - $83,400.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

Job Description

At American Express, we empower future product leaders to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As an Associate Digital Product Management in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a full-time program and contribute to product and platform initiatives that help shape seamless customer and colleague experiences.

Product Management sits at the intersection of business, technology, data, design, delivery, and customer experience. In this role, you will help frame customer and colleague problems, translate insights into product opportunities, define success measures, support prioritization, evaluate potential solutions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to build technology products that create measurable value.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities & What Type of Work to Expect 

Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Data Analysts, Architects, and business stakeholders to support product strategy, discovery, roadmap planning, and product decision-making. Help frame customer or colleague problems, define opportunities, develop hypotheses, and document product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and solution concepts. Conduct customer discovery, stakeholder engagement, user research, usability testing, and synthesis of qualitative and quantitative insights to inform product decisions. Support prioritization by evaluating customer value, business value, technical feasibility, risk, effort, and evidence from product, customer, operational, and business data. Help define product outcomes, KPIs, success measures, dashboards, launch measurement, and post-launch learning plans in partnership with product and analytics teams. Analyze customer, product, operational, and business data to identify trends, insights, opportunities, and recommendations that improve customer or colleague experiences. Collaborate across product, engineering, design, analytics, risk, security, operations, finance, and business teams to explore product concepts, prototypes, APIs, platform capabilities, roadmap tradeoffs, and implementation considerations. Evaluate how AI or automation could improve a customer journey, colleague experience, internal product, analytics practice, documentation workflow, or team process while applying responsible AI and human-in-the-loop practices. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

Must have earned a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Product Management, Economics, or another relevant field before the full-time start date. Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027. Demonstrated interest in technology, product management, digital products, customer experience, AI-enabled products, data-informed decision-making, or enterprise platform concepts. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, evaluate information, identify patterns, form hypotheses, and develop clear recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain ideas, product decisions, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams and build strong working relationships with partners and stakeholders. Experience through coursework, projects, internships, research, student organizations, or extracurricular activities that demonstrate leadership, organization, customer focus, product-oriented thinking, data literacy, or technical fluency. 

Preferred Qualifications

Interest in product management, technology strategy, digital products, customer experience, payments, data analytics, AI, or emerging technologies. Familiarity with Agile, Lean, Scrum, Kanban, product roadmaps, user stories, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, prioritization discussions, risk awareness, or delivery metrics. Exposure to customer research, design thinking, user-centered design, usability testing, journey mapping, product experimentation, launch measurement, post-launch learning, or accessibility practices. Familiarity with technical product concepts, APIs, platform products, data flows, system integrations, SDLC practices, implementation considerations, change management, or release management. Experience using customer insights, dashboards, KPIs, experimentation, product metrics, operational insights, or quantitative and qualitative evidence to support evidence-based product decisions. Interest in AI-enabled product management practices, including generative AI, intelligent automation, AI-assisted discovery or analysis, product analytics, responsible AI usage, and human-in-the-loop validation. Experience using productivity, collaboration, analytics, design, product management, or project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Demonstrated curiosity, ownership, resilience, learning agility, customer focus, technical fluency, data literacy, and passion for building technology products that create meaningful customer and business value. 

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. Junior Business Analyst (BA) to join the Sales & Operations Management Unit supporting), our POS and payment processing platform for beauty supply and food & beverage retail merchants. Job Description

The Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS) Product team is at the heart of American Express and is a core function within the GMNS business unit. Each year, we power billions of transactions through our global payments network, serving Issuing & Acquiring partners in more than 170 markets worldwide. We grow revenue by driving strategic, multi-year initiatives to deliver differentiated value to our merchants, partners, and customers.

Our solutions deliver value to American Express’ Card Members, acquirers, and partners across the globe through both proprietary and third-party capabilities, facilitating secure and seamless transactions between issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Our goal is to enable Card Members to pay however and wherever they choose. We deliver on this by setting the vision and strategy for the Network, anchoring our priorities to enterprise objectives, and developing and managing a portfolio of products. We maintain a strong customer focus, consider competitive and regulatory dynamics, and apply an end-to-end product management approach across strategy, roadmaps, scaling plans, and performance metrics. We lead the end-to-end process, manage the partner lifecycle, and drive industry intelligence and engagement through key governing bodies.

The Agentic Commerce Solutions team is responsible for defining and enabling the future of Agentic Commerce across the Amex Global Network. As AI-driven agents, digital wallets, and automated commerce experiences evolve, we are shaping how the Network supports secure, scalable, and commercially compelling agent-based transactions. Our focus spans tokenization, digital identity, and emerging network capabilities required to power next-generation commerce.

The Senior Associate, Product Management will support the development and delivery of Agentic Commerce capabilities. Reporting to a Manager or Director within Agentic Commerce Solutions, this colleague will assist in translating product strategy into requirements, support execution across product workstreams, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to help deliver new capabilities.

Responsibilities

Support the development and execution of product initiatives within Agentic Commerce SolutionsAssist in translating product strategy into detailed requirements, user stories, and documentationPartner with Technology teams to clarify requirements, support development, and track progress against milestonesCollaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Risk, Strategy, GTM, Architecture) to support delivery of product capabilitiesSupport the design and development of Agentic Commerce features (e.g., tokenization, identity, intent capture) through research and documentationAssist in managing timelines, dependencies, and risks across assigned tasks or componentsContribute to product documentation, including specifications, process flows, and integration materialsSupport testing activities, including validation of requirements and coordination of feedbackConduct research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments in agentic and digital commerceSupport internal communications and preparation of materials for stakeholder updates

The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong willingness to learn and contribute in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Responsibilities

The Credit Portfolio Management department (CPM) lies within Global Banking and Advisory (GLBA) of Societe Generale. Responsibilities

The individual will be responsible for credit analysis and management of a portfolio of client credit relationships, predominantly in the life insurance industry but also including a focus on P&C, reinsurance and insurance brokers. Geographic region is predominantly USA, with additional coverage of Canada and UK island territories (i.e. Bermuda, Cayman Islands). The candidate should have expertise in the credit analysis and supporting ratios and metrics, insurance accounting, and regulatory matters. Product lines encompass committed and uncommitted lending facilities (including revolving credit facilities and letters of credit), structured transactions, OTC and listed derivatives, foreign exchange, and repo. Establish credit terms for legal documents and follow up with legal department on negotiations.Perform ongoing monitoring of client credit quality to identify a possible deterioration of credit quality.Monitor exposure and manage credit limit exceptions. We're looking for a motivated Technical Account Analyst to support our Technical Account Managers (TAMs) in delivering outstanding outcomes for our Logistics customers.
