rows.descriptionText:
Job#: 3055878

Job Description:

Candidates must be U.S. citizens able to obtain and/or maintain a Department of Defense security clearance as a condition and continuation of employment.

Remote AI Engineer

Location: 100% Remote with quarterly travel to Washington, D.C.

Role Overview

We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to develop innovative solutions using generative AI, agentic systems, machine learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), and prompt engineering. You will design, build, and deploy scalable solutions in distributed and cloud environments, leveraging large and text-based datasets to solve complex challenges and drive innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Build and deploy agentic AI systems capable of autonomous decision-making, tool use, and multi-step task execution.Implement end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI projects, from understanding business needs to data preparation, model development, deployment, and monitoring.Develop LLM-based features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with citations, text summarization, and embedding pipelines.Design and optimize prompts using prompt engineering techniques for LLMs to achieve desired outcomes.Work with Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, etc. via APIs or cloud AI platforms to develop solutions for specific tasks.Evaluate and test GenAI features, including building test sets, grounding and citation checks, LLM-as-judge scoring, and production quality monitoring.Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models using Python.Deploy and manage solutions in distributed and cloud environments.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to guide business decisions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a Mathematics field.2+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, including demonstrable LLM application work. Experience building agentic AI systems or strong working knowledge of agent architectures and frameworks. Experience in one or more areas of machine learning/artificial intelligence such as classification, clustering, anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, and NLP.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of the modern LLM stack: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and structured outputs. Programming experience using Python and iPython notebooks; good SQL skills. Ability to think critically about AI or ML system design, including model selection, tradeoffs, and real-world deployment considerations. Experience evaluating AI/ML systems: testing, measuring accuracy, and catching hallucinations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with prompt engineering techniques such as few-shot learning, zero-shot learning, and chain-of-thought prompting.Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and their AI/ML services.Experience in using deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or Keras.Experience in MLOps to operationalize the model building process and monitor models in production.Familiarity with search and vector retrieval such as Elasticsearch, Solr, or vector databases.Familiarity with version control systems, specifically Git, and experience with platforms like Azure DevOps.Familiarity with Linux and cloud CLI tools.Experience creating interactive data visualizations and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or other tools.Experience with distributed NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.Ability to build full stack systems architected for speed and distributed computing.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Do you have demonstrated machine learning experience and want to apply that experience to solving a wide variety of complex problems in this rapidly evolving field?

Do you thrive in a collaborative research environment, working alongside an energetic, multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers?

Are you ready to help the US secure and maintain leadership in the development and deployment of AI/ML algorithms for non-kinetic defense systems?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer who will contribute to all phases of the machine learning algorithm development and implementation. You will be joining a team of engineers and scientists who are at the forefront of APL's mission to provide innovative solutions to critical challenges.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will...

Design, implement, and evaluate advanced machine learning algorithms to solve challenging real-world planning, perception, coordination, and control problems in support of national defense. Develop software pipelines to integrate data streams, simulation environments, and intelligent decision-making algorithms.Work with technologies and concepts at the cutting edge of AI, including but not limited to: deep reinforcement learning, foundation models, large language models, convolutional/recurrent/graph neural networks, computer vision, and physics-based modeling and simulation tools. Collaborate closely with the talented team of scientists and engineers in our group and with others across APL.Engage directly with sponsors to communicate proposed concepts, solutions, and analysis.

Qualifications

You meet the minimum requirements for the job if you...

Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.Have at least 2+ years of experience in machine learning and data science fields.Have at least one year of hands-on experience applying/developing machine learning algorithms using common libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Have strong foundational knowledge in at least two of the following: classification, clustering, deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision (object detection and visual tracking), multi-agent systems, or optimization/control theory.Have demonstrated experience in working with version control software like Git.Have strong, effective communication skills both verbal and written.Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You 'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have an MS in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.Have 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing AI/ML algorithms for a variety of datasets.Have proven experience applying state-of-the-art deep learning techniques to solve distributed resource allocation problems.Have hands-on experience building computer vision pipelines for detection, tracking, segmentation, or multi-modal sensor fusion.Have experience with modeling and simulation platforms such as AFSIM, Blender, Unity, or Unreal.Are comfortable working in high performance computing environments (GPU/CPU clusters).Have proficiency in one or more of the following technology areas: multi-agent reinforcement learning, geometric deep learning, multi-modal sensor fusion, agentic AI.Have a track record of writing deployable, production-level code (Python, C/C++) for real-world applications.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. rows.title: Online Brand Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Online Brand Manager – London

Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty. Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.

A Day in the Life

As our Online Brand Manager, you will drive the e-commerce growth and digital brand presence for our iconic CPD portfolio in the UK. You will lead the online consumer journey from awareness to conversion.

E-Commerce Activation:Define and execute e-commerce strategies to maximize online retail sales and market share.Lead e-merchandising, catalog optimization, and promotional campaigns across key e-retailer platforms.Digital Brand Management:Coordinate online brand consistency, digital assets, and activation plans.Collaborate with marketing teams to align online and offline campaigns.Data & Performance Analytics:Track, analyze, and report on digital shelf metrics, traffic, and conversion rates to continuously optimize ROI.
We Are Looking For

Skills

We are looking for an entrepreneurial collaborator who thrives in fast-paced environments and is ready to elevate our digital commerce. Based on our L'Oréal Skills Library, the core competencies for this role are:

e-Commerce Generalist: Strong understanding of online retail dynamics and consumer journeys.Data Analytics: Ability to translate digital metrics into actionable business insights.E-Merchandising & Eventing: Expertise in optimizing product discoverability and online visual standards.Digital Web & Platform Management: Familiarity with managing digital touchpoints and content syndication.Collaboration: Exceptional stakeholder management skills to work across divisions and agencies.

What’s In It For You

A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’OréalAn environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference

Who We Are

L’Oréal is present in 150 markets on five continents. For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to ‘Create beauty that moves the world’; it is now the industry world leader with €42 billion consolidated sales. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet.

Today, L’Oréal includes over 9k experts in beauty tech, digital, data and e-comm and is constantly growing. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.

The Consumer Products Division is on a mission to democratize beauty at its best. That means celebrating the diverse beauty of humanity and engaging the maximum number of people worldwide while elevating the mass beauty market with premium innovations. rows.title: TikTok Shop Lead - Color Wow
rows.descriptionText:
TIKTOK SHOP LEAD

Color Wow is seeking a commercially driven and digitally native TikTok Shop Lead to define and deliver the brand’s TikTok Shop strategy. Sitting at the intersection of social commerce, content, creators, media and operations, you will unlock sustainable growth on one of beauty’s most dynamic discovery platforms, driving retail sales, market share, brand relevance and profitable performance.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

You will own the TikTok Shop trading ecosystem end to end: from commercial planning, promotional strategy and P&L management, to media execution, seller operations, stock availability, fulfilment and platform optimisation. Combining sharp commercial judgement with deep platform expertise, you will turn fast-moving trends, content signals and performance data into clear actions that accelerate conversion and maximise ROI. A critical part of the role will be building a strong content-to-commerce engine in partnership with the Content and Advocacy & Influence teams using real-time organic, creator and affiliate performance to identify winning content, amplify it through paid media, and feed commercial learnings back into future content and creator strategy.

TikTok Shop Strategy & Commercial Growth: Define and implement the TikTok Shop strategy, aligned to Color Wow’s wider business, brand and social commerce ambitions. Drive growth in retail sales, market share, conversion and brand image through a clear trading, content, media and promotional roadmap.

P&L, Forecasting & Budget Ownership: Own and optimise the TikTok Shop P&L in partnership with the finance team. Lead forecasting, budget management and spend tracking across trading, affiliate and media investment, ensuring activity is commercially accountable and delivers maximum ROI.

Media Strategy & Execution: Own the TikTok Shop paid media and GMV growth strategy, translating commercial targets into clear investment, ROAS and GMV plans. Lead strategy and optimisation across GMV Max and relevant TikTok Shop media products, determining where investment should be deployed across products, creator content, audiences and trading moments to maximise incremental and profitable GMV. Monitor performance daily, identifying opportunities to scale winning content and products, improve media efficiency and respond rapidly to changes in ROAS, conversion and sales velocity.

Trading, Promotions & Campaign Execution:Build and communicate the TikTok Shop trading calendar, including promotional plans, key retail moments, launches and always-on activity. Lead campaign execution and AON reporting, ensuring content, creators, media and promotional activity work together to deliver maximum impact.

Shop Operations & Supply Chain Management: Manage the TikTok Shop Seller and Affiliate Centres alongside fulfilment partners. Oversee product set-up, product information flows, stock availability and operational readiness, working closely with Supply Chain to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Creator Commerce & Affiliate Performance: Partner closely with Content and Advocacy & Influence teams to translate creator and affiliate activity into commercial growth.Own the commercial performance lens, identifying the creators, products and content driving GMV and conversion and using these insights to inform affiliate priorities, commission strategies and paid amplification.

Content Selection, Measurement & Testing: Identify high-performing organic and affiliate content for media investment and feed performance learnings back into creator and content planning. Partner closely with Content and Advocacy teams to build a continuous testing and performance loop. Establish robust metrics for content, amplification, and affiliate impact, translating insights and test results directly into future creator strategies and content planning with the Head of Content.

Performance Analytics & Reporting: Monitor TikTok Shop, media, affiliate and content performance, delivering deep analysis across sales, traffic, conversion, live shopping, media efficiency and creator metrics. Benchmark Color Wow against competitor brands and translate insights into clear actions for Brand, Content and leadership teams.

Trend Spotting & Innovation:Stay ahead of platform developments, creator behaviours, emerging technologies and competitor activity. Identify and rapidly test new commercial opportunities, from new content formats and live shopping moments to media products, platform tools, services and creator partnerships.

Stakeholder & Partner Leadership: Build strong relationships across internal teams— including Zone, Multi-Division, Brand, Content, Advocacy & Influence, Finance and Supply Chain, Chief Digital Marketing Office as well as external platform, agency and fulfilment partners. Proactively share TikTok Shop best practice, performance updates and recommendations across the business.
Who You Are

You’ll thrive in this high-impact role if you combine TikTok Shop expertise with commercial ownership, media capability, operational rigour and the ability to bring teams together around a fast-moving growth agenda.

TikTok Shop and social commerce native: You have deep, hands-on understanding of TikTok Shop, including its seller and affiliate mechanics, live shopping, discovery commerce and the content signals that convert attention into sales.Commercially and media driven: You bring strong experience in e-commerce trading, forecasting, budget ownership and P&L management, alongside an understanding of paid social, content boosting and transactional media. You know how to balance growth ambition, media efficiency and profitability.Data-led and performance-focused: You are confident interpreting complex commercial, web, media, affiliate and content metrics—including ROAS, CTR, CVR and GMV. You can move beyond reporting to identify the story behind performance and recommend clear optimisation actions.Operationally excellent: You are highly organised, process-oriented and comfortable owning the operational detail—from shop set-up, product information and invoicing to stock monitoring, fulfilment coordination and platform tools.Creator and content fluent: You understand the UK and Ireland creator economy, consumer trends and competitor landscape, and recognise the role that credible creators, compelling content and smart media amplification play in TikTok Shop growth.Collaborative and influential: You build trusted relationships across Content, Marketing, Advocacy & Influence, Finance, Supply Chain and external partners. You can communicate complex performance data simply and influence stakeholders to act.Curious, proactive and agile: You spot opportunities early, respond quickly to market shifts and enjoy testing, learning and scaling what works in a high-momentum environment.A confident educator: You are passionate about raising TikTok Shop capability across the business, sharing practical best practice and helping teams understand how to win on the platform.

What We Offer

Our industry-leading award-winning benefits package shows how much we value our people. We know they're at the heart of L'Oréal's success, so we offer a fair and competitive package to help you thrive. Enjoy perks like money-saving offers, free mortgage advice, share options and an enhanced pension plan. Love our brands? You'll get up to 60% off iconic names like YSL, CeraVe, Armani, Kiehl's and Garnier! Because health matters, we offer private medical and dental insurance, discounted gym memberships, and onsite mental health support. We also provide enhanced family leave for all and up to 4 weeks of paid fertility leave, so you can prioritise what matters most. Learning is in our DNA at L'Oréal. We'll help you master your role, build skills, and access top-notch leadership programs and monthly expert talks. And there's lots more too!

Who We Are

L’Oréal is present in 150 markets on five continents. For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to ‘Create beauty that moves the world’; it is now the industry world leader with €29 billion consolidated sales. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet. Experience the excitement of agility to shape the future of beauty; where diversity and purpose come together to create meaningful impact.

In the Professional Products Division, our mission is to be the partner of choice for the professional hair industry. Inspiring stylists and creating desirability amongst consumers with meaningful brands. We’re the founding Division for the L’Oréal group, with a rich history over 110 years. The 8-brand portfolio includes the likes of L’Oréal Professionnel, Kérastase, Redken and Matrix and the division is universally known for exclusively supplying salons and other professional customers with the most advanced technologies in hair and beauty products.

How We Recruit

At L’Oréal, we take pride in creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment where everyone is welcome and their contributions are valued. When we recruit, hire, train, promote or engage in any other employment practice, we are committed to being an inclusive employer regardless of race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, socioeconomic status, medical condition or disability, or any other protected status. When we look for talent, we welcome difference - different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and perspectives. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. rows.descriptionText:

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary:

This Post Doctoral Research Scientist role focuses exclusively on understanding oxidative stress pathways and sensory responses in human oral mucosa triggered by oral care products. Your research will focus on developing in vitro and ex vivo models to study reactive oxygen species (ROS) associated pathways on oral mucosal and neuron-like cells. You will establish key biomarkers on oxidative stress related cytotoxicity. You will lead early-stage research programs that guide cross-functional teams in formulating safer, next-generation oral care products.

Responsibilities:

Discovery & Mechanistic Research

Scientific Discovery: Execute in vitro and ex vivo studies to evaluate oxidative stress induction and neuronal activation in oral tissue models exposed to novel formulations. Mechanistic Cellular Pathology: Investigate cellular signaling cascades linked to oxidative stress and neurogenic sensory responses . Biomarker Identification: Utilize -omics platforms to identify salivary and biological markers specific to oxidative markers and cytotoxicity. Protocol Design: Standardize testing protocols for screening active ingredients based on redox balance and neuronal reactivity. Technical Reporting: Translate oxidative and neuro-response dataset findings into guidelines for product development teams. 

Cross-Functional Innovation Strategy

Interdepartmental Partnership: Communicate mechanistic findings on oxidative stress and neuro-activation to Safety, Regulatory, and R&D leadership. Legal & IP Strategy: Work with Legal/IP to secure patent protection for novel models or formulations mitigating oxidative and neurological stress. 

Laboratory Excellence & Data Science

Lab Models: Establish high-throughput oxidative assay screening systems. Protocol Development: Standardize testing methods for quantifying ROS generation and neuronal responses. Advanced Analytics: Leverage bioinformatics tools to analyze gene expression changes in oxidative and neuro response pathways. 

Required Qualifications:

PhD in Oral Biology, Toxicology Oral Immunology, or a related fieldResearch experience in one or more of the following areas:Oral Mucosal Irritation Expertise: Deep understanding of irritation on oral soft tissues and mechanism of action of compounds inducing oral ulceration . Oral Immunology Expertise: Understanding of oral immunology, specifically the mechanisms of allergic sensitization and the inflammatory cascades leading to mucosal ulceration. Biomarker Validation: Experience in identifying, quantifying, and validating biological markers from biosamples such as saliva and blood. Bio-informatics: Data analysis and developing computable prediction models. 
Preferred Qualifications:

Toxicology and Immunology: Hands-on experience. Risk Assessment & Safety Evaluation: Database knowledge and computational predictionRegulatory Knowledge: Safety databases, status of common oral care ingredients.

Who Are We

Accelerator is Mars Snacking's growth engine, focused on unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands. Within Accelerator, the Better For You portfolio includes KIND®, RXBAR®, Nutri-Grain®, Special K Bars®, and Pure Organic® and within Tasty & Wholesome, the portfolio includes Eggo, Rice Krispies Treats and Pop Tarts. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a growth business, we are driving innovation, accelerating performance, and transforming how we work through data, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. 

We’re looking for passionate collaborators to help us become the foremost leader in Mars Snacking and positively impact society along the way. If you’re looking to be a part of an inspiring, energetic and entrepreneurial environment, you’ve found the right place. 

What You’ll Do 

Reporting to the Accelerator DT Manufacturing, Make, R&D and QFS Domain Sr. Manager, this role is part of the Digital Technologies organization supporting Accelerator, including KIND, Tru Fru, Nature's Bakery, and the newly acquired Kellanova brands. The role is responsible for shaping and governing technology solutions across the TLT portfolio, including Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, and R&D/QFS, while defining technology roadmaps, evaluating solution options, establishing architecture standards, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI, Digital Twins, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies that support Accelerator's long-term digital strategy.

As Accelerator continues to evolve, this role will provide architecture leadership across multiple business priorities, serving as a trusted advisor who bridges business and technology to shape future-state capabilities, guide investment decisions, and drive scalable, integrated solutions across the enterprise. Working closely with business stakeholders, product teams, Enterprise Architecture, and delivery partners, this individual will combine architecture expertise with strong business analysis skills to assess opportunities, translate business requirements into solution recommendations, support vendor evaluations and RFPs, shape initiatives from concept through delivery, and provide hands-on problem solving across the TLT portfolio. The role balances strategic planning with day-to-day execution, helping ensure solutions are practical, standardized, and scalable while fostering innovation, reducing technical debt, and preventing one-off solutions that limit future growth.

Architecture Strategy & Roadmap Development

Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, Digital Twins, analytics, and emerging technologies to create business value. Evaluate technology options, platforms, and vendor capabilities against business requirements and architecture standards. Support RFPs, vendor selections, proof-of-concepts, and technology due diligence activities. Provide architecture guidance during project intake, discovery, and design phases. 

Architecture Governance & Standards

Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, data, and integration standards. Review solution designs and help prevent siloed or plant-specific implementations that do not scale across Accelerator. Drive reuse, standardization, and simplification across business capabilities and technology platforms. 

Cross-Functional Delivery Support

Provide architecture leadership across Manufacturing, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, R&D and digital transformation programs. Support integration strategies across ERP, Planning, Manufacturing, Data & Analytics, AI, and operational technology ecosystems. Innovation & Emerging Technology

Assess and guide opportunities related to Digital Twins, smart manufacturing, connected operations, and data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with enterprise architecture and innovation teams to evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends.

Must-Have Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or related field. 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Business Architecture, or related technology consulting roles. Experience supporting supply chain, planning, manufacturing, quality or operational business domains. Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions and roadmaps. Experience facilitating business and technical workshops with senior stakeholders. Data, Analytics & AI Innovation

Customer-Centric LeadershipStrategic ThinkingSupply Chain ExpertiseFinancial & Business AcumenAnalytics & Data-Driven Decision MakingCross-Functional CollaborationChange LeadershipExecutive Communication & InfluenceTeam DevelopmentContinuous Improvement Mindset

rows.title: Senior Insight Manager (Beauty)
rows.descriptionText:
Circana™ is the leading advisor on the complexity of consumer behaviour. Through unparalleled technology, advanced analytics, cross-industry data and deep expertise, Circana provides clarity that helps clients take action and unlock business growth.

The CPG department works with nationally recognised FMCG suppliers with household brand clients, providing solutions to business challenges based upon our data. The team are responsible for client retention, contract renewal, and revenue growth through products and services which meet the business needs of clients. The overall aim is to boost our client’s market or category understanding whilst building brand equity.

Overview of the role:

You will be a member of the Beauty team, working on a portfolio of our Beauty client relationships, utilising extensive industry knowledge to provide valuable insights to solve their business challenges. The Senior Insight Manager is a crucial member of the team, and the ideal candidate would need to have a high degree of autonomy and problem-solving capabilities. The candidate should have a track record of using innovative and inspiring insight to grow our client’s business, paired with superb organizational and interpersonal engagement skills to deliver an all-round excellent service to the client.

This role will have the requirement to travel to the client’s office (as when needed) and Circana’s Head Office in Bracknell (roughly once per month). In the role you will be mentored, trained, and supported to become a high performing member of an ambitious and career development focused team.

Main Responsibilities

Coordinates, executes, analyses, and presents findings from a variety of insight projects commissioned by the client; positioning in an influential manner with recommendations, actions and quantified new opportunities. Working in a Partnership with an Account Director/SIM on specific clients – to create workshops (based on client briefing and/or proactively suggest areas in relation to the client and market content)To creatively cut through data and clutter to identify what is most important to the client. Full understanding, and the ability to articulate the ‘value’, of the full range of Circana services, including Analytics, Shopper, Field and Technology Solutions. To act as a business consultant leveraging the breadth of Circana solutions in the pursuit of delivering business growth and efficiencies. Commercial responsibility for the day to day financial and contractual management of the client. Drive engagement and penetration of Circana across all client functions through the execution of effective engagement strategies. Provide your customers with thought leadership/added value through your analysis and strategic recommendations. Position yourself as a privileged client partner within an in depth knowledge & understanding of Circana solutionsA real in depth & solid, understanding of their business priorities, as well as challenge outside of their context in relation to the state of the economy, and what does this mean, and how could we engage on other topicsBuild strategic relationships with Top Management client contacts (General Manager, Marketing Director) to understand knowledge of the clients’ most important business issues/needs in order to drive actionable recommendations for growing their businessAchieve revenue target for your client portfolio by identifying new commercial opportunitiesProactively Propose creative and innovative solutions to meet the needs of your clients and develop revenue in close collaboration with our team of expertsDevelop and leverage strong, collaborative relationships with external and internal stakeholders and work closely with other Circana functions to deliver an all-round positive client experience. First point of contact for clients on day-to-day issues and champion the clients need within the wider Circana organisation. Responsible for updating all business performance metrics and accurate financial reporting. Travel to client office and Circana main office (Bracknell). 

Skills And Experience

High degree of experience in the application of market measurement dataAbility to articulate complex technical knowledge of solutions in a simple impactful manner. Effective team player and proven ability to work remotely as well as onsite with clients across virtual and diverse teams. Leverages mutually beneficial relationships and networks strongly both internally and externally. Ability to proactively manage a client relationship and drive improvements in client satisfaction. Strong project and workload management and proactive management of internal and external stakeholder expectations. Able to engage in a consultative manner with clients at all levels when helping solve/manage content deliverables and critical business challenges. Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills as demonstrated by the ability to use appropriate method to communicate with clients, professional presence, ability to understand and respond to another’s point of view. Demonstrated resilience and sound judgment in dealing with business and corporate challenges and change. 

Other Requirements

Administrative accountability: financial and business reporting, adheres to corporate policies, meets deadlines on corporate initiatives surrounding personal development and input into business planning. Strong commercial acumen and appreciation of contractual obligations. Escalates issues to the right people appropriately. Expense management. Coaching and development of any direct report/s, ability to provide constructive feedback with a focus on improving storytelling skills and best practice use of market measurement data. Ensure 100% compliance of all core HR and Finance processes. Learn and work on meaningful initiatives with some of the best and brightest in the market research industry. Circana provides the world’s most successful brands with leading market research, combining consumer and retail point-of-sale data with analytic solutions to interpret today’s market trends while anticipating tomorrow’s. We are looking for an enthusiastic and innovative person with a real passion & knowledge for the Beauty industry and appetite for commercial challenges. 

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviour's sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid – easy access to London (were clients are based)

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

rows.title: Director, Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Epsilon is seeking a Director, Analytic Consulting to join our Analytics Consulting practice, part of the Analytic Services team. This role provides a clear, strategic, forward-looking analytics vision that enables effective decision making, improves paid media effectiveness, and delivers measurable business impact for clients.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Data Science, AI, Strategy, Client Services, Product, and Delivery teams to translate complex marketing and media challenges into scalable analytic solutions. You will support consultative client engagements, define measurement approaches for paid and owned channels, and help clients adopt Epsilon’s analytic capabilities, proprietary datasets, cleanroom environments, and media measurement solutions.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative, data-driven, client-first analytics leader with deep experience in paid media analytics, audience measurement, campaign performance, segmentation, and marketing effectiveness. This individual can design and guide complex analytic solutions, simplify technical concepts for business audiences, and coordinate talented onshore and offshore analytics teams in the execution and delivery of high-quality client work.

Responsibilities

Serve as a client-facing analytics lead for paid media measurement, audience analytics, and marketing effectiveness engagements across relationships of varying size and complexityDefine paid media measurement strategies for brand, performance, and customer-level campaigns, creating alignment on KPI frameworks, success metrics, and reporting expectations across client and internal collaboratorsPartner with client marketing, media, analytics, and agency teams to interpret results and recommend optimizations across audience, placement, channel, creative, offer, budget allocation, and campaign strategyTranslate complex methodologies, including experimentation, causal inference, attribution, segmentation, predictive modeling, incrementality, and closed-loop measurement, into clear, client-friendly insights and guidanceAccess and analyze data in Epsilon’s proprietary tools, PeopleCloud, cleanroom environments, CDPs, and other data platforms to measure audience quality, media exposure, campaign outcomes, online and offline sales impact, and customer behaviorOversee media data readiness, ingestion, and quality requirements to ensure audience and campaign reporting is feasible based on client advertising operations, owned digital ecosystems, and available data assetsDevelop and communicate actionable insights, optimization recommendations, executive-ready narratives, and quantifiable business impact to clients and senior collaboratorsAuthor and contribute to analytic plans, technical requirements, project estimates, statements of work, timelines, deliverables, and resource plans that support successful executionDevelop measurement procedures, benchmarks, tool playbooks, and ways of working that support repeatable, scalable paid media analytics deliveryCoach, mentor, and develop analytics team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture focused on client value, innovation, and continuous improvement

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative rigor such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Marketing Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field8+ years of hands-on, relevant experience in analytics, data science, marketing analytics, or digital media analyticsDemonstrated experience analyzing paid media performance across channels such as programmatic, search, social, display, video, connected TV, experiential, and out-of-home, including understanding how these channels contribute to digital and broader marketing measurementDeep understanding of customer-level marketing analytics, audience creation, segmentation, campaign performance measurement, testing, attribution, incrementality, closed-loop measurement, and optimizationExperience measuring audience performance using first-party data, Epsilon-owned data assets, CDPs, cleanroom environments, media exposure data, and other combined data sourcesAbility to design and implement analyses using large record-level datasets, including advertising impressions, site visitation, audience attributes, campaign activity, online sales, offline sales, and customer behavior dataProficiency with SQL, Python, or similar data manipulation and analytic toolsStrong planning, prioritization, and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple analytics projects, requests, timelines, and resources concurrentlyExcellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to simplify complexity, foster dialogue across teams, and present analytic findings in a clear, compelling, business-focused mannerSkilled in data visualization and executive-level storytelling to communicate the value of analytics to senior collaboratorsProven ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams including Strategy, Client Services, Product, Technology, Data Science, AI, Delivery, and AnalyticsExperience managing, coaching, and developing analytics team members, including coordination of junior, onshore, and offshore resourcesHighly motivated, collaborative, intellectually curious, and results-oriented, with a focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and client value realization

Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent

Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or a related quantitative fieldFamiliarity with Databricks or similar large-scale analytics platformsExperience with data visualization tools and executive reporting environmentsExperience with media mix modeling, fractional attribution, multi-touch attribution, brand lift, incrementality testing, sales lift, and other marketing measurement solutions.Familiarity with Google Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, cleanroom platforms, CDPs, DMPs, ad servers, and major paid media platformsUnderstanding of the MarTech and AdTech landscape, including how analytics drives value realization from media, identity, activation, measurement, and reporting platforms

Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

rows.title: Client Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Circana is looking for professional and sharp analytic minds to execute, analyze and present findings to our Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) client’s category management, brand, sales, and trade marketing groups. Use your energy and motivation to evaluate research data, find key points, and recommend action steps to directly impact the bottom line for our client.

Job Responsibilities

Analytic Capability: Use a systematic approach to solving problems that involve breaking it into smaller pieces, tracking the implications of situations, generating multiple alternatives, and making comparisons of potential solutions before taking action. Quality Control: Drive to achieve high-quality results through effective data integrity. Planning and Organizing: Determine effort and resources required to meet objectives; able to plan, coordinate and manage resources effectively to ensure task completion. Client Focus: Consistently act with client satisfaction in mind and follow through on commitments to ensure the needs of the client are met. 

Requirements

3+ years of experience with syndicated data, analytics, category management, or related fieldsMarketing and/or sales with a premier Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) company or other companies using syndicated, POS or Panel dataDemonstrated expertise in translating data and analysis into relevant implicationsExperience with syndicated dataStrong critical thinking, project management and process skillsAble to engage in consultative manner with clients when helping solve/manage content deliverablesRobust Microsoft Skills including Excel and Power PointBachelor's Degree

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid position, may require 2 days onsite at Oak Brook, IL client location.

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role $60,000-$75,000.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

JOB BAND: D

CONTRACT TYPE: Attachment / Fixed-term, Full-time until 02/11/2027

DEPARTMENT: BBC iPlayer & Channels

LOCATION: Salford

PROPOSED SALARY RANGE: £42,000 - £52,000 plus London Weighting depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.

We're happy to discuss flexible working. If you'd like to, please indicate your preference in the application – though there's no obligation to do so now. Flexible working will be part of the discussion at offer stage.

Please note: this role will be mapped to the career path framework role of Senior Editorial Manager.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The BBC Youth Audiences team is seeking a YouTube Entertainment Community Lead to grow and manage the audience for a new entertainment channel targeting UK 16-34-year-olds. Reporting to the YouTube Entertainment Editor, you will drive engagement, community growth and channel operations, creating a distinctive voice and building loyal audiences across YouTube and social platforms. The role suits someone with proven experience managing entertainment communities and a strong understanding of engagement, publishing, scheduling and audience development.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

This is an opportunity to play a leading role in building a new BBC entertainment destination for young audiences. You'll help shape not just what we publish, but how audiences engage with it, grow around it and become part of its community.

rows.title: Senior Financial Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  About the teamRoku’s Supply Chain Finance team provides global business support to our Logistics, Warehousing, Sourcing, and Demand Planning teams. We provide line-of-sight on our operational health to the top executive levels and work closely with our business partners to set up the most optimal supply chain structure for businesses. About the roleRoku is looking for an exceptional Sr. Financial Analyst to support Roku’s hardware Operations team. This role will play a critical role in supporting the continued growth and execution of Roku’s worldwide Operations and will help develop scalable and intuitive reporting and forecasting solutions to drive business insight that is relevant and digestible.The successful candidate will be able to communicate effectively, possess strong analytical skills, and manage multiple and time sensitive deliverables across a highly matrixed organization. The ideal candidate will have endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution.For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $125,000 - $137,700 annually.

update/maintain various financial models as necessary to support ongoing forecast deliverablesAnalyze and monitor component forecast inputs against targetsIdentify and implement systemic, scalable solutions thru technology to optimize finance processes for speed, agility and insightPerform ad hoc analyses and projects as needed We’re excited if you haveBA/BS in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Supply Chain or a similar analytical discipline (e.g. Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Data Science); MBA/CPA preferred4+ years of FP&A experience supporting hardware or product engineering organizations, ideally at a high growth tech companyUnderstanding of COGs, BOMs, and/or inventory accountingStrong analytical skill, with a passion for metrics and data; ability to apply in order to influence and drive effective decision makingAdvanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to digest, analyze and comprehend large amounts of data and maintain complex financial models; demonstrated proficiency with advanced functions (index, offsets, arrays, etc.)Experience leveraging business intelligence tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)Experience with Anaplan & NetSuiteExperience leveraging AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to optimize workloads and build visualization toolsBias for action, ability to identify and effectively prioritize critical workstreams, meet competing deadlines while managing multiple projectsMeticulous attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environmentStrong communicator, collaborator, and connector across multiple cross functional departments  What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. rows.title: Operational Risk Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna's Operational Risk team covers a global product portfolio, and the calls made there rest on the quality of the underlying data and control testing — not just the frameworks on paper. You'll drive data-informed risk management across that portfolio: pulling signal out of structured and unstructured data, running independent control tests and process reviews, and turning what you find into decisions the business and risk functions can act on.

You'll work directly with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations — feeding your findings into how Klarna's risk controls evolve and into the regulatory reporting and governance that keeps the bank compliant across markets.

What You'll Do

You'll analyze structured and unstructured data to monitor risk performance and surface emerging patterns across Klarna's product portfolio.You'll turn your analysis into concrete recommendations that support business and risk decisions.You'll run independent control testing and process reviews to evaluate whether existing risk frameworks actually hold up.You'll contribute to regulatory reporting and governance processes.You'll work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to identify and implement improvements to risk controls.

Who You Are

You've spent 5+ years working in fintech, banking, or consulting, with a focus on risk management.You've run independent data analysis to support risk initiatives, not just consumed analysis someone else produced.You've conducted control testing and process reviews inside a risk or compliance function.You understand the regulatory requirements that apply to Klarna's markets and have supported risk reporting processes before.You communicate findings clearly to stakeholders outside risk — Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations — and adjust your explanation to the audience.

Bonus points for

A relevant certification such as CFE or CRCMP.Experience working with data models, analytics techniques, or automated decision systems.A background in payments specifically, alongside broader financial services.A degree in Finance, Risk Management, Data Science, or a related field.

Things you should know before applying

Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost.

Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site!

rows.title: Graduate Programme 2027: Applied AI Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Graduate Programme

Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates who want to launch their careers in fintech. Over this 12-month programme, you’ll work on real projects, solve complex challenges, and make an impact from day one. With structured training and hands-on experience, you’ll grow your skills while exploring different areas of the business.

Top performers can be promoted during or after the programme, giving you the chance to continue your journey at Revolut.

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions, collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for Graduate Applied AI Engineers who can combine product ownership with technical execution. You’ll identify how AI can solve high-value problems, guide product strategy, and manage the models, data, architecture, and evaluation needed to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

Experience in product-related workExperience as an entrepreneur or working in a startup

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

rows.title: Senior Product Manager - Mortgage Pricing
rows.descriptionText:
Ready to shape how HSBC prices UK mortgages in a fast-moving market? 

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

Mortgages & Savings UK sits within Retail Banking & Wealth (RBW) and is responsible for Mortgages (HSBC and first direct) and Savings (HSBC, first direct and M&S). This role supports the commercial performance and growth strategy for HSBC’s UK mortgage portfolio across HSBC UK and first direct by defining and executing effective pricing decisions. The portfolio represents approximately +£140bn of mortgage balances and the wider Mortgages & Savings portfolios include c.£170bn of deposit balances. You’ll set dynamic mortgage pricing strategies that balance market share, margin and risk appetite while keeping customer outcomes and fair value at the centre. Working closely with Product Heads, Planning & Performance teams, Finance, Treasury and Analytics teams, you’ll align pricing decisions with lending objectives, funding, hedging and liquidity considerations across the RBW balance sheet. Success looks like pricing decisions that are well-governed, executable at pace, and measurably improve customer and commercial outcomes across brands, channels and platforms.

What You'll Be Doing

 Shape mortgage pricing strategy with Product leadership and the Head of Pricing, Planning & Performance translating strategic intent into pricing outcomes  Own end-to-end mortgage pricing decisions and outcomes across new business and retention from design and validation through to execution and performance tracking  Establish and agree pricing principles, guardrails and rate architecture direction to support consistent decisions at pace particularly through market volatility  Define the operating model, decision rights and internal governance that enables pace-to-market with strong control, transparency and auditability  Optimise trade-offs between volume, margin and credit risk appetite within agreed risk appetite and conduct standards  Partner with Treasury, Finance, Credit Risk and Planning & Performance to align pricing with funding, capital and risk-return priorities  Embed market and customer insight including competitor intelligence, macro signals and behavioural modelling to anticipate market moves and take proactive pricing action 

What We're Looking For

 Bring deep expertise in Retail Banking and the UK mortgage regulatory and conduct expectations including FCA fair value and customer outcomes and pricing transparency  Demonstrate strong understanding of balance sheet mechanics, financial drivers and commercial awareness that influence pricing and performance  Show strong grasp of end-to-end pricing delivery and control disciplines including governance, audit trail, testing and release management, MI and post-implementation review  Use digital and data fluency in pricing including data quality and lineage, model risk governance and practical use of automation and AI-enabled tooling  Partner effectively across Product, Finance, Treasury, Risk and Distribution with demonstrable delivery through cross-functional teams and governance 

Building stronger mortgage outcomes

This is a key role in shaping how HSBC competes and performs in the UK mortgage market across HSBC UK and first direct. You’ll turn market insight and portfolio analytics into pricing decisions that protect long-term franchise value while delivering fair value for customers. You’ll also set the standards for governance, transparency and control that allow decisions to move at pace without compromising quality. If you’re looking to apply deep mortgage pricing expertise at material balance sheet scale we’d welcome your application

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

rows.title: Credit Risk Data Analyst

Join us at Barclays as a Credit Risk Data Analyst. As part of the A-IRB Programme, you will support the delivery of critical regulatory objectives by translating business and regulatory requirements into clear requirements, data specifications, and solution designs. Working across business, risk, and technology teams, you will drive requirements capture, stakeholder engagement, data analysis, and support testing and governance activities to enable successful A-IRB implementation.

To be successful as a Credit Risk Data Analyst, you should have experience with:


Solid business & data analysis capability, including translating regulatory (IRB) requirements into structured requirements and data specificationsExperience working with credit risk data (e.g. PD, LGD, EAD) and understanding data lineage, quality, and controlsExperience in IRB / Basel / regulatory change programmes or similar risk transformation initiativesAbility to engage stakeholders across business, risk and technology to gather, challenge and refine requirements


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Knowledge of data tooling, data modelling, or MI/reporting environmentsExperience working in structured delivery environments (e.g. L0–L3 requirements, Agile or large-scale programmes)


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in Canary Wharf, Northampton or Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

Accountabilities


Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes.
