We help organisations turn ambitious AI ideas into production-ready products and measurable business outcomes, bringing together expertise across AI engineering, data science, product management and responsible AI.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for AI and Data Science professionals from Consultant to Senior Manager to help organisations unlock value from AI, machine learning, data science and intelligent automation.

As a leading Data and AI Professional, depending on your experience and area of expertise, your focus may range from hands-on technical delivery and solution development through to leading client engagements, shaping AI strategy, developing teams and contributing to account and capability growth.

You do not need to cover every area of AI. We value strong foundations, relevant depth and the ability to learn as technology and client needs evolve.

In this role you will play a key role in:

 Designing, building and deploying machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI solutions, turning business challenges into practical prototypes, products and scalable enterprise capabilities. Developing applications and pipelines that connect AI models, enterprise data, APIs, tools and existing technology platforms, applying appropriate software engineering, MLOps, LLMOps and AI governance practices. Working with clients and multidisciplinary teams to understand business objectives, shape solutions and deliver measurable outcomes through AI and data-driven transformation. Depending on your grade and experience, leading workstreams, client engagements or multidisciplinary teams, and helping clients shape AI strategies, operating models and transformation roadmaps. Contributing to client account growth and the development of propositions, colleagues and Capgemini Invent's AI capability.

Role

As part of your role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. Practice Development – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. Learning & development – Training, certifications and professional development opportunities that support your career and the skills needed within the company.

YOUR PROFILE

You bring strong problem-solving skills and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical actions, communicate technical ideas clearly and work constructively with clients, colleagues and other stakeholders.You have experience, or for more junior candidates the potential, to deliver technical work within a team environment, balancing experimentation, quality, risk and business value.You have experience or potential in one or more areas including Data Science, Applied AI, Generative AI, AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, AI Architecture or Data & AI Consulting. You are not expected to have expertise across every area, and the breadth and depth expected will depend on the grade.You build positive working relationships, communicate with credibility and connect technical decisions to business outcomes. At more senior grades, you bring strong commercial awareness, develop trusted client relationships, coach colleagues and contribute to propositions and account growth.

Ideally, you will bring a combination of consulting experience and the relevant technical expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

We are a collaborative and learning-focused team. We share knowledge, support each other and take a practical approach to solving complex client challenges as the AI landscape evolves.

Through regular learning and development days, knowledge-sharing initiatives and inclusive team events, you will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, broaden your experience and contribute to a connected community working on exciting AI projects.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self At Cap to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government’s Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

 Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Please note : Candidates applying to these roles, need to live in England or Wales at the time of application.

Csr

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. rows.title: Graduate software engineer, US
rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesBuild software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale.Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends.Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education.Competitive pay. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of $164,852in the United States. For candidates we assess as possessing exceptional potential and highly unusual achievement, compensation typically ranges $209,694 to $425,639. Compensation varies by location and expected impact. In higher-cost markets such as New York City, offers are generally positioned toward the upper end of the range. As you grow your expertise and increase your contributions, your compensation can grow rapidly alongside your impact.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location
Atlanta (GA), Boston (MA), Miami (FL), New York (NY), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

rows.title: AI Product and Innovation Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About The Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

At Capgemini Invent, the Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team helps organizations unlock the full value of their data and AI investments to drive meaningful, scalable change. As part of Capgemini's Strategy & Transformation Consulting practice, DDT partners with clients to shape data-centric strategies, modern operating models, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Our unified team model brings together expertise across Data & AI Advisory, Data Platforms & Architecture, and Applied Data Fusion, enabling seamless collaboration from strategy through execution.

Your Role

You will own AI-focused workstreams end-to-end and act as a trusted day-to-day client partner.

Key Responsibilities Include

 Own workstreams from discovery through delivery. Lead stakeholder interviews. Evaluate AI platforms and tools. Shape AI opportunity roadmaps. Develop executive-ready presentations. Lead readiness assessments. Map processes and data flows. Contribute to thought leadership.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

 5–6 years in consulting, product management, analytics, or related fields. Ability to structure ambiguity and produce executive recommendations. Knowledge of LLMs, data pipelines, model evaluation, and semantic layers. Strategic storytelling and analytical modeling skills. Comfort with emerging technology.

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $112,600- $212,700

rows.title: Decision Analytics Associate Consultant - Business Analytics & Insights
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Insights & Analytics

ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.   

Decision Analytics Associate Consultant: Business Analytics & Insights

As a Decision Analytics Associate Consultant, you will serve as a strategic thought partner to client stakeholders, helping translate complex analytics into actionable business decisions. Working at the intersection of analytics, consulting and business strategy, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape analytical approaches, guide problem-solving, interpret findings and communicate insights that drive impact. This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy connecting data to business outcomes, influencing decision-makers and partnering with teams to deliver meaningful results in a fast-growing and highly visible environment.

What You’ll Do

Develop and apply analytical frameworks and statistical approaches that help clients understand complex business issues and make informed decisions.Leverage analytic techniques to use data to guide clients and ZS team decision-making. Partner with analytical teams to design and interpret analyses using tools such as SQL, Python, R, Excel, and cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), and bring insights to life using Tableau, Power BI, or AI-assisted visualization tools. Synthesize and communicate results to clients and ZS teams through oral and written presentations. Develop client relationships and serve as key point of contact on aspects of projects. Provide client and ZS teams project status updates. Create project deliverables and implement solutions. Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities; Guide and mentor Associates on teams.Partner with clients and project teams to define business problems, shape analytical approaches and translate insights into strategic recommendations. Guide and mentor analytical teams by providing direction, reviewing work quality and helping ensure solutions address key business objectives. Serve as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders by connecting analytical findings to business implications and actionable outcomes. Collaborate across cross-functional and global teams to drive alignment, solve complex business challenges and support decision-making. Stay informed on emerging analytics and AI capabilities and identify opportunities to enhance business insights and client impact.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's or master's degree is required in any discipline with strong record of academic success in quantitative and analytic coursework such as operations research, applied mathematics, management science, data science, statistics, econometrics or engineering. 2-4 years of relevant post-collegiate job experience. A PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience. Ability to connect analytical insights to business strategy and communicate findings effectively to diverse stakeholder groups. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and influencing decision-making in a client-facing, consulting or business-partner capacity. Demonstrated ability to guide workstreams, mentor junior team members and provide analytical direction. Curiosity about emerging technologies and artificial intelligence, with an interest in applying new capabilities to business challenges. Healthcare, pharmaceutical or life sciences experience is beneficial but not required.High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative. Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex analyses into clear, compelling business narratives.Empathy, adaptability and emotional intelligence. Close attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset. Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks. Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, working in teams. Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

www.zs.com

Senior Data Analyst / Data Migration Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking two highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Analysts / Information Architecture Specialists to join our SAP S/4HANA Data team. These roles are critical for ensuring the success of our data migration and downstream data delivery efforts. The ideal candidates will possess a strong technical foundation in data analysis, profiling, and sourcing, combined with an understanding of modern information architecture and a strong interest in AI technologies.

 Data Quality & Migration Focus: Driving data quality management within the data migration workstream. Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG’s respectful and courteous work environment

Deep functional and technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Finance data domains. Prior experience navigating and extracting/cleansing data from legacy SAP ECC environments. Practical experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools/concepts and a strong, demonstrated interest in leveraging AI for data management. Demonstrated experience running data project workstreams and interacting directly with end data consumers. Exceptional organizational and communication skills, with a track record of successfully bridging the gap between IT and business stakeholders.

rows.descriptionText:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About The Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

At Capgemini Invent, the Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team helps organizations unlock the full value of their data and AI investments to drive meaningful, scalable change. As part of Capgemini's Strategy & Transformation Consulting practice, DDT partners with clients to shape data-centric strategies, modern operating models, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Our unified team model brings together expertise across Data & AI Advisory, Data Platforms & Architecture, and Applied Data Fusion, enabling seamless collaboration from strategy through execution.

Your Role

You will own AI-focused workstreams end-to-end and act as a trusted day-to-day client partner.

Key Responsibilities Include

 Own workstreams from discovery through delivery. Lead stakeholder interviews. Evaluate AI platforms and tools. Shape AI opportunity roadmaps. Develop executive-ready presentations. Lead readiness assessments. Map processes and data flows. Contribute to thought leadership.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

 5–6 years in consulting, product management, analytics, or related fields. Ability to structure ambiguity and produce executive recommendations. Knowledge of LLMs, data pipelines, model evaluation, and semantic layers. Strategic storytelling and analytical modeling skills. Comfort with emerging technology.

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Senior Marketing Analytics Lead

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Senior Analytics Lead to drive insight generation and performance optimization across global marketing and communications initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of data, storytelling, and business impact.

The Senior Analytics Lead will translate complex data into actionable recommendations that shape marketing strategy, enhance customer engagement, and improve ROI. Reporting to the Marketing Technology & Operations Director, this individual will independently lead high-impact analytics workstreams while mentoring junior team members and partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

This is an ideal role for a data-driven leader who combines strong technical expertise with business acumen and executive-level communication skills.

What You’ll Do

Lead end-to-end analytics projects supporting global marketing and communications programs.Develop measurement frameworks aligned to business objectives and marketing KPIs.Translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable insights.Partner with marketing leadership to influence campaign strategy, budget allocation, and channel optimization.Design and implement reporting frameworks across digital, content, brand, and demand-generation initiatives.Own dashboards and executive-ready reporting that drive decision-making.Conduct attribution modeling, campaign performance analysis, and ROI assessments.Ensure data integrity, consistency, and best practices in measurement methodologies.Collaborate with data engineering and technology teams to enhance data pipelines and analytics capabilities.Champion the adoption of advanced analytics techniques where appropriate (e.g., predictive modeling, segmentation, marketing mix modeling).Act as a trusted advisor to marketing, communications, and business stakeholders, presenting insights and recommendations to senior leaders in a clear, compelling manner.Manage cross-functional relationships across regions and business units in a global environment.Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on analytical rigor and storytelling.Support the firm building scalable marketing analytics capabilities.Contribute to the evolution of analytics best practices within the function.

What You’ll Bring

5-7 years of experience in marketing & communications technologyUser-first thinker who believes good architecture enables great experiencesDemonstrated ability to communicate/translate big picture needs to actionable itemDeep understanding of system integrations, APIs, identity, search, and content platformsExperience working within large, complex organizationsComfort translating between technical teams and non-technical stakeholdersPragmatic problem-solver who knows when to innovate and when to standardizeCollaborative partner who enjoys working across IT, internal communications, and business teamsCurious, adaptable, and motivated by building things that people actually useFluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

www.zs.com

The AI System SW/HW Co-design team’s mission is to explore, develop, and help productize high-performance software and hardware technologies for AI at datacenter scale. We achieve this via concurrent design, performance projection, and optimization of many aspects of the system such as models, algorithms, numerics, performance, and AI hardware including compute, networking, and storage. We drive the AI HW roadmap at Meta and ensure our existing and future AI workloads and software are well optimized and suited for new infrastructure. Meta is looking for an experienced communications leader to lead the Intelligence & Insights (I&I) function within the Communications & Public Affairs organization. rows.title: Global Community Assistant
rows.descriptionText:
GLOBAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & COMMUNITY ASSISTANT

RIMMEL, MAX FACTOR, BOURJOIS

LONDON

Immediate starting

13 months

We’re Coty, a global leader in beauty. We’re World #1 in Fragrance,

and World #3 in Colour Cosmetics. Our iconic portfolio of brands are sold in over 150 countries around the world. We believe in beauty with a purpose and brands that inspire, no matter where they are in the world.

BACKGROUND TO THE ROLE

The Global Social Media Content & Community Assistant supports the development and execution of social-first content, community engagement and cultural conversations across a portfolio of colour cosmetics brands.

Working closely with Global Brand Teams, Creative, Advocacy & Influencer Marketing, Digital Commerce and local markets, this role helps bring brand storytelling to life across social platforms. From content planning and asset management to community insights, social reporting and trend spotting, the role plays a key part in ensuring brands remain culturally relevant, socially engaging and connected to consumers.

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious marketer looking to develop expertise in content creation, social media strategy, community management and modern brand building within the beauty industry.

Key Responsibilities

Social Content Development

Support the creation and execution of global social media content plans across key platforms including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and emerging channels. Assist in building social content calendars aligned with product launches, campaigns and cultural moments. Coordinate social content assets across internal teams, creative partners, agencies and markets. Support briefing, review and approval processes for social-first content. Assist in adapting campaign assets for platform-specific social execution. Maintain content libraries and ensure all assets are organised and accessible globally. 

Community Management & Consumer Engagement

Support the monitoring of brand communities across social platforms. Track conversations, comments and consumer sentiment to identify opportunities and risks. Assist in community engagement planning and best-practice recommendations for markets. Monitor emerging topics and cultural conversations relevant to the brands. Help identify opportunities to increase brand participation in relevant consumer conversations. Support social listening activities to better understand audience needs and behaviours. Contribute to building stronger consumer communities and advocacy opportunities across the portfolio. 

Content Creator & Advocacy Coordination

Partner closely with the Influencer Marketing and PR Team to coordinate creator content usage and timing across brand social channels. Assist in managing asset requests and content approvals. Support tracking of content performance and engagement. Help identify social content trends and formats that can be amplified through brand channels. Assist with content organisation and rights management. 

Trend & Cultural Insights

Monitor emerging platform trends, content formats, social innovations and viral conversations. Track beauty, fashion, entertainment and lifestyle trends influencing consumers. Conduct competitive social audits and benchmarking. Share regular trend reports and inspiration with the wider marketing organisation. Help identify opportunities for real-time content and cultural participation. 

Campaign & Launch Support

Support the execution of major campaign launches across social platforms. Assist in coordinating global launch assets and market implementation materials. Coordinate social content requirements across cross-functional stakeholders. 

Analytics & Reporting

Monitor engagement, reach, video views, audience growth and content effectiveness. Support preparation of monthly and quarterly social performance reports. Track campaign performance against KPIs and benchmarks. Help identify opportunities to optimise content strategy and community engagement. 

Project & Operational Management

Maintain content calendars, project timelines and status trackers. Support budget administration, purchase orders and agency management processes. Support preparation of leadership presentations and social media updates. 

What You Will Bring

Required Competencies: 

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business or related discipline. Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and emerging social platforms. Passion for beauty, fashion, culture and consumer trends. Excellent organisational and project management skills. Strong written communication and storytelling ability. Analytical mindset with an interest in data and performance tracking. Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. Familiarity with social listening, analytics and social media management tools is advantageous. 

Required Behaviours:

Passionate about social culture and consumer behaviour. Naturally curious and highly trend-aware. Creative thinker with strong attention to detail. Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Proactive and solution-oriented with a can-do attitude. Commercially minded with a strong understanding of modern brand building. Enthusiastic about creating content that connects brands with consumers.

Global Marketing – New York, NY

COTY is looking for smart leaders who are fast and passionate. 

Covergirl and Sally Hansen are looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our team. You will work under key team leaders while contributing to brand strategy and business needs.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter that is passionate for beauty and brands, organized, creative, analytical and eager to learn and collaborate across a broad array of teams and stakeholders.

Responsibilities

As our Global Marketing Coordinator, you are responsible for the following:

Your main focus:

Day to Day Brand Marketing Team Support Support the Covergirl and Sally Hansen Brand Marketing teams on day to day operations, including: Retail sales data pulls Brand sales performance tracking and analysis Competitive product ordering, product evaluation and marketing/sales performance analysis Internal product ordering Shade analysis Product, product name, shade name and claims ideation. Our Benefits

As our Global Marketing Coordinator is unique role with a genuine opportunity to make an impact. You’ll get to work in a diverse environment with a team of professionals who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way.

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money — we're here to move our global customers forward. We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career — we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is building the Remitly Global Card: a card, wallet, and built-in credit line that give customers a single, trusted place to hold, spend, borrow, and move their money, launching across multiple geographies. As a Senior Data Engineer on the Global Card team, you will own the engineering of the team's data foundation end to end: the pipelines that bring in card, credit, payments, and product data; the schemas and data marts that analysts and data scientists rely on; and the checks that keep that data accurate and on time. You will lead the technical direction for this space: partnering with product, analytics, and data science on what to build, anticipating problems early, and choosing right-sized designs that scale with the business. Our team works across the stack to get the job done, so you will also contribute to the backend services that power our products as the need arises. We move fast, use agentic coding tools every day, and hold a high bar for excellence. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work from our Arlington, VA office on a hybrid schedule.

You Will:

Own the data foundation: Design, build, and operate the schemas, pipelines, and data marts behind Remitly Global Card across card, credit, and payments, including the feature pipelines that supply our credit and fraud models. Partner with data scientists on feature definitions and validation.Lead technical direction: Define the architecture and roadmap for our data systems, anticipate where the business is headed, and choose designs that fit the problem and stay fast, reliable, and cost-efficient as we scale.Build trust in our data: Put data quality and monitoring in place across our marts and model features: testable freshness and reliability targets; completeness, consistency, and business-rule checks; automated tests for pipeline changes; and alerts with clear owners. Diagnose failures, manage safe backfills and recovery, and validate data against source records.Turn business needs into data products: Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to shape requirements and turn them into reusable schemas and data contracts, well-modeled tables, shared metric definitions, and documentation, including lineage, so that people and AI tools can run their own queries and build their own dashboards.Raise the engineering bar: Set standards for data modeling, design and code review, CI/CD, access control, and sensitive data handling, including retention and deletion. Review mart changes from other contributors, and use agentic coding tools to move faster while validating generated code and protecting sensitive data.Work across the stack: Build and improve the backend services that power our products as the need arises, and work with platform teams to reuse and extend shared data infrastructure, tooling, and standards.Mentor and grow the team: Guide engineers and analysts through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing. Represent Remitly's cultural values and technical competencies in interviews.

You Have:

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.Expert SQL and strong data modeling skills, including dimensional modeling, schema evolution, and designing tables that analysts and data scientists can use at scale.Experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines, including orchestration, incremental batch loads, and streaming, using distributed processing or query engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, EMR) on cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), with data quality checks, testing, and monitoring built in.Proficiency in at least one programming language used for data and backend work (e.g., Python, Scala, Java, Go), and experience building and operating backend services.Experience leading projects at the team level, including setting technical direction, breaking work into parallel workstreams, estimating timelines, and mentoring other engineers.Demonstrated ability to partner with product, analytics, and data science stakeholders to turn ambiguous business needs into clear technical plans and drive decisions to resolution.Experience using AI tools throughout your development workflow, with sound judgment about reviewing and testing generated code and protecting sensitive data.5+ years of data engineering experience in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.Bonus: Experience with financial data in fintech, lending, or payments, where accuracy, security, and compliance shape engineering decisions.

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $180,000-$225,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.We are committed to nondiscrimination across our global organization and in all of our business operations. Employment is determined based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identification and expression, marital status, military status or status as an honorably discharge/veteran, pregnancy (including a woman's potential to get pregnant, pregnancy-related conditions, and childbearing), sexual orientation, age (40 and over), national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical, mental, or sensory disability (including the use of a trained dog guide or service animal), HIV/AIDS or hepatitis C status, genetic information, status as an actual or perceived victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking, or any other protected class as established by law.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This is a strategy, analytics, and operations role involving planning, building, and executing initiatives across product, pricing, marketing, risk/fraud, analytics, customer service, engineering, and other departments. You will report to the USA To Latin America & Caribbean (USA-LAC) General Manager and work in a hybrid environment from our Seattle, Arlington/Washington DC, or New York City office.

Own sustainable growth in your cluster of USA to Caribbean corridors, measured against key performance indicators like new customers, monthly active customers, transactions, volume, revenue, and profitability. Serve as the market expert for your corridors, building a deep understanding of customers and their communities in the US, the competitive set, and the receive-side ecosystem (payout partners, regulation, and local market conditions), and bringing that context and customer insights into decisions across the business. Define both the long and short term strategic vision for growth in your corridors, and the tactical roadmap of initiatives for how to achieve that vision.Partner closely with and drive action across pricing, product, marketing, risk/fraud, and other relevant teams: set a clear point of view on what your corridors need, push for decisions and launches, and follow through to measured results. Support commercial conversations with disbursement and destination partners in your markets, turning partner opportunities into customer-facing offers. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and customer trends, translating insights into regional priorities. Build business cases for key initiatives and influence prioritization of partner-teams' roadmaps through structured business impact / customer centric frameworks. Drive ideation of regional product initiatives, and work with the US-LAC product, engineering, and design team to translate customer and commercial opportunities into clear requirements. Support the development cycles & measure outcomes post launch. Share learnings with the other Regional Business Managers and the US-LAC GM so that what works in one cluster can be applied across the region.

5+ years of professional experience in business management, growth, or general management roles in a B2C context, ideally in money movement, fintech, or financial services. Native level fluency in Spanish (required) An ownership mentality and a track record of ownership. We are looking for someone with a bias for action who “gets things done” and is hungry to grow their areas of the business. Ideally you have: owned a market, product, or P&L end to end and driven results across some combination of pricing, product, marketing, and risk/fraud. Deep regional and cultural expertise, gained through lived experience, professional experience in the region, or both, including an understanding of the migrant community in the US and how customers send and receive money in these markets. Demonstrated problem solving skills (qualitative and quantitative). Can generate high quality hypotheses and dive into an ambiguous problem statement. Ability to balance compassionate partnership and the ability to be constructively direct. You will influence and network within the business and with external partners.

Preferred:

Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services. Ideally serving immigrant communities in the US or customers in the Caribbean. Product experience OR growth / marketing experience in the areas noted above.

On the receive side, we let businesses and sellers get paid in USD, hold balances in stable currency, and withdraw across Remitly's 170+ country disbursement network.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Remitly Business, you will set the technical direction for the product engineering that powers this marketplace. You'll lead the architecture of our Go services, APIs, and durable money-movement workflows on Temporal — and, as a well-rounded product engineer, you'll drive the frontend architecture decisions that shape our React/TypeScript applications, even though backend is your home base. This is hands-on technical leadership, not an architecture-only role: you'll code, lead large initiatives from design through launch, raise the bar through design reviews and mentorship, and use AI coding agents as a genuine force multiplier — for yourself and, by setting standards, for the whole team. You will work in a hybrid capacity from our Seattle office.

You Will

Own the overall technology of the team: lead large, multi-quarter initiatives — planning and sequencing work across engineers to deliver faster, and driving them from design through launch.Design systems that address both current and future needs: money-movement flows at scale on Temporal — long-running, idempotent, observable workflows with correct ledgering, reconciliation, and compliance gating.Drive architecture decisions across the full product surface — service boundaries, API and GraphQL contracts, data models, and the frontend architecture choices (rendering, state, client-facing API shape) they imply — partnering with our fullstack engineers on the React/TypeScript side.Lead team design reviews, ensuring proposed solutions avoid unnecessary complexity and align with Remitly's long-term architecture plans; frame build-vs-buy decisions and assess new technologies for feasibility.Make AI-assisted, spec-driven development (Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents) a core part of how you and the team work — designing team-level standards for AI-assisted development, identifying where AI delivers durable gains, and advising management on how AI adoption changes capacity and estimation.Uphold and contribute to the evolution of our Foundational Excellence standards for security, reliability, and observability; mitigate long-term risks caused by complexity before they become incidents.Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers; drive efforts to expand the team's knowledge and skills; represent Remitly's values and technical bar in interviews.Help shape short- and long-term roadmaps with Product, Design, Analytics, Compliance, Infrastructure, and Operations — communicating trade-offs concisely and adapting to technical and non-technical audiences.

You Have

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.7+ years of engineering experience building backend services in collaborative, cross-functional teams, including a track record of leading large initiatives that spanned multiple engineers or teams.Advanced backend expertise in Go, or deep experience in a comparable language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, C#) and the drive to make Go your primary language quickly.Enough frontend fluency to drive decisions in a React/TypeScript codebase — API contracts for clients, rendering and state trade-offs — even if you don't write frontend code every day.Fluency with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) as a daily working practice, and experience (or clear readiness) setting team-level standards for their effective, verified use. (We build with AI, not AI products.)Experience designing secure, scalable, performant services on cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS), and leading design reviews that keep systems simple, resilient, and extensible.Experience partnering with Product Management to shape roadmaps — breaking major launches into parallel projects, estimating with AI-aware assumptions, and driving them to launch.Clear, concise written and in-person communication, adapting to different audiences and articulating technical trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.Nice to have: workflow orchestration experience (Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions, or similar); payments, fintech, or money-movement experience; hands-on React/TypeScript.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is hiring a Regional Business Manager to own growth in our USA to Caribbean markets (these markets cover customers sending money to the Caribbean countries from the USA). The Regional Business Manager will own this corridor and be responsible for the growth and health of the markets in their region.

This is a strategy, analytics, and operations role involving planning, building, and executing initiatives across product, pricing, marketing, risk/fraud, analytics, customer service, engineering, and other departments. You will report to the USA To Latin America & Caribbean (USA-LAC) General Manager and work in a hybrid environment from our Seattle, Arlington/Washington DC, or New York City office.

You Will:

Own sustainable growth in your cluster of USA to Caribbean corridors, measured against key performance indicators like new customers, monthly active customers, transactions, volume, revenue, and profitability. Serve as the market expert for your corridors, building a deep understanding of customers and their communities in the US, the competitive set, and the receive-side ecosystem (payout partners, regulation, and local market conditions), and bringing that context and customer insights into decisions across the business. Define both the long and short term strategic vision for growth in your corridors, and the tactical roadmap of initiatives for how to achieve that vision.Partner closely with and drive action across pricing, product, marketing, risk/fraud, and other relevant teams: set a clear point of view on what your corridors need, push for decisions and launches, and follow through to measured results. Support commercial conversations with disbursement and destination partners in your markets, turning partner opportunities into customer-facing offers. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and customer trends, translating insights into regional priorities. Build business cases for key initiatives and influence prioritization of partner-teams' roadmaps through structured business impact / customer centric frameworks. Drive ideation of regional product initiatives, and work with the US-LAC product, engineering, and design team to translate customer and commercial opportunities into clear requirements. Support the development cycles & measure outcomes post launch. Share learnings with the other Regional Business Managers and the US-LAC GM so that what works in one cluster can be applied across the region.

You Have:

5+ years of professional experience in business management, growth, or general management roles in a B2C context, ideally in money movement, fintech, or financial services. Native level fluency in Spanish (required) An ownership mentality and a track record of ownership. We are looking for someone with a bias for action who “gets things done” and is hungry to grow their areas of the business. Ideally you have: owned a market, product, or P&L end to end and driven results across some combination of pricing, product, marketing, and risk/fraud. Deep regional and cultural expertise, gained through lived experience, professional experience in the region, or both, including an understanding of the migrant community in the US and how customers send and receive money in these markets. Demonstrated problem solving skills (qualitative and quantitative). Can generate high quality hypotheses and dive into an ambiguous problem statement. Ability to balance compassionate partnership and the ability to be constructively direct. You will influence and network within the business and with external partners.

Preferred:

Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services. Ideally serving immigrant communities in the US or customers in the Caribbean. Product experience OR growth / marketing experience in the areas noted above.

Compensation Details: The starting base salary range for this position is typically $156,000 - $195,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits:

Flexible paid time offHealth, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matchingPaid parental, medical, military and family care leaveMental Health & Family Forming BenefitsEmployee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Continuing education benefits

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is building the Remitly Global Card, a card and account that gives customers a single, trusted place to hold, spend, and move their money, launching across multiple geographies.

As a Product Analyst II on the Global Card team, you'll pick up real ownership from day one: funnel performance and optimization, the economic drivers of a consumer fintech product, how and why customers manage their money, and how marketing and product fit together. You'll combine rigorous, AI-first analysis with hands-on product ownership, including analyzing customer behavior, helping define and prioritize the roadmap, evaluating experiments, and building the trusted data systems and AI-driven workflows that let the whole team make faster, better decisions.

This is not a reporting or support function that exists to service PM requests. It's a builder role with a hard data and AI core, and it's the on-ramp for our next generation of data-driven Product Managers. You'll own a slice of the roadmap, build genuine product judgment, and grow into product leadership over time. You will report to the General Manager and work in a hybrid capacity from our Arlington, VA office.

You Will:

Own funnel performance end to end — acquisition, onboarding and KYC, activation, funding, first spend, and retention. Find where customers fall out, size what it's worth to fix, and drive the fix.Analyze the economic drivers of the product — unit economics, spend and funding behavior, cost and revenue per customer — and turn that into a clear point of view on what we should build next.Understand how customers actually manage money: what they spend locally, what they send home, what triggers a remittance, and how the card and the send experience reinforce each other.Own a slice of the product roadmap end to end — from identifying the opportunity, to sizing the impact, to writing requirements or lightweight specs, to partnering with Engineering to ship, to tracking results post-launch.Build and maintain the analytical foundation — clean data models, dashboards, and self-serve tooling — so Product, Engineering, and Marketing can run their own queries and read their own results without waiting on you. Where the data structures don't exist yet, you'll create them.Work in an AI-first way — using LLM-based tools, predictive models, and AI-assisted coding and query workflows to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive reporting, and surface insights faster. You should be looking for ways to automate yourself out of the routine work so you can spend your time on higher-leverage product problems.Partner with Product and Engineering to design, run, and interpret A/B tests and experiments, and use results to guide roadmap prioritization and feature development.Drive customer segmentation and lifecycle analysis to identify at-risk cohorts, high-value customers, and opportunities for personalization across product and marketing touchpoints.Connect the dots between marketing and product — partner with Marketing on campaign measurement and attribution, and make sure acquisition, activation, and product engagement are read as one system rather than three.Support launches into new geographies — sizing the opportunity, defining launch-readiness metrics, and reading market-by-market performance as the product expands.Represent the voice of the customer in product discussions, translating research and data into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership, while holding the correctness and trust bar a regulated money product demands.

You Have:

4+ years of experience in product analytics, business analytics, data analytics, product management, or a related quantitative/product role.Domain depth in financial services, ideally consumer-facing products. You understand how these products make money and what makes a customer stay.Experienced with writing SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, plus experience with data modeling and structure. You can not only query the data, you can design how it should be stored and built in the first place.A builder's mindset and full-stack product instincts — you'd rather write code to automate a report than pull it by hand, and you care about how the product works, not just how it's measured.Fluency with AI-first tools and workflows, and an instinct to reach for them first.A passion for solving customer problems through data, with genuine curiosity about how product decisions shape customer behavior.

rows.title: Associate Manager, Offline Marketing

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.

Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.

We are seeking a curious, analytical and results-driven marketing professional to join our Offline Marketing team and help drive new patient growth across Audio, YouTube and endorser partnerships. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Offline Marketing, you will own the day-to-day management and optimization of a growing portfolio of Audio and YouTube campaigns across Ro’s conditions while helping build the next generation of our endorser partnership program. You’ll work across podcast, streaming audio, YouTube and talent partnerships to identify new opportunities, evaluate and structure deals, optimize existing campaigns, and develop a proactive pipeline of endorsers who can help Ro reach and acquire new patients.

The ideal candidate combines strong media and performance-marketing instincts with an enthusiasm for creators, talent and partnerships. You are comfortable using data to make decisions, managing a large portfolio of campaigns and external partners, and moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term opportunities to improve and grow a program. This role is highly cross-functional and requires a collaborative approach to working across multiple agency partners, Creative, Legal, Product Marketing, Engineering and Medical teams.

What You’ll Do

Own and optimize Ro’s Audio and YouTube campaigns across conditions, managing media plans, budgets and ongoing performance against condition-specific acquisition targets. Help build and grow Ro’s endorser ecosystem by proactively identifying high-potential talent and partnership opportunities across podcasts, YouTube and the broader creator landscape. Evaluate and structure new partnership opportunities, assessing media economics, audience fit, historical performance, usage rights, creative potential and expected value to determine where Ro should invest. Develop a proactive partnership pipeline and testing roadmap, identifying new talent, audiences and partnership models that can expand the program beyond its existing portfolio. Manage relationships with Audio and YouTube agencies and external partners, serving as a key day-to-day Ro point of contact and ensuring campaigns launch and operate effectively. Monitor campaign and partner performance and make portfolio recommendations, including where to scale, extend, optimize or exit partnerships based on direct acquisition performance and the broader value of the relationship. Partner closely with Paid Social and Creative teams to extend endorser content, identifying promising footage and concepts and helping translate partnership assets into performative assets. Help shape creative strategy with endorsers and partners, applying learnings from both native placements and Paid Social performance to improve scripts, reads, concepts and future content. Analyze and synthesize media and creative performance, translating campaign data into clear insights and recommendations for budget owners and cross-functional stakeholders. Own key operational workflows across the portfolio, including campaign launches, creative briefing, script refreshes, compliance reviews, reporting and budget management. Develop a deep understanding of Audio and YouTube measurement and attribution, including the different signals Ro uses to understand both direct-response and holistic partnership performance. Stay close to the evolving Audio, YouTube and creator landscape, including emerging talent, competitor activity, platform trends and new partnership opportunities that could help differentiate Ro. 

What You’ll Bring To The Team

3- 5 years of experience in performance marketing, media planning/buying, partnerships, growth marketing, or a related field. Experience managing or supporting scaled acquisition programs within a marketing program with budgets of $3M+/month. Experience across one or more relevant media channels such as Audio (radio + podcasts), YouTube, creator partnerships, TV/CTV, or other Offline acquisition channels. A genuine interest in creators, endorsers, podcasts, YouTube and the broader media landscape, with an instinct for identifying talent and content that could resonate with an audience. Strong performance-marketing instincts and comfort using metrics such as CAC, response rate and conversion performance to evaluate campaigns and make optimization recommendations. You have a passion for data and possess the expertise to utilize both qualitative and quantitative information in effective decision making You have experience and are familiar with running A/B, multivariate, and geo tests You are familiar with the nuances and complexities of the various attribution approaches for offline channels Experience managing external agencies, media partners, creators or other external stakeholders and an ability to build productive, trusted relationships. Experience working through creative development and production workflows, with an understanding of how creative can be tested and optimized as a performance lever. Strong project-management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and partners simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail. Comfort working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment and navigating ambiguity as priorities and opportunities evolve. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize performance into clear recommendations for stakeholders. Experience with marketing analytics and reporting tools such as Looker, Mixpanel, Hex or similar platforms preferred (Audio attribution platforms such as Podscribe and AI platforms such as Claude is a plus!) 

We welcome qualified candidates of all races, creeds, genders, and sexuality to apply.

The target base salary for this position ranges from $103,700 to $120,000, in addition to a competitive equity and benefits package (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

Ro recognizes the power of in-person collaboration, while supporting the flexibility to work anywhere in the United States. For our Ro’ers in the tri-state (NY) area, you will join us at HQ on Tuesdays and Thursdays. For those outside of the tri-state area, you will be able to join in-person collaborations throughout the year (i.e., during team on-sites).

At Ro, we believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths — and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Ro is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our application and interview process. If you require a reasonable accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact us at [email protected] .

See our California Privacy Policy here .

We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to assist with parts of our recruiting and hiring process, such as reviewing applications, evaluating resumes, and assessing responses or job-related qualifications. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are made by humans.
