rows.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Strava

Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the growing AI and Machine Learning team at Strava. This team is responsible for sophisticated machine learning models and systems which provide value to Strava athletes including personalization, recommendations, search, and trust and safety. The team also maintains the ML platform and infrastructure that enables our team to iterate on models quickly and deploy them reliably at scale.

This is an important role in the ML team and across Product teams designing, roadmapping, and implementing innovative machine learning algorithms. We value full stack ML engineers who are able to work on all parts of an ML pipeline from model building, evaluation, optimizing performance, and ensuring the scalability and reliability of these production models. We also seek those who can improve the systems and tools behind the ML pipeline to further empower the team.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half your time on-site in our San Francisco Office — three days per week.

What You’ll Do:

Build for a Well Loved Consumer Product: Work at the intersection of AI and fitness to launch and optimize product experiences that will be used by tens of millions of active people worldwideOwn End to End AI Systems: Drive key projects powered by ML on the Strava platform end-to-end, from initial model prototyping to shipping production code to scaling and optimizing inference and deploymentShape AI at Strava: Be a strong voice on a highly collaborative team with a range of experience levels. Work across teams to deploy ML solutions in multiple surfaces and build out our technical ML capabilities. Innovate in AI for Fitness: Design and develop novel models and methodologies to take on novel problems that improve athlete experience, including recommendation systems, activity prediction, and personalized insights. Build from a rich dataset: Explore and use Strava’s extensive unique fitness and geo datasets from millions of users to extract actionable insights, inform product decisions, and optimize existing features

You Will Be Successful Here By:

Driving innovation with Product in mind: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in machine learning, AI, and related fields. Experiment, advocate and get buy-in for innovative techniques to improve existing products or explore new features that result in step function changes to how we build AI at Strava. Leading as an Owner: Owning your work end-to-end and being accountable for the outcomes in the projects you drive and landing impact for the business. Ensure the end-to-end system delivers as expected through collaboration with partners. Analyzing the Data: Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to find opportunities for applying machine learning to drive business impact and enhance Strava’s features and measure impact. Collaborating in and across teams: Build relationships, advocate, and communicate with cross-functional partners and product verticals to identify opportunities and bring your technical vision to life. Raising the ML standard: Help work towards best practices for model development, deployment, and maintenance. Being passionate about the work you are doing and contributing positively to Strava’s inclusive and collaborative team culture and values

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

Have worked on numerous machine learning problems and broken them down into incremental tasks. Have demonstrated solid interpersonal and communication skills, and collaborative approach to drive business impact across teams. Have experience building, shipping, and supporting ML models in production at scale. Have experience with exploratory data analysis and model prototyping, using languages such as Python or R and tools like Scikit learn, Pandas, Numpy, Pytorch, Tensorflow, and Sagemaker. Have built and worked on data pipelines using large scale data technologies (like Spark, Hadoop, EMR, SQL, and Snowflake). Are experienced and interested in production ML model operational excellence and best practices, like automated model retraining, performance monitoring, feature logging, and A/B testing. Have built backend production services on cloud environments like AWS, using languages like (but not limited to) Python, Ruby, Java, Scala, and Go. 

For information on benefits, please click here.

Why Join Us?

Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

Strava is an equal opportunity employer. In keeping with the values of Strava, we make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

rows.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives

About the Role:

Remitly is building the Remitly Global Card, a card and account that gives customers a single, trusted place to hold, spend, and move their money, launching across multiple geographies.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Global Card, you are the voice of the customer inside the product team and the voice of the product in the market. You'll define who this card is for, why it matters to them, and how we say it, and then carry that through launch across new geographies, one market at a time. You'll partner closely with Product, Analytics, Design, Compliance, and regional Marketing teams as a cross-functional team that moves fast and builds with AI in the loop every day.

This is a builder's seat on a product still finding its shape, not a launch-calendar function. You will report to the General Manager, Remitly Global Card, and work in a hybrid capacity Tuesday - Thursday from our Arlington, VA office.

You Will:

Own positioning and messaging for Global Card — who it's for, what it replaces, and why it earns a place in a customer's financial life. Translate deep customer understanding into messaging that lands with migrant and multicultural audiences across very different markets.Drive go-to-market end to end for launches and major features — GTM strategy briefs, launch tiering, readiness, channel briefs, and post-launch debriefs — ensuring every launch is anchored in customer insight, executed with rigor, and aligned to business priorities.Lead market entry. As Global Card expands beyond the U.S., you'll size the audience, adapt positioning to local context and regulation, partner with regional teams on launch plans, and read what works market by market.Shape the roadmap. Bring competitive, customer, and market evidence into product planning, and influence what gets built — not just how it's announced.Partner with Analytics on the full funnel — acquisition, onboarding, activation, funding, first spend, and retention. Use unit economics and customer behavior data to decide where marketing effort actually moves the business, and hold yourself to measurable outcomes.Work in an AI-first way — using LLM-based tools to accelerate research, message testing, competitive tracking, and content production, and to automate the repetitive work so your time goes to the strategic problems. AI tools are part of how this team works, not a side experiment.Enable scale and repeatability by codifying what works into playbooks and standards other PMMs and channel owners can run without you in the room.Communicate with clarity to executives — distilling a complex, regulated, multi-market product into a crisp narrative leadership can act on.

You Have:

6+ years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience in a data-driven consumer (B2C) product company, with a strong track record of leading GTM strategy and influencing product roadmaps.Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or financial services, with exposure to international or multicultural audiences.Proven success launching new products and features for diverse consumer audiences through strategic acumen, data-driven decision-making, and effective cross-functional collaboration.Strong ability to craft compelling messaging and positioning that resonates with customers and drives product and feature adoption.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret unit economics, consumer behavior, and market data to inform marketing strategy. Extensive experience collaborating with Product, Business, and Marketing teams to develop strategies, execute experiments, and analyze results that drive successful launches.Fluency with AI-first tools and workflows, and an instinct to reach for them first.

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $144,000 – $180,000 gross per annum. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Flexible paid time offHealth, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matchingPaid parental, medical, military and family care leaveMental Health & Family Forming BenefitsEmployee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Continuing education

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is hiring Regional Business Managers to own growth in our USA to Latin America markets (these markets cover customers sending money to Latin America from the USA). The Regional Business Manager will own a cluster of corridors and be responsible for the growth and health of the markets in their region.

This is a strategy, analytics, and operations role involving planning, building, and executing initiatives across product, pricing, marketing, risk/fraud, analytics, customer service, engineering, and other departments. You will report to the USA to Latin America & Caribbean (US-LAC) General Manager and work in a hybrid environment from our Seattle, Arlington/Washington DC, or New York City office.

Corridor Clusters:

We are hiring for several corridor clusters within the US-LATAM market. We will match each hire to the cluster where their market expertise is strongest, and cluster boundaries may shift to fit the right person. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one of the following:

Central America (Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, and Nicaragua): We are looking for someone with experience across these four key markets in Central America. We especially welcome candidates with a Guatemalan background or deep familiarity with Guatemala, including its indigenous communities.South America North (Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia): We are looking for deep knowledge of one or more of these markets and their communities in the US, with a Colombian or Ecuadorian background especially welcome.South America South (Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay): We are looking for someone with experience across the Southern Cone of South America. Given Brazil’s market size and distinct market dynamics it is of particular interest.

Own sustainable growth in your cluster of USA to Latin America corridors, measured against key performance indicators like new customers, monthly active customers, transactions, volume, revenue, and profitability. Serve as the market expert for your corridors, building a deep understanding of customers and their communities in the US, the competitive set, and the receive-side ecosystem (payout partners, regulation, and local market conditions), and bringing that context and customer insights into decisions across the business. Define both the long and short term strategic vision for growth in your corridors, and the tactical roadmap of initiatives for how to achieve that vision.Partner closely with and drive action across pricing, product, marketing, risk/fraud, and other relevant teams: set a clear point of view on what your corridors need, push for decisions and launches, and follow through to measured results. Build business cases for key initiatives and influence prioritization of partner-teams' roadmaps through structured business impact / customer centric frameworks. Drive ideation of regional product initiatives, and work with the US-LAC product, engineering, and design team to translate customer and commercial opportunities into clear requirements. Support the development cycles & measure outcomes post launch. Share learnings with the other Regional Business Managers and the US-LAC GM so that what works in one cluster can be applied across the region.

5+ years of professional experience in business management, growth, or general management roles in a B2C context, ideally in money movement, fintech, or financial services. Native level fluency in Spanish (required), fluent Portuguese for Brazil-focused candidates. An ownership mentality and a track record of ownership. We are looking for someone with a bias for action who “gets things done” and is hungry to grow their areas of the business. Ideally you have: owned a market, product, or P&L end to end and driven results across some combination of pricing, product, marketing, and risk/fraud. Deep regional and cultural expertise in at least one of the corridor clusters above, gained through lived experience, professional experience in the region, or both, including an understanding of the migrant community in the US and how customers send and receive money in these markets. Demonstrated problem solving skills (qualitative and quantitative). Can generate high quality hypotheses and dive into an ambiguous problem statement. Ability to balance compassionate partnership and the ability to be constructively direct. You will influence and network within the business and with external partners.

Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services. Ideally serving immigrant communities in the US or customers in Latin America. Product experience OR growth / marketing experience in the areas noted above.

rows.title: Assistant General Counsel, Litigation
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

The WHOOP legal team plays a critical role in supporting that mission by enabling the business to move quickly and responsibly around the world. We are rigorous but pragmatic, risk-aware rather than risk-averse, calm under pressure, excellent communicators, and deeply committed to being trusted partners to the business.

WHOOP is hiring an Assistant General Counsel, Litigation to oversee and manage litigation and regulatory enforcement matters. In this role, you will report to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO) and, in conjunction with the CLO, be responsible for developing and implementing litigation and regulatory enforcement strategy. The successful candidate must be comfortable managing all manner of litigation, including commercial disputes, consumer class actions, intellectual property matters, employment disputes, and investigations by federal, state, and international regulatory bodies.

WHOOP is a rapidly scaling, global business built upon a dynamic consumer brand that involves hardware, software, and healthcare. Accordingly, this role will be engaged with an extraordinarily broad array of legal areas. The successful candidate will be a seasoned litigator who possesses the first-hand experience and judgment necessary to assess litigation and regulatory risks and opportunities, hire and manage the outside counsel representing WHOOP, and ensure WHOOP receives the highest quality representation from its law firm partners.

In addition to managing the litigation docket, you will serve as a strategic counselor to all business and corporate functions regarding legal risk and opportunity. The successful candidate will be more than an experienced litigator. They will be a business-minded litigation leader who knows when to fight, when to settle, and when litigation risk should drive changes in the business.

Responsibilities

Own the Company's litigation portfolio, with responsibility for the strategy, oversight, and resolution of lawsuits, arbitrations, pre-litigation disputes, and other contested matters involving the Company, independently driving matters while exercising sound judgment as to when legal, business, or reputational risks warrant escalation.Develop litigation strategy for significant matters, including evaluating claims and defenses, determining strategic objectives, identifying key decision points, and recommending litigation and settlement positions.Provide senior leadership with clear and actionable assessments of litigation risk, including exposure, ranges of potential outcomes, strategic alternatives, costs, business implications, and recommended courses of action.Select, retain, and manage outside counsel, establishing clear expectations regarding strategy, staffing, budgets, work product, responsiveness, and outcomes, and independently pressure-testing outside counsel’s strategic recommendations throughout the entire litigation life-cycle.Exercise rigorous oversight of litigation spending, including reviewing budgets and forecasts, scrutinizing staffing and billing practices, identifying opportunities for alternative fee arrangements, and ensuring that legal spending is proportionate to the Company's exposure and strategic objectives.Develop settlement strategies and lead significant settlement negotiations, balancing legal exposure, litigation costs, business considerations, precedent risk, reputational considerations, and operational impacts.Partner closely with Finance and Accounting regarding litigation reserves, contingent liabilities, insurance recoveries, settlement accounting, budgeting and forecasting, and other financial implications of litigation.Partner closely with the People Team regarding employment disputes.Manage litigation-related insurance matters, including providing timely notice of claims, coordinating with insurers and brokers, pursuing available coverage, and managing coverage disputes where necessary.Oversee discovery and evidence-preservation obligations, including litigation holds, document collection and review, information governance, e-discovery strategy, privilege issues, and the use of technology and outside vendors to manage discovery efficiently.Conduct and oversee sensitive internal investigations where appropriate and coordinate with employment, compliance, privacy, security, or other specialists depending on the subject matter.Establish and continuously improve litigation playbooks, processes, and technology, enabling the Legal team to manage a growing litigation portfolio efficiently and consistently as the Company scales.Promote appropriate use of data and technology in litigation management, including e-discovery tools, matter-management systems, litigation analytics, and emerging AI-enabled legal technologies.

Qualifications

J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.7+ years of relevant legal experience, including experience at a nationally recognized law firm and/or an in-house legal department managing litigation.Experience as the lead or managing attorney on complex litigation. Strong command of litigation strategy and procedure, including discovery, dispositive motions, expert practice, mediation, trial preparation, settlement negotiations, and appeals.Demonstrated ability to balance legal risk with practical business considerations and deliver actionable advice in a fast-paced environment.Ability to translate complicated legal issues into concise, practical advice for senior executives and business leaders.Experience in building and improving legal processes, playbooks, and operational infrastructure to support a scaling business.Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across cross-functional teams.Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.Experience supporting technology, consumer products, healthcare, or subscription-based businesses is strongly preferred.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $220,000 to $250,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Product Owner II
rows.descriptionText:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed togetherTrusting – we choose to trust each otherCustomer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisionsFuture Focused – we accelerate changeCurious – we turn knowledge into action

Job Description

Wood Mackenzie’s Long Term Power product team is responsible for a suite of products that enables our customers to make decisions that matter across the energy value chain, delivered through Lens, our one-stop research and data analytics platform. Lens delivers insights at key decision points across end-to-end workflows, with the experience increasingly enhanced by AI and made accessible through agentic delivery mechanisms such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Establishing a resilient, sustainable portfolio is critical for energy companies as they develop agile business models to meet net zero goals. We strive to be their partner of choice, offering a range of technical solutions – increasingly delivered through AI-enabled and agentic channels – to support the business needs of these companies. Our team delivers integrated analysis across the power sector, enabling customers to navigate energy industry dynamics, and make quicker, more effective decisions.

We are seeking a delivery-focused Product Manager to help execute the next phase of our AI-ready data transformation journey. Working from an audited inventory of technology datasets, you will prioritise and drive their migration into Snowflake, ensuring they are structured, governed and ready to power new agentic AI experiences and Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) offerings. You will liaise closely with our engineering team, translating the voice of the customer into clear, prioritised requirements, and keeping delivery on track against an established roadmap. A key part of the role is understanding how our data connects – from the technologies that generate renewable power through to their impact on the wider energy mix – and turning that understanding into practical, sequenced execution plans.

This role sits at the intersection of product, data engineering and analytics. It is a hands-on, execution-led role, critical to ensuring our data capabilities scale with the needs of the business while enabling high-quality, reliable and actionable data for our clients and internal research teams.

Main responsibilities

Working in the Long Term Power and Renewable customer segment with a focus on renewable technology and hydrogen and derivatives datasets, you will work alongside our product, data, research and engineering teams, reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Power & Renewables. This is an execution and prioritisation-focused role: you will take agreed strategy and turn it into a well-sequenced backlog, drive it through delivery, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress.

Responsibilities Will Include

Data Tooling & Infrastructure

Own and prioritise the backlog for onboarding audited technology datasets into Snowflake, sequencing the work required to make them AI-readyCollaborate with engineering and data teams to enhance our data capabilities – ensuring we have proper meta dataWork with engineering to prioritise and execute pipeline improvements for performance, reliability and cost-efficiencyDrive initiatives to improve data consistency, interoperability and quality across systems, tracking progress against plan

AI-Ready Data & Agentic Enablement

Support the packaging of audited, AI-ready datasets into agentic AI experiences and Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) offerings, working closely with engineering to execute against the roadmapPrioritise the backlog of dataset readiness work (schema, metadata, lineage) needed to unlock new agentic workflowsCoordinate with the Senior Product Manager to translate strategic direction into sequenced, deliverable execution plans

Data Discovery

Support evaluation of new data sources identified by the portfolio product lead, and manage their onboarding into the delivery roadmapCollaborate with research and modelling teams to sequence delivery work that balances their needs with those of external clientsTrack delivery of new and enhanced data sources against the agreed roadmap, flagging risks and re-prioritising as needed

Cross-functional Collaboration

rows.title: Senior HR Business Partner
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favorite sports teams and competitions.

Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.Sports books can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.

Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

In this critical role, you will partner closely with senior leadership to align our HR initiatives with business objectives. Performance Management: Champion our continuous performance management processes, empowering managers to provide meaningful feedback, set clear goals, and address underperformance effectively. Engagement & Culture: Drive initiatives that enhance employee engagement, promote diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI), and reinforce our core values within the Paddington office and beyond. Data-Driven Insights: Utilize HR metrics and analytics to identify trends, inform decision making, and measure the impact of HR programs on business outcomes. Required Qualifications

7+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years operating as a Senior HRBP or in a similar strategic role.Previous experience in the technology, data analytics, or sports industry is highly desirable. Subject Matter ExpertiseDeep understanding of UK employment law and best practices in employee relations, performance management, and talent development. Commercial AcumenStrong business acumen with the ability to connect HR strategies to commercial outcomes. Communication SkillsExceptional communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to challenge and advise senior leaders. Analytical SkillsProficiency in using HR data to tell a story and drive actionable insights. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business

Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

Just as grading olympiad proofs takes someone who can solve olympiad problems, judging an AI-proposed change to a frontier training algorithm takes a researcher who could have invented it. In this role, you are that researcher.

You will invent new machine learning (ML) architectures, optimizers, and training methods, and build the systems that let Gemini propose, implement, and test such changes on its own. rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

How Product Works At DX

PMs at DX act as the compass and context engine for their product area. You will own product direction, prioritized problems, and outcomes; your Tech Lead partner will own sequencing, technical scope, and quality. We expect PMs to stay close to customers, synthesize context for the team, sprint ahead on ambiguous work with lightweight specs and mockups, and increase the team’s speed of learning. We default to pragmatic, async written work rather than unnecessary process.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead DX’s System Insights portfolio, including out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.

This portfolio is where complex engineering data becomes understandable and actionable. You will define how DX turns quantitative signals into trusted insights for engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, and platform teams. That includes both opinionated experiences that answer common questions quickly and flexible tools that let sophisticated customers explore their own questions.

You will set portfolio strategy, connect work across multiple product surfaces, and drive decisions through deep customer, market, technical, and quantitative context. The right person is an exceptional data product leader who can move fluently between analytical methods, data models, information design, customer workflows, and business outcomes.

Location

This role is US remote-friendly. Candidates based in Utah are preferred.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX’s System Insights portfolio.Establish a coherent reporting and analytics experience across out-of-the-box reports, Dashboards, Data Studio, and Pulse.Define how DX helps customers move from data to insight to action, reducing time to insight while preserving analytical trust.Balance opinionated, ready-to-use insights with flexible tools for custom exploration and analysis.Raise the quality of report discoverability, information architecture, data visualization, and decision support across the product.You’ll own how DX evolves AI across the platform, shaping the roadmap for DX AI, our conversational copilot that lets engineering leaders query their own data to investigate anomalies, compare teams, summarize survey feedback, and generate charts on the flyYou will drive the platform toward a more Agentic future where AI proactively surfaces insights and takes action on the user’s behalf.Partner with the Data Cloud and Self-Reported Insights teams to combine system and human signals into a differentiated customer experience.Develop deep context on engineering executives, developer productivity leaders, platform teams, the questions they need to answer, and how those answers affect decisions.Shape the most ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, analytical exploration, and clear written narratives.Always know how the portfolio is performing across usage, adoption, retention, and satisfaction; lead regular growth reviews and bring hypotheses when metrics move.Influence product direction beyond your immediate team and raise the quality of product thinking across DX.Partner with Engineering, Design, customer-facing teams, and go-to-market leaders on pilots, launches, documentation, positioning, and measurement.
